patippurimi aṟṟatu

inta ākkattuṭaṉ toṭarpuṭiyavarkaḷ, ulakaḷaḷāviya potup payaṉpāṭṭukku eṉa patippurimic caṭṭattukku uṭpaṭṭu, taṅkaḷ aṉittup patippurimikaḷiyum viṭuvittuḷḷaṉar.

putuppativukaḷ





﻿

nuḻivāyil



eṉatu kāl nūṟṟāṇṭuk kaṉavukaḷiloṉṟu iṉṟu naṉavāka nūluruvil uṅkaḷ karaṅkaḷil tavaḻvatu eṉakku elliyillā makiḻvūṭṭuvatāyuḷḷatu. nāṉ ilakkiyattiyum moḻiyiyaliyum mutaṉmip pāṭaṅkaḷāka eṭuttup paṭittavaṉ eṉṟālum eṉakku eppōtum aṟiviyal, toḻilnuṭpap pāṭaṅkaḷil kuṟippāka maruttuvattuṟi nūlkaḷip paṭippatilum avaṟṟip paṟṟit tamiḻilē cintippatilum eṉakku eppōtumē viruppam atikam. maruttuvattit tamiḻil colla vēṇṭum eṉṟa eṉatu viruppatti eṉ iḷiya makaṉ cemmal mūlam niṟivēṟṟik koḷḷa virumpiyataṉ viḷivē, avaṉ maruttuva māṇavaṉ ākiyatu. maruttuvak kallūriyil avaṉ kālaṭi eṭuttu vikkummuṉ avaṉiṭam eṉ uḷḷuṇarvukaḷi veḷippaṭuttiṉēṉ.

uṉ etirkāla nalvāḻvukkāka maṭṭum uṉṉi nāṉ maruttuvam payila aṉuppavilli. eṉṉuḷ pala āṇṭukaḷākak kaṉaṉṟu koṇṭirukkum pērāciyoṉṟi uṉmūlam niṟivēṟṟi, uṉ vāḻvōṭu eṉ vāḻviyum veṟṟiyuṭiyatāka ākkikkoḷḷa vēṇṭum eṉṟa pēravā eṉakkuṇṭu. nī maruttuvap paṭippi veṟṟikaramāka muṭittapiṉ uṉṉāl evvaḷavu muṭiyumō avvaḷavu maruttuva nūlkaḷit tamiḻil tara vēṇṭum. ivveṇṇatti maruttuvak kallūriyil kālvikkum pōtē uṟutimikka muṭivāka uṉ uḷḷattiṉ aṭittaḷattil aḻuttamākap patiya vittuk koḷḷavēṇṭum. maruttuvatti āṅkila moḻimūlam paṭittālum atit tamiḻil colvatu eppaṭi eṉṟa cintaṉi eppōtum uṉakku iruntukoṇṭē irukka vēṇṭum. appaṭi nī tamiḻil colla ﻿viḻiyum aṟiviyal, maruttuvac ceytikaḷi ilakkiya nayattōṭum kaṟpaṉit tiṟaṉōṭum puṉikati vaṭivil iyaṉṟavari kūṟa muṟpaṭa vēṇṭum. appōtutāṉ cātāraṇamāṉavarkaḷ purintu koḷḷak kaṭiṉamāka uḷḷa maruttuvac ceytikaḷum eḷimiyāka amintu, cātāraṇa paṭippaṟivuḷḷavarkaḷukkum eḷitākap puriyavum virivāka avarkaḷip pōyc cēravum vaḻiyēṟpaṭum. atuvē, makaṉ eṉṟa muṟiyil tantiyākiya eṉakku nī ceyyum uṇmiyāṉa kimmāṟāka irukkum. itit tavira vēṟu etiyum nāṉ uṉṉiṭam etirpārkkavilli. itic ceyvatāka eṉakku nī uṟutimoḻi tara vēṇṭum



eṉṟu nāṉ kūṟiyapōtu,

uṅkaḷ viruppatti niṟivēṟṟuvatiyē eṉ vāḻkkiyiṉ mukkiya nōkkamākak koṇṭu ceyalpaṭuvēṉ



eṉa uṟutiyaḷittāṉ. eṉ makaṉōṭu iṇintu nāṉum kaṭanta pala āṇṭukkālamāka maruttuvap pāṭanūlkaḷip paṭittu varalāṉēṉ. eṉ aiyappāṭukaḷiyellām nāṉ tamiḻil kēṭpatum avaṟṟiṟkāṉa viḷakkaṅkaḷi avaṉ eṉakkut tamiḻil viḷakkuvatum vaḻakkamākiyatu. itaṉmūlam eṅkaḷ iruvariṭiyēyum maruttuvak karuttukkaḷit tamiḻil parimāṟikkoḷvatu eḷitāṉatāka maṭṭumallāmal iṉimiyāṉatākavum amintateṉalām. appōtellām veḷippaṭum karuttukkaḷik kuṟittu vittukkoḷvatiyum nāṉ vāṭikkiyākkik koṇṭēṉ. kaṭanta patiṉāṟu āṇṭu kālamāka eṉ makaṉ ṭākṭar cemmaliṉ uṟutuṇiyōṭum eṉ arumi naṇparkaḷ tiru. irā. naṭarācaṉ, ilakkiya maruttuvar na. kiruṣṇamūrtti, maruttuva eḻuttāḷar ku. kaṇēcaṉ ākiyōrkaḷiṉ ottuḻippōṭum maruttuvak kaḷañciyap pērakarāti eṉum peyaril innūl veḷivantuḷḷatu.

eṉiṉum, itaṟkāṉa aṭittaḷam nāṟpattintāṇṭukaṭku muṉpē eṉ uḷḷattil aḻuttamākap pōṭap paṭṭiruntati innērattil niṉivu kūrāmal irukka muṭiyavilli.

iṉṟikkuc cariyāka nāṟpattintu āṇṭukaṭku muṉpu, 'Wonder Drugs’ eṉum āṅkila maruttuva nūli teṉmoḻikaḷ puttaka niṟuvaṉattukkākat tamiḻil patippikkum paṇiyi nāṉ mēṟkoṇṭapōtutāṉ, tamiḻip poṟuttavari immuyaṟciyil nām eṅkē niṟka vēṇṭiyuḷḷatu eṉpatu eṉakkut teḷivākap pulappaṭṭatu. annūli veḷiyiṭṭataṉāl nāṉ peṟṟa paṭṭaṟivu mikavum payaṉuḷḷatāyamintatu. uyiriyal eṉṟa nūliyum yuṉeskō kūriyar tiṅkaḷitaḻil toṭarntu 1970il puṟṟunōy paṟṟiyum aṭuttu 1972il itaya nōy paṟṟiyum ciṟappitaḻkaḷi tamiḻil veḷiyiṭumpōtu maruttuvattit tamiḻil collumpōtu etirppaṭum iṭarppāṭukaḷ eṉṉeṉṉa eṉpatu pulaṉākiyatu.

maruttuva nūlkaḷ tamiḻil niṟiya veḷivaravēṇṭum eṉap peritum virumpukiṟōm. āṉāl, piṟa moḻikaḷil veḷivarum aḷavukku aṟiviyal, toḻilnuṭpa, maruttuva nūlkaḷ tamiḻil veḷivaruvatilli. itaṟku eṉṉa kāraṇam?

nammiṭiyē aṟiviyal, toḻilnuṭpa, maruttuvat tuṟikaḷil poruḷaṟivum tamiḻaṟivum eḻuttut tiṟaṉum mikkavarkaṭkup pañcamilli. ittuṟikaḷip paṟṟit tamiḻil teḷivākavum tiṭpamākavum viḷakkikkūṟa muṭiyum eṉṟa ārvat tuṭippiṉar palaruṇṭu. avarkaḷ eḻutavum muṉikiṟārkaḷ. appōtu avarkaḷ muyaṟcikkup perum muṭṭukkaṭṭiyāka vantamivatu kaliccoṟkaḷ (Technical terms) ākum. āṅkilak kaliccoṟkaḷukkēṟṟa nērt tamiḻ kaliccoṟkaḷi, eḻuta muṉiyum ellōrālum uriya muṟiyil kalic coṟkaḷi uruvākka iyaluvatilli. ataṟkēṟṟa moḻiyaṟivum ilakkaṇap pulamiyum vērccol aṟivum pōtiya aḷavu illātatāl āṅkilak kaliccoṟkaḷi moḻi peyarppuc ceytum cila camayaṅkaḷil olipeyarppucceytum payaṉpaṭutta vēṇṭiya kaṭṭāyac cūḻnili uṇṭākiṟatu. itaṉāl kaliccol moḻipeyarppu nīḷamākavum poruṭ piṟaḻvuṭiyatākavum amiya nērkiṟatu. peyarppāl pōtiya poruḷviḷakkam peṟa muṭivatilli. itaṉāl coṟceṭṭum poruṭ ceṟivumuṭiya curuṅkiya vaṭivilāṉa kaliccoṟkaḷ uruvāka iyalāmal pōkiṟatu. itaṉ viḷivāka ārvattōṭu eḻuta muṉinta nūlāciriyar oru cila pakkaṅkaḷilēyē maṉaccōrvaṭintu taṉ muyaṟciyi toṭarātu viṭṭuviṭa nērkiṟatu. itaṉi, im muyaṟci yāḷarkaḷ mūlam kēṭkumpōtellām kaliccol iṭarppāṭṭi nīkkiṉāl poruḷaṟivumikka, oraḷavu tamiḻaṟivum eḻuttāṟṟalumuḷḷa ivarkaḷ nūl eḻuta ētuvāka irukkumē eṉṟa eṇṇam eṉṉuḷ aḻuttam peṟum. ataṉ viḷivāka aṟiviyal, toḻilnuṭpa, maruttuvattuṟik kaliccollākka muyaṟciyil muḻu īṭupāṭu koḷḷalāṉēṉ.

nūl eḻutuvōrukkum kaṟpikkum āciriyarkaṭkum paṭippārvalarkaṭkum maṭṭum payaṉpaṭuvatōṭu amiyātu cātāraṇa vācakarkaṭkum payaṉpaṭa vēṇṭum. āṅkilak kaliccollukku nikarāṉa tamiḻk kaliccollum, akkaliccollukku viḷakkamāka oru aṟiviyal ceytiyum paṭippōrkkuk kiṭikka vēṇṭum eṉṟu viḻintēṉ. atiyum paṭa viḷakkattōṭu tantutava vēṇṭum eṉa virumpiṉēṉ. viḷivu kaḷañciyap pōkkil oru putuvaki kaliccol akarātiyi vaṭivamittēṉ.



ipputuvaki 'kaliccol kaḷañciyam' mutal tokuti 'aṟiviyal kaliccol kaḷañciyam' eṉṟa peyaril 1990il veḷivantatu. itē peyaril iraṇṭāvatu tokuti 1993il veḷivantatu. ivaṟṟil 36 aṟiviyal toḻilnuṭpap pirivukaṭkāṉa kaliccoṟkaḷum viḷakkaṅkaḷum iṭampeṟṟaṉa. mūṉṟāvatu tokuti 1995il maruttuva, aṟiviyal toḻilnuṭpak kaliccol kaḷañciya akarāti eṉṟa peyaril veḷivantatu. 68 aṟiviyal toḻilnuṭpa, maruttuvap pirivukaṭkāṉa kalic coṟkaḷiyum viḷakkaṅkaḷiyum koṇṭatāka aḵtu amintatu. innūl aracu, makkaḷiṉ pērātaraviyum peṟṟatu. aṟiviyal tamiḻ ārvalarkaḷum, itaḻkaḷum, nūlāciriyarkaḷum eṉ muyaṟciyip pārāṭṭi ūkkuvittaṉar. ‘aṉantāccāri ḵpeḷaṇṭēṣaṉ āḵp intiyā', muṟpōkku eḻuttāḷar caṅkam, tamiḻnāṭu araciṉ tamiḻ vaḷarccittuṟi pōṉṟa amippukaḷ paricum pārāṭṭum vaḻaṅkic ciṟappittaṉar.

nāṉkāvatu kaḷañciya akarātiyāka ‘maruttuvak kaliccol kaḷañciyam'eṉum nūli veḷiyiṭṭēṉ. piṉṉar aintāvatu tokutiyāka kaṇiṉik kalic coṟkaḷukkāṉa “kaṇiṇik kaliccol kaḷañciya akarāti” eṉum peyaril veḷiyiṭṭēṉ. āṟāvatu tokutiyāka “kaṇiṉi kaḷañciya akarāti" nūli 2001il veḷiyiṭṭēṉ. ēḻāvatu tokutiyāka “kaṇiṉik kaḷañciyap pērakarāti" yi 2002il 1600 pakkaṅkaḷil intiyāvil veḷiyiṭappaṭṭa mutal pērakarātiyāka veḷivantatu. eṭṭāvatu tokuti “maruttuvak kaḷañciyap pērakarāti" nūli itēpōkkil maruttuvaviyaliṉ patiṉintu pirivukaṭkuriya āṅkilak kalic coṟkaḷukku nērt tamiḻk kaliccoṟkaḷum avaṟṟiṟkāṉa poruḷ viḷakkamum paṭaṅkaḷōṭu tayārikkat toṭaṅkiṉēṉ. āṅkilak kalic coṟkaḷi iṉaṅkaṇṭu tērvu ceyvatil eṉ makaṉ ṭākṭar cemmaliṉ paṅku kaṇicamāṉatu. tamiḻk kaliccol uruvākkattilum tamiḻil poruḷ viḷakkam varivatilum naṇpar tiru. irā. naṭarācaṉ, ilakkiya maruttuvar na. kiruṣṇamūrtti, maruttuvar ku. kaṇēcaṉ ākiyōriṉ ottuḻippu kuṟippiṭattakkatākum. nāṅkaḷ evvaḷavutāṉ tiṟampaṭac ceyalpaṭṭālum maruttuvaviyal vallunar eṉṟa muṟiyil 'srī rāmaccantirā' nikarnilip palkalikkaḻakat tuṇivēntarum nīṇṭakālamāka eṉ aṟiviyal tamiḻ vaḷarcci muyaṟcikaḷukkup piṉ tuṇiyāka iruppatil perumakiḻvu koṇṭavarumāṉa pērāciriyar, maṟinta maruttuvar lalitā kāmēsvaraṉ avarkaḷ taṉakkuḷḷa perumpaṇikaḷukkiṭiyēyum varivariyākap paṭittu kuṟi niṟikaḷic cuṭṭikkāṭṭiyum tēviyāṉa māṟṟatiruttaṅkaḷic ceytu nūliṉ oru pakutiyic ceppaṉiṭṭu tantārkaḷ.

'alōpati' eṉṟaḻikkappaṭum āṅkila maruttuvattit tamiḻil tarum muyaṟci 1852-lēyē ḵpiṣkirīṉ eṉum amerikka maruttuvap pērāciriyarāl ilaṅki yāḻppāṇattil mutaṉ mutal toṭaṅki vikkappaṭṭatu. ṭākṭar kaṭṭar āṅkilattil eḻutiya 'Anatomy Physiology and Hygiene' eṉum nūli moḻipeyarttār. tamiḻ nūl eṉa makuṭam tāṅki veḷivanta pōtilum atil iṭam peṟṟa perumpālāṉa coṟkaḷ, kuṟippākak kalic coṟkaḷ tamiḻ eḻuttōṭu kūṭiya camskirutac coṟkaḷēyākum. tamiḻōṭu kalantu atikap puḻakkattiliruntatāl camskiruta moḻic coṟkaḷit tamiḻc coṟkaḷākavē ḵpiṣkirīṉ karutiyatē itaṟkuk kāraṇam

tamiḻil kalik kaḷañciyaṅkaḷ veḷivarat toṭaṅkiya piṉṉar maruttuvam toṭarpāṉa kaṭṭurikaḷi eḻutiya maruttuvattuṟi vallunarkaḷ, kūṭiyavari maruttuvak kaliccoṟkaḷit tamiḻil taruvatil pērārvam kāṭṭiṉar. ceṉṉip palkalikkaḻaka āṅkila-tamiḻ coṟkaḷañciyam uruvāṉapōtu atil maruttuvam toṭarpāṉa āṅkilac coṟkaḷukkut tamiḻilēyē colviḷakkam koṭukkap paṭṭatu. tamiḻnāṭu pāṭanūl niṟuvaṉam kallūrip pāṭa nūlkaḷāka cila maruttuva nūlkaḷi maruttuvarkaḷik koṇṭu eḻutac ceytatu. annūlkaḷ virumpum vakiyil amiya iyalāmaṟpōyiṉum atil iṭampeṟṟa maruttuvak kaliccoṟkaḷ tamiḻilēyē perumpālum amintiruntaṉa. itaṟkuk kāraṇam tamiḻnāṭṭup pāṭanūl niṟuvaṉamē maruttuvak kalic coṟkaḷit tokuttu nūlāciriyarkaṭku vaḻaṅkiyatākum.

tamiḻp palkalikkaḻakam 'aṟiviyal kaḷañciyam' tokutikaḷi veḷiyiṭa muṉintapōtu nalla tamiḻil maruttuvak kaṭṭurikaḷi eḻutac ceytu peṟuvatil peruṅkavaṉam celuttiyatu. maruttuvap pulamiyōṭu tamiḻaṟivumikka ṭākṭar cāmi caṇmukam pōṉṟavarkaḷ aṟiviyal kaḷañciyap patippāciriyar kuḻuvil iṭampeṟṟiruntatāl maruttuvak kaliccoṟkaḷ aḻakāṉa tamiḻc colvaṭivaṅkaḷāka iṭampeṟṟaṉa. appōtiya tuṇivēntar ṭākṭar va.ay. cuppiramaṇiyam avarkaḷiṉ viruppattiṟkēṟpa 'aṟiviyal kaḷañciyam' mutal tokutiyi mēṟpārviyiṭṭu vaṭivamittu accuppativam tayārikkum paṇiyi niṟivēṟṟum vāyppi nāṉ mēṟkoṇṭu, niṟivēṟṟiṉēṉ. avaṟṟuḷ iṭampeṟṟa maruttuvak kalic coṟkaḷ pala aḻaku tamiḻil poruṭceṟivōṭu amintavikaḷākum.

tamiḻil veḷivantu koṇṭirukkum 'kalik katir' tiṅkaḷitaḻil iṭampeṟṟa aṟiviyal kaliccoṟkaḷi yellām pērāciriyar ji.ār. tāmōtaraṉ avarkaḷ tokuttu aṭippaṭi aṟiviyal, 'payaṉuṟa aṟiviyal' eṉṟa peyarkaḷil nūluruvil veḷiyiṭṭār. ivi poruḷaṟivik kāṭṭilum moḻit tiṟattukku mutaṉmi tarupavikaḷāka amintuviṭṭateṉalām. 'yuṉeskō kūriyar' paṉṉāṭṭut tiṅkaḷitaḻil paṉṉūṟu maruttuvak kaṭṭurikaḷ kaṭanta muppattiyintu āṇṭuk kālamāka veḷivantuḷḷaṉa. avaṟṟit tamiḻil veḷiyiṭumpōtu moḻipeyarppāḷarkaḷiṉ utaviyōṭum maruttuva vallunarkaḷiṉ uṟutuṇiyōṭum pala nūṟu maruttuvak kalic coṟkaḷi uruvākkip payaṉpaṭuttum iṉiya vāyppu eṉakkēṟpaṭṭatu.

maruttuvak kaliccoṟkaḷip poṟuttavari kaṭanta kāla muyaṟcikaḷik karuttiṟ koṇṭu 'maruttuvak kaḷañciyap pērakarāti' nūli uruvākkiyuḷḷēṉ. maruttuvattuṟit toṭarpāṉa poruḷaṟivip pukaṭṭuvataṟkāṉa tuṇikkaruviyākattāṉ moḻiyik kiyāṇṭuḷḷēṉ. iyalpilēyē tamiḻ or aṟiviyal moḻiyāka - aṟiviyali nuṇmāṇ nuḻipulattōṭu uṇarttavalla āṟṟalmiku moḻiyāka - amintiruppatāl kaṭiṉamāṉatākap palarum karutum kaliccollākka muyaṟci eḷitāṉatāka amivatāyiṟṟu. tamiḻip pōṟṟat terinta aḷavukku ataṉ aḷappariya āṟṟali aṟintu koḷḷavō uriya muṟiyil payaṉpaṭuttik koḷḷavō muṉiyā malirukkiṟōm eṉpatutāṉ uṇmi. aṟiviyalip poṟutta vari tamiḻiṉ taṉittiṟatti ceyalvaṭivāka ulakumuṉ eṇpikkum vakiyilē eṉ muyaṟcikaḷit toṭarntu koṇṭuḷḷēṉ.

innūlukku mikac ciṟappāṉa aṇinturiyoṉṟi vaḻaṅkiyuḷḷār malēciya intiyar kāṅkiraciṉ tēciyat talivarum malēciyap potuppaṇittuṟi amiccarumāṉa ṭattōsrī cāmivēlu avarkaḷ. kaṭantu muppatu āṇṭukaḷukku mēlāka malēciyavāḻ tamiḻ makkaḷukku maṭṭumallātu ulakat tamiḻar nalaṉ kākkum kāvalarākavum tikaḻntu varupavar ṭattōsrī ca. cāmivēlu avarkaḷ.

tamiḻ, tamiḻar nalaṉi iru kaṇkaḷākak karuti ceyalpaṭum aṉṉār, tamiḻ vaḷarcciyil pērārvamuṭiyavar eṉpatik kaṭanta kāl nūṟṟāṇṭukku mēlāka kaṇṭu varukiṟēṉ. malēciya maṇṇil iru perum ulakat tamiḻ mānāṭukaḷi cīrum, ciṟappumāka naṭattiya perumik kuriya peruntaki. paṉṉāṭṭut tamiḻ iṇiyataḷa mānāṭṭi kōlālampūril ciṟappāka naṭatti paṉṉāṭṭut tamiḻ iṇiyataḷa muyaṟciyil ulakaḷavil tamiḻukku taṉittuva nili kiṭikka vaḻivakuttavar.

'yār?' eṉṟu pārātu 'eṉṉa?' eṉpatil karuttuṉṟic ceyalpaṭum iyalpiṉarāṉa ipperuntaki, tamiḻ vaḷarccikku, tamiḻar nalaṉukku uḻippavarkaṭku tuṇi niṟpatil perumakiḻvum, maṉaniṟivum koḷpavar. ivaratu aṉpālum utavi ottuḻippālum eṉatu 'kaṇiṇi kaḷañciya akarāti' iraṇṭām tokuti veḷivantatu pōṉṟē, im 'maruttuvak kaḷañciyap pērakarātiyum' veḷivarukiṟatu. ivaratu utaviyum, ottuḻippum aṟiviyal tamiḻ vaḷarccikkāṉa māperum untuvici eṉpatu varalāṟṟup pativākum. iṉṉoru vakiyil colla vēṇṭumāṉāl kampaṉukku caṭiyappa vaḷḷal vāyttatu pōl eṉ aṟiviyal tamiḻ vaḷarccip paṇikku ātaravu tarum peruntakiyāka vāyttavar ṭattōsrī ca. cāmivēlu avarkaḷ eṉak kūṟuvatil perumiyaṭikiṟēṉ.

eṉatu kaliccol kaḷañciya akarāti veḷiyīṭṭup paṇikku māperum untuviciyāka iruntu varupavar muttamiḻaṟiñar ṭākṭar kaliñar avarkaḷ. atē pōṉṟu eṉatu aṟiviyal tamiḻp paṇikkut tōṉṟāt tuṇiyāka iruntu varupavar iṉamāṉa pērāciriyar ka. aṉpaḻakaṉār avarkaḷ. avarkaḷ maruttuvak kaliccol kaḷañciyam nūlukku vaḻaṅkiyirunta ciṟappuriyi, annūliṉ virivāka veḷivarum 'maruttuvak kaḷañciyap pērakarātikkum' poruntuvatāl innūlilum ataṉi iṭampeṟac ceytuḷḷatu poruttameṉak karutukiṟēṉ. mēlum, pērāciriyar ṭākṭar lalitā kāmēcuvaraṉ avarkaḷ 'maruttuvak kaliccol kaḷañciyam' nūlukku vaḻaṅkiyirunta 'āyvuri'yiyum annūliṉ virivāka uruvākiyuḷḷa innūlilum iṭampeṟac ceytuḷḷēṉ. ivarkaṭkellām eṉṟeṉṟum naṉṟi celuttak kaṭamip paṭṭuḷḷēṉ.

innūl uruvākkattukku eṉ āruyir naṇpar maṟinta irā. naṭarācaṉār avarkaṭkum, 'maruttuva malar' ciṟappāciriyar ilakkiya maruttuvar na. kiruṣṇamūrtti avarkaṭkum itaḻkaḷ vāyilākavum tam nūlkaḷ mūlamum maruttuva aṟivip parappivarum maruttuvar ku. kaṇēcaṉ avarkaṭkum nāṉ eṉṟum naṉṟik kaṭaṉpaṭṭuḷḷēṉ.

innūl uruvākkattil ellā vakiyilum eṉakkut tōṉṟāt tuṇiyāka iruntuvarum eṉ tuṇiviyār tirumati citti ceḷatā avarkaṭkum, eṉ makaṉ maruttuvar mu. cemmal avarkaṭkum, mikunta poṟumiyōṭu ciṟappāka kaṇiṇiyil oḷiaccup pativam uruvākkit tanta srī piriṇṭ havus tiru. kōpināt avarkaṭkum, tirumati na. laṭcumi avarkaṭkum naṉṟi celuttak kaṭamippaṭṭuḷḷēṉ. avvāṟē mika aḻakiya vaṭivil aṭṭip paṭam vaṭittut tanta cuvāti cāḵpṭ coluṣaṉ niṟuvaṉar tiru. es. makēntirakumār avarkaṭkum aḻakiya muṟiyil acciṭṭa kāris accakattārukkum eṉ naṉṟi urittākum.

eṉatu muntiya paṭippukaḷip pōṉṟē inta akarāti nūliyum tamiḻulakam ēṟṟu ūkkuvikkum eṉpatil eṉakku eppōtum muḻu nampikki uṇṭu.

maṇavi mustapā

nūlāciriyar





nūlāciriyar tiru. maṇavi mustapāvuṭaṉ

malēciya intiyar kāṅkiraciṉ tēciyat talivarum

malēciya araciṉ potup paṇittuṟi amiccarumāṉa

ṭattōsrī ca. cāmivēlu avarkaḷ.





﻿ malēciya intiyar kāṅkiraciṉ tēciyat talivarum malēciyap potuppaṇittuṟi amiccarumāṉa ṭattōsrī ca. cāmivēlu avarkaḷ vaḻaṅkiya

aṇinturi



"yāmaṟinta moḻikaḷilē tamiḻmoḻipōl iṉitāvateṅkum kāṇōm" eṉat tamiḻiṉ iṉimic ciṟappip pukaḻntu pāṭiṉāṉ pārati. 'tamiḻ iṉiya moḻi maṭṭumalla āṟṟalmiku aṟiviyal moḻiyumākum' eṉap pōṟṟip pukaḻvatōṭu amiyātu, tam kaṭum muyaṟciyālum ceyalpāṭukaḷālum kaṭanta ari nūṟṟāṇṭuk kālamāka "tamiḻ or aṟiviyal moḻi" eṉpati veṟum coṟkaḷāl allāmal ceyal vaṭivil kāṇpittu varukiṟār tiru. maṇavi mustapā avarkaḷ

"paḻiyaṉa kaḻitalum putiyaṉa pukutalum

vaḻuvila, kāla vakiyiṉāṉē"



eṉṟa poruḷ potinta paḻampāṭalukkiṇaṅka iṉṟiya kālattiṉ pōkkukkum tēvikkum ēṟpa mutaṉmit tamiḻp paṇiyāka tiru. maṇaviyār tērnteṭuttiruppatu 'aṟiviyal kalic ceyalākkap paṇi' ākum. 1996 il veḷiyiṭappaṭṭa 'maruttuva kaliccol kaḷañciyam' eṉum nūliṉi 48,686 kalic coṟkaḷāka virivākki viḷakkam tantu putiya vaṭivil 1200 pakkaṅkaḷik koṇṭu "maruttuvak kaḷañciyap pērakarāti" uruvākkiyuḷḷār tiru. maṇavi mustapā avarkaḷ.

uruvākkam peṟum kalic coṟkaḷi veṟum paṭṭiyalāka amikkāmal avaṟṟi āṅkilak kalic collukku nērāṉa tamiḻk kaliccol, col viḷakkam, poruḷ viḷakkaṅkaḷi paṭaṅkaḷōṭu, paṭa viḷakkaṅ kaḷōṭum veḷiyiṭuvataṉ mūlam akarātit taṉmiyiyum kaḷañciyap pōkkiyum oruṅkiṇittu 'kaḷañciya akarāti' eṉum putuvaki amippil uruvākkiyiruppatu ellā vakiyilum pārāṭṭattakka putu muyaṟciyākum.



maruttuvam payilāta oruvar oru āṅkila maruttuvak kaliccol mūlam, ataṟku nikarāṉa tamiḻk kaliccol, ataṉ poruḷ viḷakkaṅkaḷip paṭam maṟṟum paṭa viḷakkattōṭu paṭikkumpōtu, accol mūlam maruttuvat takavalkaḷi eḷitāka aṟintu koḷḷa muṭikiṟatu. cāṉṟāka "Pancreas' eṉṟa āṅkilak kalic collukkuk 'kaṇiyam' eṉum tamiḻk kaliccollit taruvatōṭu amiyātu atu itayattiṉ eppakutiyil evvaṭivil amintuḷḷatu maṟṟum evvakip paṇikaḷic ceykiṟatu eṉpatiyum kīḻkkaṇṭavāṟu viḷakkukiṟār.

"Pancreas : kaṇiyam : itu irippiyiṉ arukiluḷḷa cerimāṉattukkuriya nīr curakkum curappi. itu nākku pōṉṟa vaṭivuṭiyatu. itaṉ vāl pakuti maṇṇiralit toṭṭuk koṇṭirukkum. itu cumār 18 ce.mī. nīḷamum cumār 100 kirām eṭiyum uṭiyatu. itil iṉculiṉ eṉṟa iyakku nīrum (hārmōṉ) ciṟukuṭalil koḻuppukaḷiyum purataṅkaḷiyum cīraṇikkakkūṭiya cerimāṉap poruḷkaḷ aṭaṅkiya kaṇiya nīrum curakkiṉṟaṉa." eṉap paṭattōṭu tarum viḷakkam teḷivākavum tiṭpa nuṭpamākavum irukkiṟatu. itē muṟi immaruttuvak 'kaḷañciyap pērakarāti' muḻumiyum kiyāḷappaṭṭuḷḷatu.

malēciyat tamiḻarkaḷāl peritum pukaḻappaṭum tiru. mustapāviṉ tamiḻppaṇi peritum pārāṭṭappaṭa vēṇṭiya oṉṟu. 'cemmoḻi' eṉa tamiḻmoḻiyi aṟivikka avar eṭuttukkoṇṭa muyaṟci, "kūriyar" itaḻ mūlam āṟṟiya tamiḻt toṇṭu aṉivarum pārāṭṭa vēṇṭiya oṉṟākum.

iṉṟiya iṉṟiyamiyāk kālat tēviyi muḻumiyāka niṟivu ceyyum ivaratu aṟiviyal kalic collākkap paṇi nāḷum toṭara vēṇṭum. ataṟkut tuṇiyāyiruppatu nam aṉivariṉ kaṭamiyākum. avar muyaṟci ellā vakiyilum veṟṟipeṟa vāḻttukiṟēṉ.





ca. cāmivēlu





﻿muṉṉuri

⁠tiru. maṇavi mustapā 'maruttuvak kaḷañciyap pērakarāti' eṉṟa innūli vallunarkaḷiṉ utaviyōṭu eḻutiyirukkiṟār. innūl collukkup poruḷtarum akarātiyāka maṭṭumiṉṟi, nūliṉ peyarukkēṟpa viḷakkam tarum kalikkaḷañciyamākavum tikaḻkiṟatu. cāṉṟāka "Viral hemorrhagic fever" eṉpataṟkut tamiḻil kirumik kurutip pōkkuk kāyccal eṉṟu poruḷ taruvatōṭu veppa maṇṭalap pakutikaḷil kocuviṉāl allatu naccu uṇṇikaḷāl paravum kurutip pōkkuk kāyccal eṉṟu viḷakkamum itil tarappaṭṭuḷḷatu. poliomyelitis-eṉpataṟku 'iḷampiḷḷi vātam' eṉpatōṭu mutukut taṇṭiṉ cāmpalniṟa uṭpakutiyil ēṟpaṭum aḻaṟci, muḷit taṇṭilum mutukut taṇṭilum uḷḷa muṉpakkak kompukaḷiṉ iyakka narampaṇukkaḷi oru koḷḷi nōykirumi tākkuvatāl itu uṇṭākiṟatu' eṉṟu viḷakkam tarappaṭṭuḷḷatu.

⁠eṅkum tamiḻ etilum tamiḻ eṉpati veṟum muḻakkamāka maṭṭumiṉṟi ceyaṟpaṭuttum nōkkōṭu tamiḻvaḷarccik keṉṟu taṉiyāka oru amiccari niyamittu, moḻiyiyal, maruttuvam pōṉṟa tuṟikaḷiyum tamiḻil kaṟka muṭiyum eṉpataṟkāṉa paṇikaḷil inta aracu īṭupaṭṭu varukiṟatu. ittakiya paṇikaḷukku maṇavi mustapāviṉ 'maruttuvak kaliccol kaḷañciyam kikoṭukkum.

mu. karuṇāniti

(maruttuvak kaliccol kaḷañciya

akarāti nūl muṉṉuric curukkam)





﻿ ciṟappuri



vaṟumic kuḻalukku āḷāṉa kuṭumpattil piṟantu

peṟṟōr ceytoḻilil tāṉum uḻittavārē,

paḷḷiyil cērntu paṭittiṭat tāṉē valiyac ceṉṟu cērntu,

ōyvu vāytta pōtellām ēṭukaḷ pala payiṉṟu,

iṉam piḷḷiyāyt tanti periyāriṉ pēcciṉik kēṭṭu,

camūkattiṉ mūṭanampikkikaḷi maṟukkum tuṇiveyti,

aṟiñar aṇṇāviṉ uriyiṉik kēṭṭu ūkkaṅkoṇṭu,

paḷḷiyilēyē kaṭṭuri varivatil vallavaṉāki,

piṉṉar pēccāṟṟalum kāṭṭip paricukaḷ pala peṟṟu,

tamiḻaṟiñar palarālum pārāṭṭappaṭṭa māṇava maṇiyāki,

aṇṇāmali palkalik kaḻakam cārntu tamiḻiṉ mutukaliñaṉāki,

tamiḻt toṇṭē vāḻviṉ kuṟikkōḷākak koṇṭu,

vāytta kallūri āciriyar paṇiyiyum ūtiyattiyum tuṟantu

tamiḻ ākkattiṟkē muḻunēram uḻittiṭum uṟuti pūṇṭu,

ēṭukaṭku eḻutuvatiyē vāḻkkit toḻilāka ēṟṟu,

teṉmoḻikaḷ puttaka niṟuvaṉattiṉ paṇiyiṉ cērntu,

aṟiviyal toḻilnuṭpa nūlkaḷum kali ēṭukaḷum veḷivara

mūlanūlic cīrceytu meypput tiruttuvatil tiṟaṉkāṭṭi,

muttiṅkaḷ itaḻāṉa 'puttaka naṇpa'ṉic cīruṟa veḷiyiṭṭu,

yuṉeskōviṉ aṟiviyal pēḻiyām 'kūriyar' ēṭṭiṉ

tamiḻppatippi veḷiyiṭum paṇiyilum paṅkēṟṟut

taṉ matinuṭpam kāṭṭiyum niṟuvaṉattār matippip peṟṟum

poṟuppāciriyarāy uyarntu, kāl nūṟṟāṇṭāka

ataṉ cevilit tāyākac cīrāṭṭi vaḷarttu varupavartāṉ

eṉ naṇpar maṇavi mustapā eṉṉum tamiḻ maṟavar



'kūriyar' ēṭṭiṉit tamiḻil veḷiyiṭum ciṟappiṉi yuṉeskō pārāṭṭiya ceyti kaṇṭu uvanta tamiḻuḷḷaṅ koṇṭa kāyitēmillat ismāyīl cākip vaḻaṅkiya aṉpup pārāṭṭum vāḻttum mustapāviṉ tamiḻt toṇṭiṉi mēlum ūkkuvittatu. avaratu ayarāta aṟiviyal tamiḻt toṇṭiṉi mēlum ūkkuvittatu. avaratu ariyat tamiḻt toṇṭu tamiḻulakiṉ matippip peṟṟatu. tamiḻaka araciṉ kalimāmaṇi virutum, tiru.vi.ka. virutum iṉṉum palavaki pārāṭṭukaḷiyum peṟṟa perumi avarukku uṇṭu. periyāriṉ pakuttaṟivuc cintaṉit tākkam avari mūṭanampikkiyi viraṭṭuvatilum aṟiviyal cintaṉiyi vaḷarppatilum, aṟiñar aṇṇāviṉ koḷkivaḻit tākkam aṟiviyal cintaṉiyit tamiḻil vaḷarppatilum avari muṉintiṭac ceytatu.

avaratu kuṟikkōḷukkuk 'kūriyar' poṟuppu nalvāyppāyiṟṟu. kūriyar vaḷarccikku avaratu toṇṭu nalvāyppāyiṟṟu. inta islāmiyat tamiḻar, tamiḻilum tērcci peṟṟataṉṟi, aṭippaṭi vaṭamoḻip payiṟciyum peṟṟavarāvār. emmoḻip payiṟciyum ettuṟi aṟivum tiṟamiyum ellām entāymoḻi tamiḻiṉ ākkattiṟkē eṉum tiṇmiyar avar. "nāṉ niṟiyap paṭikkiṟēṉ, paṭittavikaḷip paṟṟi āḻac cintikkiṟēṉ. avi eṉ maṉatil appaṭiyē paṭintu viṭukiṉṟaṉa. eḻutumpōtu aviyellām appaṭiyē eṉ eḻuttil patikiṉṟaṉa" eṉṟu taṉ eḻuttut tiṟamiyi aiyuṟṟa āciriyarukku māṇavar mustapā kūṟiya patil "viḷiyum payir muḷiyilē" tanta kāṭci. "viḷinta payir mutirvilē" ataṉ payaṉi ulaku pārāṭṭukiṟatu.

pēccum eḻuttum māntar eṇṇatti veḷiyiṭa ētuvākum taliciṟanta karuvi moḻi. avvakiyil maṉita uṇarvukaḷi, paṇpāṭukaḷi, oḻukka neṟikaḷi, uyar cintaṉiyi veḷiyiṭuvataṟku muḻu āṟṟal peṟṟa niṟimoḻiyāka viḷaṅkuvatē centamiḻ. tamiḻmoḻi pēci vāḻntuvarum makkaḷ nākarika vaḷarcciyum aṟiviyal cārnta muyaṟcikaḷilum mēmpaṭṭu viḷaṅkiya kālam variyil, avar tam moḻiyum ataṟkēṟṟa coṟkaḷiyum kaṇṭu vaḷam peṟṟu vantuḷḷatu. kaṭanta pala nūṟṟāṇṭukaḷākat tamiḻarkaḷiṉ vāḻvil camaya vaḻippaṭṭa cintaṉiyum purāṇak kaṟpaṉiyumē mēmpaṭṭu niṉṟatāl, ulakiyal vāḻvilum aṟiviyal eṇṇa vaḷarcciyilum piṉtaṅki viṭṭaṉarātaliṉ, tamiḻmoḻiyum aṟiviyal tuṟiyil puttākkam peṟum vāyppiḻantatu. āṅkila nāṭṭavar āṭciyiṉ viḷivāka namatu makkaḷ payila nēriṭṭa āṅkilamē mēlnāṭukaḷil viyattaku vaḷarcci peṟṟu vanta aṟiviyal karuttukkaḷi nāmaṟiya vāyttatoru vāyilāka amintatu. nammip poṟuttavariyil 'āṅkilamē' puttulaka aṟiviyal oḷi vaḻaṅkiya palakaṇiyākum.

eḻuttaṟivu peṟāta makkaḷ perumpāṉmiyiṉarāka irunta niliyilum, ēṭṭaṟivi vaḷarttuk koḷḷum ārvam peṟa muṭiyāta vaṟumic cūḻalilum - aṟiviyal karuttukkaḷ, viññāṉa viḷakkaṅkaḷ makkaḷic ceṉṟaṭiyavilli. makkaḷiṉ palavaki mūṭanampikkikaḷ oru vakiyil aṟivu nāṭṭattiṟkut taṭiyāyiṟṟu eṉiṉum, aṟiviyal uṇmi viḷakkaṅkaḷ tāymoḻiyil viḷakkappaṭāmiyē aṭippaṭik kāraṇamākum. kaṭanta aimpatu āṇṭukaḷākap paḷḷi māṇavarkaḷ aṟiviyal cārnta kalviyit tamiḻilēyē payilvataṟku vaḻiceyyum muyaṟciyākap palanūṟu ēṭukaḷ tamiḻil veḷivantuḷḷaṉa. kallūriyil payilum māṇavar kaḷukkāṉa uyarkalvi ēṭukaḷum pala iyaṟṟappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. āyiṉum palkalik kaḻakap paṭṭappaṭippu aṉittiyum tamiḻilēyē payilac ceyyum aḷaviṟkō, māṇavarkaḷē payila muṉvarum aḷaviṟkō palkali aṟiviyaṟ pāṭaṅkaḷ aṉittum tamiḻil veḷivaruvataṟkāṉa muyaṟci toṭara vēṇṭiyuḷḷatu. maruttuvam, poṟiyiyal, uyiriyal, vētiyiyal, iyaṟpiyal, kālnaṭi maruttuvam mutalāṉa tuṟikaḷ palavaṟṟiyum tamiḻil vaḻaṅkac ceyyum nōkkam niṟivēṟa vēṇṭumeṉil mikavum vēkamāka vaḷarntuvarum aṟiviyal āyvuk kaṇṭupiṭippukaḷāl nāḷtōṟum veḷivarum putiya uṇmikaḷiyum nuṇukkaṅkaḷiyum uṭaṉukkuṭaṉ moḻipeyarppuc ceytu tamiḻil araṅkēṟṟum kaṭamiyit toṭarntu niṟivēṟṟa vēṇṭum.

inta nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ tuvakkattil vakippaṭuttap paṭṭirunta aṟiviyal tuṟikaḷ iṉṟu mēlum pala kiḷikaḷāka virivaṭintiruppatu maṭṭumiṉṟi, kaṭanta oru nūṟṟāṇṭil aṟiviyal eytiya vaḷarcci vikitatti inta nūṟṟāṇṭiṉ mutal muppatu āṇṭukaḷilēyē eṭṭi yuḷḷatu. iṉṟō atip pōṉṟu mēlum pala maṭaṅku virivuṭaṉ aṟiviyal vaḷarntu varukiṉṟatu. atu ulakattiṉ pala nāṭukaḷilum (cila moḻikaḷilum) nāḷum uruvākivarum aṟiviyal vaḷarcciyiṉ virivu eṉpatāl, nām anta virivukku īṭukoṭukkum cūḻalilli. eṉiṉum avaṟṟiṉ payaṉi nāmum uṭaṉukkuṭaṉ peṟuvataṟku iṉṟiyamiyāta moḻipeyarpput tiṟaṉi mikap periya aḷavil maṭṭumiṉṟi, virivākac ceytiṭavalla kaṇippoṟip payaṉ pāṭṭiyum mēṟkoṇṭu niṟivēṟṟiṭa muṉiya vēṇṭum. appaṭippaṭṭa vaḻimuṟikaḷ mēṟkoḷḷap paṭṭālaṉṟi, namatu muṉṉēṟṟam maṭṭumaṉṟi, vāḻkki niliyum mēlum piṉṉaṭivukku āḷāki, nām ulakōrāl karutappaṭa vēṇṭātavar āvōm.

itit teḷivāka uṇarntavar tiru.maṇavi mustapā. aṟiviyal karuttit tamiḻil tara muṭiyumā? māṇavarkaḷiṉ aṟiviyal payiṟci moḻiyākum takuti tamiḻukku uṇṭā? iruppiṉum payaṉpaṭumā? eṉṟellām aiyuṟavu eḻuppiyavarkaṭkellām - takunta viṭi aḷittavar avar.

"tamiḻil" entat (aṟiviyal) tuṟic ceytiyiyum, coṟceṭṭōṭum poruṭceṟivōṭum kūṟa muṭiyum, ettakiya aṟiviyalnuṭpak karuttukkaḷiyum, teḷivākavum tiṭpamākavum colla muṭiyum. ēṉeṉil tamiḻ kaṭantakāla moḻi maṭṭumalla; nikaḻkāla moḻiyumākum āṟṟalmikka etirkāla moḻiyumākum. iṉṟu mutal tamiḻil etiyum kūṟa muṭiyum eṉpati veṟum collāl alla; ceyalāl nirūpippatē eṉ vāḻviṉ orē ilaṭciyam, "kuṟikkōḷ" eṉṟu oru mēṭiyil tiru. mustapā kūṟiya uṟutimoḻiyic ceyaṟpaṭuttik kāṭṭavē taṉṉi muḻuvatumāy appaṇikkē oppaṭittuk koṇṭuḷḷavar avar.

entap poruḷ kuṟitta collāyiṉum makkaḷ vaḻakkil iṭampeṟṟu apporuḷik kuṟikkum orē collāka itu nilipeṟuvatip poṟuttē orē collāka amiyalākum.

cikkiḷ - īruruḷi, mitivaṇṭi eṉavum,

piḷacar kār - makiḻuntu, cīruntu eṉavum,

pas - pēruntu, payaṇi untu eṉavum,

ṭireyiṉ - toṭarvaṇṭi - nīrāvi vaṇṭi eṉavum,

ērōpiḷēṉ - vimāṉam, vāṉūrti eṉavum.





vaḻaṅkuvatu pōṉṟa nili iṭikkālattē toṭarvatu iyalpē. malēciyāvilum ciṅkiyilum peṭrōl pampu eṇṇeykkaṭi eṉṟum, ṭipaṉ cāppiṭṭīrkaḷā eṉṟu kēṭkappaṭum kālic ciṟṟuṇavik kuṟikkum vakiyil paciyāṟiyāccā eṉṟum kēṭkiṉṟaṉar. itu vaḻakkāṟṟalāl oru col oru poruḷi uṇarttum tiṟaṉ peṟuvatik kāṭṭum. tamiḻakattil eṇṇeyk kaṭi, uṇavukku vēṇṭiya eṇṇeykaḷi viṟkum iṭattik kuṟikkum. mēlum keraciṉ maṇṇeṇṇi’ eṉṟu vaḻaṅkuvatu pōṉṟu peṭrōlukkum, ṭīcalukkum tamiḻil taṉiccol amiyavilli. avipōṉṟu maruttuvat tuṟi cārnta Dettol; Tincture; Turpentine; Terramycin mutalāṉa coṟkaḷukku īṭākat taṉit tamiḻc col illi. appaṭiyē vaḻaṅkalum poruntum. āṅkilattil iṭampeṟṟa aṟiviyal kaliccoṟkaḷ avi urukkoṇṭa vakiyāl parupporuḷi uṇarttuvatilum, apporuḷiyum, iyalpukaḷiyum viḷivukaḷiyum nuṇukkamākap pulappaṭuttum tiṟamuṭiyaviyātaliṉ, collukkuc col ituvē tamiḻccol eṉak koṇṭu variyaṟuttuk kiyāḷutal moḻipeyarppil eḷitaṉṟu collukkuc col itu eṉṉum nili aṟiviyal kaliccol moḻipeyarppil uruvākiṭa, tamiḻil kiyāḷappaṭak kūṭiya kaliccoṟkaḷip poruḷ variyaṟi ceytu muṟippaṭuttuvatum virivu paṭuttappaṭṭāka vēṇṭum.

A Dictionary of standardised Scientific and Technological terms in Tamil uruvākkappaṭa vēṇṭiyuḷḷatu. appaṇikkum iṉṟiyamiyāta aṭippaṭip paṇiyāka amintiruppatu intak kaḷañciyam ākum. āṅkilac coṟkaḷ pala nām vaḻakkamāka uṇarum poruḷil iruntu caṟṟē vēṟupaṭṭatoru kuṟippiṭṭa poruḷi vaḻaṅkuvatāka maruttuvat tuṟiyil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

Advancement - eṉil māṟukaṇ aṟuvi maruttuvam Affiliation - eṉil (toṭarpuṭi) mūlam kāṇal Antisocial - eṉil maṉanalakkēṭu Aspiration - eṉil uṟiñci iḻuttal Contract - eṉil nōypīṭittal, toṟṟutal Culture - eṉil nuṇṇuyir vaḷarppup paṇṇi Flora - eṉil nuṇṇuyir paṭi eṉavum

vaḻaṅkuvatiyum avipōṉṟa pala coṟkaḷiyum ikkaḷañciyattil kāṇalām. nām aṭikkaṭi payaṉpaṭuttum cila maruttuvaccoṟkaḷiṉ poruḷi nām viḷaṅkik koḷvatilli. appaṭippaṭṭa Angia; Angiogram; Angiography; X-ray; Gamma rays; virus; laser mutalāṉa pala coṟkaḷ kuṟikkum poruḷi intak kaḷañciyam teḷivaṭiyac ceykiṟatu.

aṟiviyal āyvu putiya uṇmikaḷiyum, pala poruḷ āṟṟaliyum payaṉiyum ataṉip payaṉ koḷḷum karuviyiyum kaṇṭupiṭippatāl nāḷtōṟum vaḷarvatu. appaṭik kaṇṭaṟinta mētikku ulakam kaṭamippaṭṭuḷḷatu. eṉavē avar peyarālō, avar cūṭṭa nēriṭṭa peyarākavō avi vaḻaṅkuvatu tamiḻ ākkattiṟkut taṭiyalla. poruḷiṉ peyar maruntu peyar palavum peyarc coṟkaḷēyāvatāl atē peyar tamiḻilum payaṉpaṭuttappaṭuvatu tavaṟalla. āṉāl avaṟṟi evarum etuveṉat teḷivataṟkāṉa viḷakkam tamiḻil tarappaṭuvatē tamiḻukku āṟṟavēṇṭiya aṟiviyal ākkappaṇi yākum. anta ariya paṇiyit tiṟampaṭavum teḷivuṭiyatākavum āṟṟiyuḷḷār tiru. maṇavi mustapā.

tamiḻ maṇṇil toṉṉāḷilēyē vaḷarntu, payaṉpaṭṭu aṇmik kālattil toyvaṭiya nēriṭṭuḷḷatu citta maruttuvam. anta maruttuva muṟiyiyum maruntu ceymuṟikaḷiyum viḷakki eḻunta ceyyuḷ ēṭukaḷ pala. avarkaḷ uṭaṟkūṟṟiṉiyum ataṉ iyakkattiyum, uḷ uṟuppukaḷiyum kuṟittu aṟintu peyariṭṭu vaḻaṅkiyuḷḷaṉar. āṅkilattil iṭampeṟṟa maruttuvak kaliccoṟkaḷ palavaṟṟiṟku īṭāṉa tamiḻc coṟkaḷi nām avaṟṟuḷ kaṇṭaṟiyalākum. citta maruttuvac coṟkaḷ palavum, cila nōykaḷiṉ peyarkaḷum muṉṉarē kikkoḷḷappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. anta vaki muyaṟciyil citta maruttuvak kalviyil paṭṭam peṟṟavarkaḷ īṭupaṭavum, ammuyaṟciyāl maruttuva aṟiviyal taḻikkavum intak kaḷañciyam ēṟṟatoru tuṇiyākum. mēlum "maruttuvam, vētiyiyal, tāvara iyal toṭarpuṭiya aṟiviyal" eṉṉum peyaruṭaṉ aṟiviyal tamiḻc coṟkaḷukkut tamiḻilum āṅkilattilum viḷakkam tarum pērakarāti oṉṟiṉi, aṟivāṟṟalil ciṟanta ṭi.vi. cāmpacivam piḷḷi avarkaḷ ari nūṟṟāṇṭukku muṉṉarē taṉ taṉi muyaṟciyāl uruvākkiyuḷḷati aṟintavar evarum naṉṟiyuṭaṉ pōṟṟat tavaṟār. citta maruttuva nūṟkaḷil tamiḻ vaḻakkilum iṭampeṟṟa peyarkaḷāka anta akaravariciyil kāṇappaṭum coṟkaḷ palavum, ippaṭippaṭṭa maruttuvak kaḷañciyap paṇi virivukkup peritup payaṉpaṭum eṉṟu karutukiṟēṉ.

alōpati maruttuvap paṭṭappaṭippum tamiḻil payiṟṟuvikkappaṭa vēṇṭum eṉṟu virumpuvataṟkāṉa niyāyaṅkaḷ vaḷarntuḷḷa ikkālattil, tērnta maruttuva aṟivāṟṟalit tamiḻil peṟamuṭiyumā? eṉṉum kēḷvi eḻuppum iḷiñar ulakam teḷivaṭintu taṉṉampikki koḷvataṟkum intak kaḷañciyam vaḻiceyyum eṉpatil aiyamilli. aṟiviyal maruttuva nūl eḻutuvārkkum takunta tamiḻ vaḻakki nāṭuvārkkum ēṟṟatoru kiyēṭākavum itu viḷaṅkum.

mēlum viritturikka nāṉ oru maruttuvaṉō aṟiviyal tuṟiyiṉaṉō alla. curuṅkac colvatāṉāl, intak kaḷañciyam maruttuva aṟiviyal tamiḻ ākkattiṟku amikkappaṭṭa putiya pātiyākum. intap pātiyip payaṉpaṭutti naṭappōr palarākiṭiṉ tamiḻil aṟiviyal karuttukkaḷik kiyāḷum tiṟaṉum ataṉi vaḷarkkum ārvamum mēlōṅkum eṉpatu uṟuti

kālamellām tamiḻ ākkap paṇiyil īṭupaṭṭuḷḷa 'kūriyar' āciriyarum, kūriya cintaṉiyāḷarumāṉa itaṉ āciriyar kālam tēṭum tamiḻaṉ maṇavi mustapā avarkaḷi evvaḷavu pārāṭṭiṉum takum avarukku - avaratu toṇṭu toṭara eṉ vāḻttukkaḷ.

ka. aṉpaḻakaṉ

(mēṉāḷ kalviyamiccar,

tamiḻnāṭu aracu)





﻿ āyvuri



tamiḻil pēccu vaḻakkil "orē kallil iraṇṭu māṅkāy" eṉṟu palar kūṟuvatik kēṭṭirukkiṟōm. tiru. maṇavi mustapā avarkaḷ paṭittirukkum inta nūl aṭippaṭiyil oru kaliccol akarātiyāka maṭṭumiṉṟi, maruttuvak kalikkaḷañciyamākavum uruppeṟṟirukkiṟatu. āṉāl, iraṇṭu māṅkāykaḷuṭaṉ āciriyar niṉṟuviṭavilli. mūṉṟāvatu oru māṅkāy viḻuntālum viḻaṭṭumē eṉṟa karuttum maṟivāka miḷirkiṟatu. akarātiyip payaṉpaṭuttuvōr cintaṉikku oru tuṇṭukōlākavum innūl iyaṅka vāyppirukkiṟatu. inta maruttuva akarātik kalikkaḷañciyat tokuppiṉi payaṉpaṭuttuvōr, itil kuṟippiṭappaṭṭirukkum kaliccoṟkaḷi viṭa ciṟanta vēṟu poruttamāṉa coṟkaḷip puṉiya muṉvariṉ mūṉṟāvatu kuṟikkōḷum niṟivuppeṟum.

iṉṟiya maruttuva aṟiviyal coṟkaḷukkellām taṉit tamiḻc coṟkaḷi uruvākki, avikaḷip payaṉ paṭutti, maruttuva nūlākkatti iyakki maruttuvam cārnta kalvi - maṟṟum payiṟci araṅkukaḷ aṉittum tamiḻil vara vēṇṭum eṉṟu kāttiruntōmāṉāl atu aṇmik kālattiṟkuḷ niṟivēṟakkūṭiya kaṉavāka irukkātu.

laṇṭaṉ mānakarattil māli nēra vakuppil cērntu cila kālam "aṟiviyal ruciya moḻi" payiṟci peṟṟēṉ. nāṉ ēṟkeṉavē āṅkilattil paḻakiyirunta pala maruttuvac coṟkaḷ ruciya moḻi aṟiviyal kaṭṭurikaḷil payaṉ paṭuttappaṭuvatip pārttēṉ. āciriyiyāka irunta ruciyap peṇmaṇiyiṭam itupaṟṟip pēciṉēṉ. avarkaḷ coṉṉa karutti ellōrum cintittup pārkka vēṇṭiya avaciyam karuti kīḻē tarukiṟēṉ: "ulakil pala pakutikaḷum oraḷavu nākarikam vaḷarcciyaṭintirunta kālattil karuttup puraṭci, camutāyap puraṭci ivi airōppāk kaṇṭattil tōṉṟi, aṟiviyal vaḷarccikkum ārāyccikkum vittiṭṭaṉa.

palavāṟāṉa ārāyccikaḷ pala nāṭukaḷil mēṟkoḷḷappaṭṭaṉa. pala putiya kaṇṭupiṭippukaḷ ulakukku aṟimukamāyiṉa. iṅkilāntu, airōppā, amerikkā maṟṟum jappāṉ pōṉṟa nāṭukaḷil pala ārāyccikaḷ naṭipeṟṟu, putiya kaṇṭupiṭippukaḷ toṭarpāṉa āyvuk kaṭṭurikaḷ pala aṟiviyal cañcikikaḷil piracurikkappaṭṭu, ulakukku aṟimukamāyiṉa. ivikaḷi āṅkilac col eṉṟō, jermāṉiyac col eṉṟō, jappāṉiyac col eṉṟō colliviṭa muṭiyātu. ovvoru putiya kaṇṭu piṭippiyum yār mutalil ulakukku vaḻaṅkukiṟārkaḷō avarkaḷ avikaḷi viḷakka uruvākkiya coṟkaḷi ulakam ēṟṟuk koḷḷa vēṇṭum. kaṇṭupiṭippukkaḷukku eppaṭi avarkaḷic contakkārarkaḷ eṉṟu colkiṟōmō atip pōlavē avarkaḷ uruvākkiya coṟkaḷum avarkaḷuṭiya paṭippukkaḷē. antac coṟkaḷi aṟiviyal makkaḷ camutāyam - ulakap potuc coṟkaḷākat tāṉ karuta vēṇṭum" eṉpatē anta ammiyār tanta viḷakkam. inta muṟiyil "viras", "lēcar", "peṉiciliṉ", "mārḵpiṉ" pōṉṟa pala coṟkaḷi nām appaṭiyē payaṉpaṭuttiṉālumkūṭa oru aṟiviyal maruttuvak kaḷañciyattil anta coṟkaḷ uruvākiya aṭippaṭi varalāṟṟiyum kuṟippiṭṭu eḻutumpōtutāṉ ataṉ poruḷum viḷakkamum muḻumiyākak kiṭikka vāyppu ēṟpaṭum.

cōtaṉik kuḻāy, puti cākkaṭi, kaṭṭi, karappāṉ, puṟṟu, kācam, īḷi, irumal pōṉṟa pala coṟkaḷ ēṟkeṉavē tamiḻ vaḻakkil irukkiṉṟaṉa. ippaṭi ēṟkaṉavē vaḻakkil irukkum coṟkaḷi iṉṟum aṟiviyal karuttukkaḷi eṭuttiyampumpōtu payaṉpaṭuttukiṟōm. ivi tavira, muṉ paḻakkattil iruntu, maṟintu pōṉa cila tamiḻ aṟiviyal coṟkaḷik kaṇṭupiṭittu maṟupaṭiyum avaṟṟiṟkup puttuyirūṭṭi paḻakkattiṟkuk koṇṭu varavēṇṭum. tiru. maṇavi mustapā avarkaḷ inta muyaṟciyil kaṇicamāṉa aḷavu veṟṟiyaṭintirukkiṟārkaḷ eṉṟē colla vēṇṭum. "Slough" eṉṟāl "porukku", "Desquamation" eṉṟāl "cetiḷutirvu" eṉṟu mikat teḷivāka viḷaṅkum vakiyil coṟkaḷip payaṉpaṭuttum muṟiyic cuṭṭiyirukkiṟārkaḷ.

itu tavira paḻiya citta maruttuva nūlkaḷil uṭaluṟuppukaḷiyum nōy vaki maruttuva muṟikaḷ pōṉṟavaṟṟic cuṭṭuvataṟkum pala coṟkaḷ payaṉ paṭuttappaṭṭirukka vēṇṭum. nāṭi, narampu, nāḷam, nōy eṉṟu pala coṟkaḷi nām eṭuttāḷkiṟōm. atip pōlavē iṉṉum pala coṟkaḷ irukkak kūṭum. citta maruttuvarkaḷum, tamiḻaṟiñarkaḷum kūṭṭākac cērntu oru tamiḻ-āṅkila (citta) maruttuva akarātiyit tayārittāl atu namakkup perum payaṉaḷikkum. maṟinta tamiḻ maruttuva aṟiviyal coṟkaḷit terintu koḷḷa muṭiyum.

āṅkila maruttuvac coṟkaḷ eppaṭi uruvākkappaṭṭaṉa eṉṟu aṟiyumpōtu cila coṟkaḷ kāraṇap peyarkaḷāka irukkak kāṇkiṟōm. atē kāraṇaṅkaḷukku īṭāṉa tamiḻc coṟkaḷik kaṇṭupiṭittu avaṟṟil iruntu putut tamiḻ maruttuvac coṟkaḷi uruvākkum vaḻiyum kaṭippiṭikkappaṭṭu, appaṭi cila nalla coṟkaḷ namakkuk kiṭittirukkiṉṟaṉa. "Thyroid" eṉpataṟku kēṭayac curappi eṉṟum "Adrenal" eṉpataṟku aṇṇīrakac curappi eṉṟum coṟkaḷ uruvākkappaṭṭu avi tamiḻil paḻakkattil vantuviṭṭaṉa. ivikaḷi ellām kūṭiyavari āciriyar akarātikkuḷ iṇittirukkiṟār.



nāṭṭuppuṟa makkaḷ cila camayaṅkaḷil paṭṭaṟivu aṭippaṭiyil avarkaḷākavē cila coṟkaḷi uruvākki viṭuvārkaḷ. malēriyā kāyccali 'muṟik kāyccal' eṉṟum tūrattup pārviyi 'veḷḷi muttu' eṉṟum 'wrist' eṉpataṟku maṇikkaṭṭu eṉṟum tamiḻc camutāyam ēṟkaṉavē uruvākkiviṭṭa coṟkaḷiyum nām taḷḷi viṭa muṭiyātu. avikaḷi nammuṭiya coṟkaḷañciya tokuppukaḷil cērkkattāṉ vēṇṭum.

āṅkilam maṟṟum airōppiya moḻikaḷil pala putuc coṟkaḷi uruvākka vēṇṭiya cūḻnili ēṟpaṭum pōtu kirēkkam maṟṟum lattīṉ moḻiyil toṭarpuṭiya poruḷ tarum coṟkaḷil vērc coṟkaḷi ārāyntu eṭuttu avaṟṟil iruntu putuc coṟkaḷi uruvākki yirukkiṟārkaḷ. mārḵpiṉ (morphine) eṉṉum maruntu tūkkatti uṇṭākkum. kirēkkap purāṇattil kaṉavukku (dreams) poṟuppāṉa kaṭavuḷ mārḵpiyā. ataṉāl inta maruntu kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭavuṭaṉ ataṟku mārḵpiṉ eṉṟu peyar cūṭṭiṉar. atik kaṇṭupiṭitta vētiyal nipuṇar, appaṭippaṭṭa coṟkaḷ aṉittiyum kāraṇac collukku īṭāṉa tamiḻc colliyum ataṉ vērc colliyum kaṇṭupiṭittu atiliruntu putiya tamiḻc colli uruvākkalām eṉṟu niṉittōmāṉāl atu muṭivē illāta paṇiyākiviṭum. appaṭippaṭṭa pala coṟkaḷi nām appaṭiyē tamiḻil eḻuti payaṉpaṭuttik koḷḷa vēṇṭiya cūḻniliyiltāṉ irukkiṟōm. vēṟu putuc coṟkaḷi uruvākka muṭiyāta ittaku cūḻnilikaḷil iṉṟu āṅkilattil irukkum coṟkaḷi eṭuttut tēvikkēṟṟapaṭi pakuti, vikuti māṟṟaṅkaḷi maṭṭum ceytukoṇṭu, tamiḻp paḻakkattiṟku avikaḷi koṇṭu varalām eṉṟu, nām uṇarum vakiyil tiru. maṇavi mustapā avarkaḷ pala coṟkaḷi kaliccol akarātik kaḷañciyattil cērttiruppatu pārāṭṭutaṟkuriyatu.



inta akarāti kaḷañciyat tokuppip payaṉpaṭuttuvatil pala ariya vāyppukaḷum cintaṉikaḷum uruvāka vaḻiyuṇṭu.

1. tamiḻil maruttuva nūlkaḷ eḻuta vēṇṭum eṉṟu niṉippōr poruttamāṉa tamiḻ maruttuvak kalic coṟkaḷit tēṭi pala akarātikaḷi vittuk koṇṭu nēram aṉittum vīṇākāmal inta nūli arukil vittuk koṇṭu virivākak karuttukkaḷukku uriya eḻuttu vaṭivam koṭukkamuṭiyum.

cātāraṇa akarātikaḷip pōl tamiḻil āṅkilac collukku nērccol maṭṭum tantu poṟuppi muṭittu viṭāmal, ataṉ poruḷ viḷakkattiyum curukkamākat tantirukkiṟār āciriyar. maruttuvat tamiḻc collit terintu koḷvatuṭaṉ cātāraṇa makkaḷ aṟiviyal ceytikaḷiyum terintu koḷḷap payaṉpaṭum vakiyil tokuttirukkiṟār. e.kā. "Version" eṉṟa collukku 'nili tiruppam' eṉṟu maṭṭum colli niṟuttiviṭāmal, "makappēṟṟu maruttuvattil kuḻanti eḷitāka veḷivarum poruṭṭu karuppikkuḷ kuḻanti kiṭakkum niliyi māṟṟi talippākam mutalil veḷiyēṟumāṟu ceytal" eṉṟu viḷakkam tantirukkum pāṅku makkaḷ eḷitil terintukoṇṭu poruḷuṭaṉ, ceytiyiyum uṇarntu koḷḷa oru karuviyāy amikiṟatu. innūl ippaṭi āciriyar viḷakki iruppatāl etirkālattil cila nalla viḷivukaḷi etirpārkkalām. ippaṭi tarappaṭṭirukkum pala viḷakkaṅkaḷi paṭikkum yārukkāvatu itiviṭa ciṟappāṉa oru tamiḻc colli uruvākkakkūṭiya kaṟpaṉi tōṉṟumpōtu tamiḻukkup putuc coṟkaḷ cērum; tamiḻ vaḷam peṟum.

2. akarātiyip payaṉpaṭuttumpōtu atil tarap peṟṟirukkum col poruttamāṉatāka illi eṉṟu oruvarukkut tōṉṟiṉālum irukkum coṟkaḷil ciṟu māṟṟaṅkaḷ ceytu valimi tantu, colli ēṟṟam peṟac ceyyavum vāyppirukkiṟatu.

3. muḻuvatumākavē oru col poruttamaṟṟatu eṉṟu atit taḷḷiviṭṭu ciṟanta oru putuccolli uruvākka oru cilarāvatu muyalvar. ataṉālum tamiḻukku vaḷam cērum.

enta vakiyil pārttālum itip pārāṭṭuvōr toṇṭālum, kuṟikūṟuvōr muyaṟciyālum iṟutiyil mēlum pala putiya coṟkaḷ uruvākit tamiḻ vaḷara vāyppākum eṉṟa oru kāraṇattiṟkākavē āciriyarip pārāṭṭak kaṭamippaṭṭirukkiṟōm.

paḻiya ilakkiyat tamiḻ, iṉṟiya paḻaku tamiḻ-ivi paṟṟiyē cintittuk koṇṭiruppōrukkiṭiyē, putiya tamiḻ, nāḷiyat tamiḻ, aṟiviyal tamiḻ eṉṟellām cintippōrum cilar irukkiṟārkaḷ. avarkaḷil tiru. maṇavi mustapā avarkaḷi mutaṉmiyāṉavarākat tikaḻkiṟār eṉat tayakkamiṉṟic collalām.

maruttuvac coṟkaḷi tiṭpanuṭpattuṭaṉ tamiḻil colla muṭiyum eṉak kāṭṭiyiruppatuṭaṉ, coṟ ceṭṭuṭaṉ poruṭceṟivum orucēra avaṟṟuṭaṉ ilakkiya merukum ēṟṟi cuvipaṭa aṟiviyal ceytikaḷit tamiḻil collalām eṉpataṟku innūl oru eṭuttukkāṭṭu. moḻikku maṭṭum mutaṉmi tarāmal maruttuvap poruḷaṟivi viḷakkavalla tuṇik karuviyāka moḻiyik kiyāḷum pāṅkāl, maruttuvac ceytikaḷi āṟṟaluṭaṉ āciriyarāl viḷakka muṭikiṟatu. itaṟkākat tavirkka muṭiyāta iṭaṅkaḷil āciriyar taṉit tamiḻ pōkkiṉik kūṭa naḻuva viṭavēṇṭiya nili uruvākiṟatu.

maruttuvap palkalik kaḻakaṅkaḷum vallunar kuḻuvum ceyalpaṭṭu uruvākkappaṭa vēṇṭiya oru kalic col tokuppu nūli' taṉiyoruvarāka muyaṉṟu, pārāṭṭattakka muṟiyil niṟivēṟṟiyiruppatu tamiḻar aṉivarkkum makiḻcci tarakkūṭiyatu. tuṟi vallunarkaḷ kūṭa avaravar tuṟikaḷiltāṉ cintaṉiyāḷarākat tikaḻa muṭiyum. āṉāl pala maruttuvap pirivukaḷukkum uriya kaliccollākkaṅkaḷi kaṇṭiruppataṉmūlam im muyaṟciyil tiru. maṇavi mustapā avarkaḷ tamiḻaṟivuṭaṉ maruttuva aṟiviyum evvaḷavu āḻntu nuṇukik kaṟṟut tērvupeṟṟuḷḷār eṉpatu aṉivariyum viyakka vikkum.

āṅkilattil ivvakiyāṉa akarāti-kaḷañciya nūlkaḷ pala iruppiṉum intiya moḻikaḷuḷ ituvē mutalāvatāṉa muyaṟciyāy irukkakkūṭum eṉṟu nampukiṟēṉ. oru col mūlam, oru maruttuvac ceytiyik kūṟuvataṉ mūlam cātāraṇap paṭippaṟivu uḷḷavarkaḷum maruttuva aṟivu peṟavum aṟivip perukkik koḷḷavum tuṇi ceyvatākum.

innūliṉ kuṟippiṭattakka maṟṟoru ciṟappamcam pala iṭaṅkaḷil teḷivāṉa paṭaṅkaḷiyum, paṭa viḷakkaṅkaḷiyum koṇṭamintiruppatākum. ellā vakiyilum nūl ciṟappāka amiya vēṇṭum eṉṉum āciriyariṉ vēṭkiyi itu pulappaṭuttukiṟatu. innūlvaḻi mēlum toṭarntu vaḷam peṟṟu avar vaḻiyil iṉṉum palar maruttuvat tamiḻ nūlkaḷi iyaṟṟit tamiḻ moḻi ēṟṟatti virivil eyta vēṇṭum eṉpatē aṉivariṉ āvalākavum irukkum. avar muyaṟciyum avarāl tūṇṭappaṭṭu mēlum palar ceyyappōkum muyaṟcikaḷum veṟṟi peṟa vēṇṭi vāḻttuvōm.

pērāciriyar ṭākṭar lalitā kāmēcuvaraṉ

(mēṉāḷ tuṇivēntar,

srīrāmaccantirā nikarnilip palkalikkaḻakam)





vāḻtturi



"nēṟṟu, iṉṟu, nāḷi; naṭappavi, naṭakka vēṇṭiyavi aṉittiyum kavaṉittu toṭarcciyāka, tēviyāṉa muṟiyiltāṉ tamiḻ vaḷarcciyaṭiya vēṇṭum.

palvēṟu tamiḻk kaviñarkaḷālum tamiḻ vallunarkaḷālum iṉṟiya tamiḻ maṇakkiṟatu. paḻaṅkālat tamiḻ maṇam maṭṭum pōtātu. putiya maṇamum vēṇṭum. kālattiṟkēṟṟa karuttukkaḷ aṉittum tamiḻil eṭuttukkūṟum uṇmiyit tamiḻ vaḷara vēṇṭum. vēkamāka muṉṉēṟivarum putupputu eṇṇaṅkaḷ, karuttukkaḷ yāviyum eḻuttil vaṭittut taruvataṟkut tamiḻāl muṭiyum eṉṟa aḷaviṟku tamiḻ vaḷarntāltāṉ tamiḻ vaḷarcci aṭintiruppatākak koḷḷa muṭiyum. eṉavē, tamiḻnāṭṭil ittakiya caktiyum ārvamum koṇṭa palvēṟu tamiḻ mētikaḷ tōṉṟa vēṇṭum.

ellām tamiḻāl muṭiyum eṉṟa nilitāṉ tamiḻiṉ vaḷarcci, tamiḻaṉiṉ vaḷarcci. tamiḻnāṭṭiṉ vaḷarcci eṉpati nām ellōrum uṇaravēṇṭum. atē eṇṇam nam tamiḻ perumakkaḷiṭiyē evvaḷavukkevvaḷavu āḻamāka uṟutiyākap patikiṉṟatō atē aḷavukku tamiḻnāṭu ellā vakiyilum ciṟakkum, maṇakkum eṉṟa nampikki eṉakku irukkiṟatu.

tamiḻakam taḻittōṅka tamiḻāl muṭiyum eṉṟa anta nampikki ellōriṭattilum vaḷara vēṇṭum eṉpatē eṉatu viruppam vēṇṭukōḷ" eṉa 25-1-62 il veḷiyiṭṭa "tamiḻāl muṭiyum" eṉṟa nūlil kuṟippiṭṭiruntēṉ.

kaṭanta 35 āṇṭukaḷil pala tamiḻaṉparkaḷ nāṉ aṉṟu kaṇṭa kaṉavi naṉavākka muyaṟci eṭuttu cilar veṟṟiyum kaṇṭuḷḷaṉar. avarkaḷil mutaṉmi peṟṟu viḷaṅkupavar tiru. maṇavi mustapā avarkaḷ. pala nuṇṇiya navīṉa karuttukkaḷiyum tamiḻil kūṟa muṭiyum eṉpati nirūpittu varukiṟār. itaṉ mūlamākap putiya tamiḻp pataṅkaḷiyum uruvākkit tamiḻiṉ vaḷattip perukki varukiṟār tiru. maṇavi mustapā.

itōṭu tiruptiyaṭiyāmal tamiḻil aṟiviyal, toḻilnuṭpa nūlkaḷi palar eḻutuvataṟku utavum muṟiyil pala kaliccol kaḷañciyaṅkaḷip perumuyaṟciyuṭaṉ ciṟanta muṟiyil veḷiyiṭṭu varukiṟār. taṟpōtu maruttuvak kaḷañciya akarātiyi veḷiyiṭṭuḷḷār. ikkaḷañciya akarāti tamiḻil pala maruttuva nūlkaḷ veḷivara utavum eṉa nampukiṟēṉ.

tiru. maṇavi mustapā avarkaṭku eṉatu nalvāḻttukkaḷ.





ci. cuppiramaṇiyam

(maruttuvak kaliccol

kaḷañciya akarāti

nūl vāḻtturi)





﻿ kāṇikki



eṉ vakupput tōḻarum eṉṉi muḻumiyākap purintu koṇṭu eṉ muyaṟcikaḷuk kellām tōḷ koṭuttu vantavarum eṉ kaṭanta kāla vāḻviyum muyaṟcikaḷiyum nūl vaṭivil pativu ceytavarumāṉa arumi naṇpar irā. naṭarācaṉār avarkaḷiṉ eṉṟeṉṟumāṉa iṉiya niṉivukkum, eṉatu aṟiviyal tamiḻp paṇiyi kāl nūṟṟāṇṭukkum mēlāka iṭiyaṟātu ūkkivantavarum eṉ maruttuvak kaliccol maṟṟum viḷakkaṅkaḷi eḻutteṇṇip paṭittu āyvuri vaḻaṅkiya maṟinta maruttuvap pērāciriyi ṭākṭar lalitā kāmēsvaraṉ avarkaḷiṉ eṉṟeṉṟumāṉa iṉiya niṉivukkum innūli kāṇikki ākkukiṟēṉ.





nūlāciriyar





﻿abacterial : nuṇṇuyirilā; nuṇṇuyiraṟṟa, pākṭīriyā cārā vīkkam: pākṭīriyāviṉāl uṇṭākāta, kuṟukiyakāla vīkkattiṟkāṉa cūḻniliyik kuṟikkum col.

abalienation : maṉakkuḻappam .

abandon : taṅkutaṭiyilā maṉappāṉmi; kavaliyilā maṉanili; utaṟittaḷḷu.

abandoning: kiviṭal,kinekiḻttal.

abarognosis:: cumi uṇarviṉmi; eṭi uṇarviṉmi; paḷu uṇarviṉmi, eṭi uṇarviḻappu: paḷu uḷḷati uṇara iyalāmi.

abarthrosis: aciyum mūṭṭu : uṭaliluḷḷa elumpu mūṭṭukaḷil acikiṉṟa mūṭṭuvaki.

abasia : naṭakka iyalāmi; naṭakkāmi narampukaḷiṉ otticivu iṉmiyāl naṭakka iyalāta nilimi.

abate : tāḻttu, taṇi, kuṟi: taḷḷupaṭicey; vilakkivi; valuviḻakkaccey; maṭṭuppaṭuttu kaṭṭuppaṭuttu.

abatement : kaṭṭuppaṭuttal kuṟittal, taṇittal.

abattar dissement : kuṟippiṭṭa uyirvarkkam illāmalātal abattoir : aṭitoṭṭi; vilaṅku veṭṭukaḷam; iṟicci veṭṭutoṭṭi.

aleattoir sanitation :vilaṅku veṭṭukaḷat tūymi; aṭitoṭṭit tuppuravu.

ABC: ēpici varici muṟi: toṭarnikaḻvu muṟi: itaya nuriyīral iyakka mīṭpiṉ pōtu pātikkappaṭṭavariṉ kāṟṟup pāti (cuvācap pāti), cuvāca nili maṟṟum itaya iratta oṭṭa iyakkam pōṉṟavaṟṟic cīrākka utavum uyir kākkum toṭar nikaḻvukaḷ.

abdomen: aṭivayiṟu;akaṭu; utaram : neñcuk kūṭtaṭitta eḻuttukkaḷṭiṉi aṭuttuk kīḻē uḷḷa mikapperiya uṭal uṭkaḻivu. itaṉi īralukkum kuṭalukkum naṭuvēyuḷḷa iṭiyīṭṭuc cavvut tiriyāṉatu neñcuk kūṭṭiliruntu pirikkiṟatu. itu perumpālum taciyiṉālum, tacinār cūḻnta tacippaṭṭiyālum cūḻappaṭṭuḷḷatu. eṉavē, itu taṉatu vaṭiva aḷaviyum vaṭivaabdominalttiyum māṟṟik koḷḷum taṉmi uṭiyatākum. itu, aṭivayiṟṟu uṭpakutiyic cūḻntuḷḷa nīraṭaṅkiya iraṭṭic cavvup pi (vapi) mūlam uḷvariyiṭappaṭṭuḷḷatu.

muṉippāṉa aṭivayiṟu irukku māyiṉ ataṉi uṭaṉaṭiyāka aṟuvi maruttuvam mūlam cīrpaṭutta vēṇṭum.

toṅkalāṉa aṭi vayiṟu irukkumāyiṉ, ataṉ muṉ puṟaccuvar caṟṟut taḷarcciyāka amintirukkum. itaṉāl, atu pūppu meṉmikku mēlē toṅkik koṇṭu irukkum.

paṭaku vaṭiva aṭivayiṟu muṉ puṟaccuvar uṭkuḻivuṭiyatākum.

adrenal : aṇṇirakam; kuṇṭikkāy aḻutta curapi; kuṇṭikkāy aḻutta; ciṟunīraka mēvi : (1) ciṟunīrakattiṟku arukil; (2) aṇṇirakac curappi.

aṇṇirakap puṟaṇi : aṇṇirakac curappiyiṉ veḷippakuti. itu aṇṇiraka akaṇiyuṭaṉ toṭarpuṭiyatu. miṉaralō ﻿kārṭṭi kāyṭs maṟṟum kuḷukkō kārṭṭi kāyṭs iyakku nīrkaḷic curakkiṉṟatu.

aṇṇīraka ikkaṭṭu : aṇṇīrakac karappu nīrkaḷ kuṟivatāl uṇṭākiṉṟa uṭalnalak kōḷāṟu. itu tiṭīreṉat tuvaṅkum. nōyt toṟṟu ēṟpaṭum. nōyāḷikaḷi kaṭumiyākap pātikkum.

aṇṇirakac curappi ; ciṟunīrakattiṉ ucciyil oru toppiyi kaviḻttāṟpōṉṟu amintirukkum oru mukkōṇa vaṭivac curappi. muṉ mūḷiyaṭic curappiyiliruntu curakkappaṭum ē.ci.ṭi.ec kiḷarmat tūṇṭalāl itu kārṭṭivil maṟṟum āṇmiyūkki (āṉṭrōjaṉs) iyakku nīrkaḷic curakkiṟatu.

aṇṇiraka akaṇi : aṇṇirakac karappiyiṉ uṭpakuti. aṭrīṉaliṉ maṟṟum nār aṭrīṉaliṉ iyakkunīrkaḷic curakkiṟatu. aṭrīṉaliṉ (aṇṇir) ālpā, pīṭṭā ēṟpāṉkaḷuṭaṉ iṇintu viṉipuriyum. ālpā ēṟpāṉkaḷ uḷḷa uṟuppukaḷiṉ tacinārkaḷ aṭrīṉaliṉ iyakkattāl curuṅkum pīṭṭā ēṟpāṉkaḷ uḷḷa uṟupput tacinārkaḷ viriyum. aṭrīṉaliṉ mikutiyākac curakkappaṭumpōtu iratta aḻuttam atikarikkum. nār aṭrīṉaliṉ uṭal muḻuvatilum uḷḷa taci nārkaḷic curuṅkac ceyyum. itaṉ mikic curappālum iratta aḻuttam atikarikkum. nāṭittuṭippu atikarikkum. itayattiṉ iyakkavēkam mikum.

adrenal function tests : aṇṇirakac curappic cōtaṉi : kuṇṭikkāyc curappiyiṉ puṟappakuti iyalpukku mīṟutalākac ceyaṟpaṭuvatik kaṇṭaṟivataṟkāṉa oru cōtaṉi. itil niṇanīr curakkum aḷaviṉik kaṇakkiṭuvataṉ mūlam itu kaṇṭaṟiyappaṭukiṟatu.

adrenalectomy : aṇṇīrakac curappi aṟuvi maruttuvam : kaṭṭi ēṟpaṭṭuḷḷa oru kuṇṭikkāyc curappiyi akaṟṟuvataṟkāṉa aṟuvi maruttuvam. kuṇṭikkāyc curappikaḷ iraṇṭiyumē akaṟṟiviṭṭāl, uṭcurappu iyakkunīrkaḷi (hārmōṉkaḷ) uṭceluttutal vēṇṭum.

adrenal hormone : aṇṇīraka iyakkunīr.

adrenaline : aṇṇirakac curappu nīr : pālūṭṭikaḷil kuṇṭikkāyc curappiyiliruntu ūṟum iyakkunīr (hārmōṉ). inta ﻿nīr uṭali pōrāṭuvataṟku (allatu) tappippataṟkut tayār ceykiṟatu. inta iyakkunīric ceyaṟki muṟiyilum tayārikkālam. puṟat tūṇṭutalāl uyirmam muḻutum etiriyaṅkuṟuvatil, inta nīr pāṉamāka uṭkoḷḷappaṭukiṟatu. niṇa nīruciyāl uṇṭākum koppuḷak kāyccal, mūccut taṭiyuṭaṉ kūṭiya īḷi nōy (āstmā), kāñ coṟit taṭippu pōṉṟa ovvāmi nōykaḷukku ūci mūlam itu celuttappaṭukiṟatu. uṟuppelli uṇarvu nīkkak karicalkaḷil, viravip paravuvatik kuṟippataṟkākavum, uṇarviḻappu niliyi nīṭippataṟkākavum itu cērkkappaṭukiṟatu. iratta oṭṭac cīrkulivu nilikaḷil, mikavum nīrtta karicalāka (1 : 1,00,000) metu, metuvāka narampu mūlam celuttap paṭukiṟatu.

adrenal glands : aṇṇīrakac curappi : ivi ciṟunīrakatti aṭuttuḷḷa curappikaḷ, intac curappiyiṉ uṭpakutiyāṉa uṭkaruviliruntu ūṟum 'aṭriṉalīṉ' eṉappaṭum curappu nīr irattattil pāyntu, tiṭīr accam allatu kōpattiṉpōtu virivāṉa itayattuṭippu, veṟutta mukam pōṉṟa viḷivukaḷi uṇṭākkukiṟatu. intac curappiyiṉ puṟappakuti uḷḷuṟuppu māṟutalkaḷi uṇṭākkukiṟatu. paṟavikaḷilum mīṉkaḷilumuḷḷa intac curappikaḷ muṟṟilum vēṟāṉavi.

adrenogenital syndrome : uṭcurappuk kōḷāṟu; aṇṇīrakap pāluṟuppu nōyt tokuppu : kuṇṭikkāyc curappiṉ puṟap pakutiyiṉ iyalpukku mīṟiya naṭavaṭikkiyiṉ viḷivākap piṟaviyilēyē tōṉṟum oru vaki uṭcurappuk kōḷāṟu. itaṉāl oru peṇ kuḻantiyiṭam virivaṭinta makaḷir kantum, utaṭṭu itaḻkaḷ iṇintum kāṇappaṭalām. appōtu antak kuḻantiyi āṇ eṉṟu tavaṟākak karuta iṭam ēṟpaṭum. āṇ kuḻantiyiṭam veḷippaṭiyāṉa mayirum, virivaṭinta āṇ kuṟiyum kāṇappaṭum. āṇ peṇ kuḻantikaḷ iraṇṭilum virivāṉa vaḷarcciyum, tiṇṇiya tacip paṟṟum mikunta elumpu mutircciyum kāṇappaṭum.

alum : paṭikkāram : poṭṭāciyam allatu ammōṉiya alumiṉiya calḵpēṭ. itaṉ iṟukacceyyum taṉmi kāraṇamāka, vāykoppaḷikkum tirava mākavum (1%) naccupporuḷi veḷiyēṟṟa pīṟṟuk kuḻaliṉ tāriyākavum (0.5%) payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

aluminium hydroxide : alumiṉiyam hiṭrākciṭu : vayiṟṟup puḷippakaṟṟum maruntu; puḷippu māṟṟumaruntu; puḷipput taṉmikku etirīṭāṉatu. irippippuṇṇik kuṇappaṭuttu vataṟkup payaṉ paṭuttumpōtu nīṇṭa nāṭkaḷ viṉi purikiṟatu. itu perumpālum meṉmiyāṉa pālēṭu allatu kūḻvaṭivil irukkum.

aluminium paste : alumiṉiyam kaḷimpu : alumiyattuḷ, tuttanāka ākciṭu, tivak kaṉ meḻuku (pāraḵpiṉ) ākiyavi kalanta oru kaḷimpu. itu tōl kāppu maruntākap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu. itaṉi 'pālṭṭimār kaḷimpu' eṉṟum kūṟuvar.

alupent : aluppeṉṭ : 'ārcipraṉaliṉ' calḵpēṭ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikappeyar.

alveolus : kaṇṇaṟi. alveolar capillary block syndrome : nuriyīral kaṇṇaṟit tantuki aṭippu nōy : nōyk kāraṇam kaṇṭaṟiyappaṭāta or ariya nōy. itil nuriyīral kaṇṇaṟi uyiraṇukkaḷ paruttuviṭuvataṉ kāraṇamāka ākcijaṉ paravutal naṭi peṟāmal muccaṭippu, tōl nīlaniṟamātal, valatu itayam ceyaliḻattal pōṉṟa kōḷāṟukaḷ uṇṭākiṉṟaṉa.

alveolitis : nuriyīral kaṇṇaṟi vīkkam : nuriyīral kaṇṇaṟi kaḷil vīkkam ēṟpaṭutal. pūntātu (makarantam) pōṉṟa or ayaṟ poruḷic cuvācippatāl itu uṇṭākiṟatu. itaṉi 'ayaṟporuḷ ovvāmi turiyīral kaṇṇaṟi vīkkam' eṉpar.

alveolus : mūccuc ciṟṟaṟi; kaṇṇaṟi : 1. nuriyīraluḷḷa kāṟṟuk kaṇṇaṟikaḷ 2. pallukku ātaravākavuḷḷa pal poruntu kuḻi.

alzheimer's disease : alji mar nōy : mūḷit taḷarcciyiṉāl aṟivu kuḻampi ēṟpaṭum pittiyam.

amalgam : ulōkap pūccu; iracakkalavi (iracakkaṭṭu); māḻip pūccu : pātaracamum ētēṉum maṟṟoru ulōkamum cērnta kalavi. 'pal iracak kalavi' eṉpatu, pal kuḻiyi nirappuvataṟkup payaṉpaṭum ōr iracak kalavi. itil pātaracam, veḷḷi, veḷḷiyam (ṭiṉ) kalantuḷḷaṉa.

amantadine : amaṉṭṭāṭiṉ : nōykkirumi etirppu maruntu. itu nōyk kirumiyāl uṇṭākum hāṅkāṅ caḷik kāyccal (iṉḵpuḷuveṉcā), cuvācakkōḷāṟukaḷ pōṉṟavaṟṟil nōyiṉ kālanīṭciyik kuṟikkiṟatu.

pārkkiṉcaṉ nōyil naṭukkat tiyum, viṟippiyum kuṟippataṟkup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

amastia : mārpakamiṉmi; muliyiṉmi; mukiyiṉmi : piṟavi yilēyē mārpakaṅkaḷ (muli) illātiruttal.

amurosia : oḷiyiṉmi; pārvi aṟṟa.

amurosis : kuruṭṭut taṉmi; pārviyiṉmi; oḷiyiṉmi : pārvi narampuk kōḷāṟu kāraṇamāka uṇṭākum ōraḷavu allatu muḻumiyāṉa kuruṭṭut taṉmi.

amurotic : kuruṭṭut taṉmi uṭiyar : kaṇṇiṉ puṟa uṟuppuc cariyāka iruntum allatu kaṇṇiṉ puṟattōṟṟattiṉāl māṟutal tōṉṟātiruntum muḻuk kuruṭāka iruppatu. ambidexterity : oruppōl irukit tiṟaṉ : irukikaḷiyum orē vitamākat tiṟampaṭap payaṉpaṭuttum tiṟaṉ.

ambidextrous : oruppōl iru kip paḻakkam; iru kic camaṉ tiṟaṉ; iru ki nikariya : iru kikaḷiyum orē vakiyākat tiṟampaṭap payaṉpaṭuttak kūṭiya.

ambiguous : aiyamuḷḷa; aiyuṟavāṉa.

ambilhar : ampilkār : 'niriṭācōl' eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

ambivalence : irumaṉappōkku; viruppum veṟuppum : oruvariṭam orē camayattil etirmāṟāṉa irumuka uṇarccip pōkku iruttal. (e-ṭu) aṉpu, pakimi.

amblyopia : pārvi mantam; maṅku pārvi : kuruṭṭut taṉmiyiṉ aḷavukkup pārvi mantamāka iruttal. itaṉi 'puki piṭippōr kuruṭu" eṉṟum kūṟuvar.

ambu bag : uyirmūccup pi : ceyaṟki cuvācam aḷikka utavum irapparāl āṉa pi. oṉṟiliruntu oṉṟariliṭṭar koḷḷaḷavu koṇṭatu. tāṉē kāṟṟi nirappik koḷḷum vitattil taṭukkitaḻ amiyap peṟṟuḷḷatu.

ambulance : nōyāḷi ūrti (āmpulaṉs : nōyāḷikaḷi maruttuvamaṉikku eṭuttuc celvataṟkāṉa ūrti. iyaṅku maruntakam. iyaṅku maruntakamāka irukkiṟa ūrti.

ambulant : iṭappeyarvu.

ambulatory : ūrti maruttuvam : nōyaḷikaḷ irukkum iṭaṅ kaḷukku nōyāḷi ūrtiyil ceṉṟu, nōyāḷikaḷukkuc cikicciyaḷittu avarkaḷiṉ muṉṉēṟṟam kuṟittu maruttuva maṉiyiṉ puṟanōyāḷar tuṟikaḷukkut terivittal.

amelia : uṟuppuk kuṟipāṭu; piṟavi ūmi; aṅkamiṉmi : piṟaviyilēyē uṟuppu allatu uṟuppukaḷ illātiruttal. atu 'muḻu uṟuppuk kuṟipāṭu' eṉappaṭum.

amelification : paṟcippi uruvākum muṟi.

amelioration : nōyk kaṭumi kuṟippu; nōyt taṇivu; nōyk kuṟivu : nōyk kuṟikaḷiṉ kaṭumiyik kuṟittal.

amenorrhoea : mātaviṭāy tōṉṟāmi; mātavilakkiṉmi; tīṭṭu niṟuttam; pōkku niṟuttam; tīṭṭu māṟuki : mātaviṭāy tōṉṟātiruttal; mātaviṭāy tōṉṟa vēṇṭiya nērattil tōṉṟātiruntāl atu 'toṭakka nili mātaviṭāy tōṉṟāmi" eṉappaṭum. mātaviṭāy oru muṟi toṭaṅkiya piṟaku tōṉṟāmal iruntāl, atu "iraṇṭāmnili mātaviṭāy tōṉṟāmi" eṉappaṭum.

ament : vaḷarcci kuṉṟiya maṉattiyuṭiya.

amentia : maṉavaḷarccik kuṟi pāṭu; uḷakkuḻappam; mūḷit tiṟaṉiḻappu : piṟaviyiliruntu maṉavaḷarcci kuṉṟiyiruttal, maṉattaḷarcciyiṉāl ēṟpaṭum pittiya niliyiliruntu (Dementia) itu vēṟupaṭṭatu.

amethocine hydrochloride : amettōkkiṉ hiṭrō kuḷōriṭu : kōkkiṉ eṉṟa maruntup poruḷil cila paṇpukaḷiyuṭiya oru ceyaṟkip poruḷ. taṇṭuvaṭa uṇarcci iḻappu maruntākap payaṉpaṭu kiṟatu. 60 mi.ki. aḷavuṭiya māttirikaḷāka itu payaṉ paṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

ametria : karuppi iṉmi : piṟaviyilēyē karuppi illātiruttal.

ametropia : pārvik kuṟipāṭu; kuṟipārvi : kaṇṇiṉ oḷikkōṭṭa āṟṟal kuṟipāṭṭiṉāl uṇṭākum pārvik kuṟipāṭu.

amicar : amikkār : amiṉō kāprāyk amilattiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

amidin : māccattuk karical : karical niliyiluḷḷa māccattu.

amikacin : amikkāciṉ : pākṭīriyac cerimāṉap poruḷkaḷ (eṉcimkaḷ) taraṅkuṟi vatit taṭukkum oru nōy etirppupporuḷ. itu 'kaṉāmiciṉ poruḷiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum ceyaṟki vaḻip poruḷ.

amiken : amikkeṉ : amikkāciṉ eṉṉum etirppup poruḷiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

amimia : ceyal uṇarviḻappu; ceyki āṟṟaliḻappu.

amino acids : karima amilaṅkaḷ (amiṉō amilaṅkaḷ) : oṉṟu allatu ataṟku mēṟpaṭṭa hiṭrajaṉ aṇukkaḷukku patilāka karima (amiṉō) aṇukkaḷik koṇṭa karima amilaṅkaḷ (NH2) puratatti nīriyal pakuppu ceyvataṉ viḷivāka ivi kiṭikkiṉṟaṉa. ivaṟṟiliruntu uṭal taṉatu contap purataṅkaḷi maṟupaṭiyum tayārittuk koḷkiṟatu. ivi aṉittiyum uṭal uṟpatti ceytukoḷḷa muṭiyātu. eṉavē ivi uṇavil iṉṟiyamiyātu cērkkappaṭavēṇṭum ārkiṉiṉ, hisṭiṭiṉ, aicōliyūciṉ, liyūciṉ, liciṉ, mettiyō ṉiṉ, ḵpiṉilālaṉiṉ, tiriyōṉiṉ, ṭiripṭōḵpāṉ, vāliṉ ākiyavi iṉṟiyamiyā karima amilaṅkaḷ. eñciyavi avaciyamaṟṟa karima amilaṅkaḷ eṉa vakip paṭuttappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa.

aminoacidemia : amiṉō amila mikippu : irattattil amiṉō amilaṅkaḷiṉ aḷavu mikutal.

aminoaciduria : karima amila nōy; amiṉō amilac ciṟunīr : ciṟunīril karimaamilam (amiṉō amilam) iyalpu aḷavukku mēl iruppatāl uṇṭākum nōy. itu vaḷarciti māṟṟattil uḷḷārnta tavaṟu iruppatik kāṭṭukiṟatu.

aminobenzoate : peṉcōvēṭ : pērā amiṉō peṉcāyik amilattiliruntu tayārikkappaṭum oruvaki uppu.

aminobutane : nōy taṇikkum maruntu vaki.

aminocaproic acid : amiṉō kāprāyk amilam : kaṭṭiyāka uṟiyakkūṭiya nāriyal kacivu ūṉir (ḵpipriṉ) cīrkulivatit taṭuppataṉ mūlam nēraṭiyākak kurutippōkkiṉi niṟuttum viṉiyip purikiṟatu. itu piḷāsmiṉōjaṉ viṉi ūkkikaḷiṉ ceyalit taṭi ceykiṟatu.

aminocrine : amiṉōkriṉ : akkiḵpḷēviṉ pōṉṟa, kaṟippaṭuttāta oru nōy nuṇma (kirumi) oḻippup poruḷ.

aminoglutethimide : amiṉō kuḷuṭṭittimiṭ : iyakkunīri (hārmōṉ) cārnta puṟṟu nōykaḷil aṇṇīrakac curappiyiliruntu ūṟum iyakkunīri niṟuttuvataṟkup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum oru maruntu.

aminoglycoside : amiṉō kuḷukkōciṭu : sṭrepṭōmicis kirumikaḷiliruntu tayārikkappaṭum nuṇṇuyirk kolli kuṭumpam. (e.ṭu) sṭrepṭōmiciṉ, jeṉṭāmiciṉ, neṭṭilmiciṉ, amikkaciṉ, niyōmiciṉ.

aminophylline : amiṉō ḵpiliṉ : ettiliṉ ṭayāmiṉ kalanta tiyōḵpiliṉ. itu tiyōḵpiliṉiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum oruvaḻip poruḷ; kariyak kūṭiyatu. īḷinōy (āsttumā) kurutiyiṉ aṭartti mikutiyiṉāl ēṟpaṭum māraṭippu. neñcuppi iḻima aḻaṟci ākiya nōykaḷik kuṇappaṭuttap payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṟatu. aminoplex : amiṉō pḷaks : narampuvaḻi uṭceluttuvataṟku ukanta oru ceyaṟkit tayārippu maruntupporuḷ. cātāraṇamākap puratamāka uṭceluttappaṭum karima amilaṅkaḷi (amiṉō amilaṅkaḷ) itu koṇṭu irukkiṟatu. itu kāyaṅkaḷik kaḻuvik kuṇappaṭuttap payaṉ paṭukiṟatu.

aminopterin : amiṉōpṭeriṉ : ḵpōlik amila etirppi.

aminoquinoline : amiṉō kuyiṉōliṉ : kuyiṉōliṉ maruntuṭaṉ amiṉō vaki maruntik kalantu tayārikkappaṭum maruntu vaki. itu 4 amiṉō kuyiṉōliṉ eṉavum 8 amiṉō kuyiṉōliṉ eṉavum iru vakippaṭum. malēriyā kāyccalukkuriya maruntu itu.

amino-salicylic acid : amiṉō-cālicilik amilam : kāca nōyi (elumpurukki nōy-ṭi.pi.) kuṇappaṭuttuvataṟku vāyvaḻi koṭukkappaṭum oru pākṭīriyā etirppu maruntu.

aminosol : amiṉōcōl : karima amilaṅkaḷil (amiṉō ami laṅkaḷ) oru karical. itu, kuḷukkōs, ḵpirakṭōs, etil ālkahāl ākiya aṭaṅkiya tayārippukaḷākak kiṭikkiṟatu. itaṉi vāy vaḻiyākavō narampu vaḻiyākavō celuttalām

amitosis : uyiraṇup pakuppu; uyiraṇuppiḷavu; ticup perukka miṉmi : or uyiraṇu, nēraṭip piḷappu mūlam pakutikaḷākap pirivuṟutal.

amitotic : piḷavupperukkamilā.

aminotransferase : amiṉō ṭirāṉsḵperēs.

aminodarone : amiṉōṭārōṉ.

aminotriptyline : amiṉōṭripṭiliṉ : mūccaḻaṟciyuṭiya vali taṇippu maruntu, itu imiprāmiṉ maruntiṉip pōṉṟatu. itil oruvaki nōvāṟṟum viḷivu uṇṭu. itu kuḻappattuṭaṉ kūṭiya maṉattaḷarcciyiṉpōtu mikavum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

ammonia : navaccāra āvi (ammōṉiyā) : niṭrajaṉum hiṭrajaṉum iṇintu iyaṟkiyākak kiṭikkum oru kūṭṭupporuḷ. maṉitarkaḷiṭam navaccāra vaḷarciti māṟṟattil uḷḷārntu ēṟpaṭum palvēṟu piḻipāṭukaḷ kāraṇamāka maṉa vaḷarccik kuṟipāṭu, narampuk kōḷāṟukaḷ, vāta caṉṉi pōṉṟa tiṭīr nōyppīṭippukaḷ uṇṭākiṉṟaṉa. navaccāra āvik karical niṟamaṟṟa tiravam, kāra neṭiyuṭiyatu; itu ciṟunīrc cōtaṉiyil payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṟatu.

ammonium bicarbonate : ammōṉiyam pikārpaṉēṭ : irumal maruntukaḷil kapatti veḷikkoṇarum maruntākap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu. aritāka vayiṟṟu manta nōyāḷikaḷukku vayiṟṟu uppucam akaṟṟukiṟa maruntākak koṭukkappaṭukiṟatu.

ammonium chloride : ammōṉiyam kuḷōriṭu : ciṟunīrk kōḷāṟukaḷil ciṟunīril amilat taṉmiyi atikarippataṟku itu payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu. aritāka kapam veḷikkoṇarum maruntākavum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

ammonuria : ammōṉiyā mikic ciṟunīr : ciṟunīril ammōṉiyāk kūṟu mikiyāka iruttal.

amnesia : maṟati nōy (niṉiviḻappu); maṟati : maṉat taḷarcci yiṉāl ēṟpaṭum maṉanōy nili. icivu nōyiṉpōtu atirccikkup piṉpu niṉivāṟṟal muḻuvatumāka iḻantu viṭutal. oru vipattiṟkup piṟaku aṇmi nikaḻccikaḷ maṟantu pōkumāṉāl atu "muṉṉōkkiya maṟati" eṉappaṭum; kaṭantakāla nikaḻccikaḷ maṟantu pōkumāṉāl atu "piṉṉōkkiya maṟati” eṉappaṭum.

aminocentesis : karuccavvut tuḷippuc cōtaṉi : aṭi vayiṟṟuc cavviṉ vaḻiyākak karuvi aṭuttuc cuṟṟiyuḷḷa cavvuk kuḻiyiṉit tuḷittal. kuḻanti piṟappataṟku muṉṉar iṉakkīṟṟuk kōḷāṟukaḷ, vaḷarciti māṟṟap piḻi pāṭukaḷ, mutirkaruk kuruti nōykaḷ uḷḷaṉavā eṉṟu kaṇṭupiṭikkum cōtaṉikkākat tirava mātiriyi eṭuppa taṟkāka ivvāṟu ceyyappaṭukiṟatu.

aminography : karuccavvuppi ūṭukatirppaṭam ; paṉikkuṭa varivi : karuvi aṭuttuc cuṟṟiyuḷḷa cavvup piyiṉuḷ oḷi ūṭuruvāta ūṭuporuḷi ūci mūlam celuttiyapiṉ, antac cavvup piyiṉi ūṭu katir (eksrē) oḷippaṭam eṭuttal. itil koppūḻk koṭiyum, naccuk koṭiyum pativākum.

amnion : karuccavvup pi ; paṉik kuṭa uṟi : kuḻanti piṟappataṟku muṉ karuvi aṭuttuc cuṟṟiyuḷḷa cavvup pi. itil mutirkaruvum, karuppit tiravamum irukkum. itu koppūḻkkoṭiyip pōrttiyirukkum; itu mutirkaruvuṭaṉ koppūḻk kuḻiyil iṇikkappaṭṭirukkum.

amnionitis : karuccavvup pi vīkkam : paṉikkuṭa aḻaṟci.

amnioscopy : karunōkkuk karuvi paṉikkuṭa nōkki : aṭi vayiṟṟuc cuvariṉ vaḻiyākac celuttik karuviyum, karuppit tiravattiyum pārppataṟku utavum oru karuvi, karuppit tiravam mañcaḷāka allatu pacciyāka iruntāl, atil apiṉik amilam kalantu iruppatik kuṟikkum. itu karuviṉ nōy kaṇṭiruppatik kāṭṭuvatākum.

amniotic cavity : karuccavvukkuḻi : kuḻanti piṟappataṟku muṉ karuvi aṭuttuc cuṟṟiyuḷḷa cavvukkum, toṭakka niliyil uḷḷa (mutirāta) karumuḷikkum iṭiyiluḷḷa tiravam nirampiya kuḻivu.

amniotic fluid : karuppit tiravam ; paṉikkuṭa pāymam : kuḻanti karuppiyilirukkum kālam muḻuvatum, karuppic cavvum, mutirkaru uṟpatti ceyyum oru tiravam, itu mutirkaruvukkup pōrvi pōl iruntu pātukāppu aḷikkiṟatu. intat tiravam, tīviramāka vētiyiyal parimāṟṟaṅkaḷ naṭipeṟum oru ūṭu poruḷākum. itaṉik karuc cavvuk kuḻiyic cuṟṟiyuḷḷa uyiraṇukkaḷ curantu, mīṇṭum īrttuk koḷkiṉṟaṉa.

amniotomy : karuppi piḷavu uṟuttal : mutirkaruc cavvukaḷic ceyaṟki muṟiyil piḷavuṟuttutal. piḷḷippēṟṟu valiyi virivu paṭuttuvataṟkāka ivvāṟu ceyyappaṭukiṟatu.

amnioebiform : vayiṟṟuṭali vaṭivamuḷḷa.

amobarbital : amōpārpiṭṭāl : itu oru tūkkamaruntu cila maṇi nēraṅkaḷukku maṭṭum payaṉaḷippatu.

amodiaquine : amōṭiyākkuyiṉ : malēriyā kāyccalukkut tarappaṭum oru vaki maruntu. aḻaṟci etirppu maruntākavum ceyalpaṭum.

amoeba : amīpā ōraṇuvuyir); nekiḻi : orē aṇuvuṭaṉ uyir vāḻum uyiriṉam; vayiṟṟuvali. itil, orē aṇuvē, uṇavu uṭ koḷḷutal, kaḻivupporuḷi veḷiyēṟṟutal, cuvācittal, iṭam peyartal ākiya aṉittup paṇikaḷiyum ceykiṟatu. itu taṉṉit tāṉē piḷavupaṭutti koṇṭu iṉapperukkam ceykiṟatu. itil oru vakiyāṉa "eṉṭāmīpā" eṉṟa nuṇṇuyir maṉitariṭam vayiṟṟu aḷiccal (cītapēti) uṇṭākkukiṟatu.

anethine : aṉittiṉ : 'amittōkkiṉ' eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

aneurine : narappūṭṭac cattu (aṉiriṉ); ciṟunīriṉmi : cattuk kuṟipāṭṭāl narampukaḷ cīr keṭātapaṭi taṭukkum oruvaki ūṭṭam. tiyāmiṉ allatu viṭṭamiṉ B ūṭṭaccattiṉ paḻiya peyar.

aneurysm : kurutināḷa aḻaṟci : kuruti nāḷam (tamaṉi) iyaṟki mīṟi vīṅkiyiruttal. tamaṉic cuvaril ēṟpaṭum taḷarvu palavīṉam kāraṇamāka itu uṇṭākiṟatu.

angiectomy : iratta nāḷa veṭṭu : iratta nāḷatti akaṟṟal, iratta nāḷatti nīkkum muṟi.

angiectasis : kuruti nāḷa aḻaṟci; kurutik kuḻāy taḷarcci : iratta nāḷaṅkaḷ iyalpukku mīṟi virivaṭintiruttal.

angiectopia :iratta nāḷap pātip piṟaḻcci; kuruti nāḷam amippup piṟaḻcci kuruti; oru iratta nāḷam iyalpilā iṭattil iruppatu allatu iyalpilā pātiyil amintiruppatu.

angina : toṇṭi aṭippu; itayavali; neñcuvali : iṭatu mārpu vētaṉitarum itayanōy kāraṇamāka ēṟpaṭum muccaṭippu allatu tacic curukka uṇarvu. taṟkālikamāka neñcuppi vali ēṟpaṭum. intat taṟkālika vali, kikaḷukkum paravalām. muṉippu uṭaṟpayiṟciyiṉāl inta tākkutal tuāṇṭappaṭukiṟatu.

angina of effort : iyakka neñcu vali; iyakka nerippu.

anginapectoria : iṭatu mārpu (vētaṉi tarum) itayanōy.

angina pectoris : itayak kuttal; iṭatu mārpu vali : itayattiṟku irattam vaḻaṅkum kuruti nāḷam kuṟukalāvataṉ kāraṇamāka iṭatu mārpu vētaṉitarum kaṭum itayavali.

angloblast : iratta nāḷakkōḷam : iratta nāḷam uruvāvataṟku uṟutuṇi ceyyum or uṭalaṇu.

angiocarditis : itaya iratta nāḷa aḻaṟci : itayamum atic cārnta iratta nāḷaṅkaḷum aḻaṟci ēṟpaṭutal.

angiogenesis : karuvil iratta nāḷam uruvāvatu.

angiocardiography : itaya iyakkam kāṭṭum karuvi : oḷi ūṭuruvāta ōr ūṭuporuḷi ūci mūlam celuttiya piṉpu itaya aṟikaḷiyum, peruṅkuruti nāḷaṅkaḷiyum kaṇ kūṭākak kāṭṭum karuvi.

angiogenic : (1) iratta nāḷam uruvāvatu toṭarpāṉa. 2 iratta nāḷam uruviṭam.

angiogram ; angiography : itaya aḻuttap pativu; kuḻal variviyal : itaya aḻuttattip pativu ceyvataṟkāṉa oru paricōtaṉi muṟi. itayattil naṭattappaṭum ipparicōtaṉi mūlam enta vitamāṉa itayac cikicciyaḷikka vēṇṭum eṉpati aṟintu koḷḷa muṭikiṟatu. oru ciṟiya kuḻāyi (Catheter) tuṭiyiṉ mutaṉmit tamaṉi allatu mūccuk kuḻāyt tamaṉi vaḻiyē celutti ataṉ mūlam itaya iyakkattip pativu ceykiṟārkaḷ. oru taṉivakit tiravam tamaṉiyiṉuḷ celuttap paṭṭu, mukkiyap pakutikaḷ ārāyappaṭṭu uṭaṉukkuṭaṉ paṭamum eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. itu muṭintatum antak kuḻāy eṭukkappaṭṭu aṅkē nērāṉa aḻuttam mūlam 15-30 nimiṭam vari kurutikkacivi niṟuttuvataṟkāka aḻuttappaṭa vēṇṭum. intap paricōtaṉi muṭinta aṉṟē kūṭa vīṭṭukku ceṉṟu viṭalām. intap paricōtaṉi ceytu koḷvataṟku muṉpu kaṭipiṭikka vēṇṭiya mūṉṟu iṉṟiyamiyāta nipantaṉikaḷ: 1. paricōtaṉikku muntiya nāḷ iravukkumēl etiyum cāppiṭavō kuṭikkavō kūṭātu. 2. kāliyil pal tēykkalām; vāy kaḻuvalām. āṉāl, taṇṇīr uḷḷē cellāmal pārttuk koḷḷavēṇṭum, 3. paricōtaṉi muṭintu uṭaṉē vākaṉaṅkaḷi oṭṭakkūṭātu. amerikkāvil antap paricōtaṉiyi 'vaṭivakkuḻāy' itaya aḻutta aḷavīṭu (Cardiac Cathetereization) eṉkiṉṟaṉar.

angioid : iratta nāḷaṅkaḷi yotta.

angioma : kurutik kaṭṭi iratta nāḷaṅkaḷil ēṟpaṭum irattak kaṭṭi.

angiology : kuruti nāḷaviyal; uṭaṟ kuḻāyiyal; kuḻaliyal : kurutināḷaṅkaḷ, ūṉīr nāḷaṅkaḷ paṟṟi ārāyum aṟiviyal.

angitis : nāḷavīkkam : iratta nāḷam allatu niṇanīr nāḷam vīṅkiyiruttal.

angioma : kuruti nāḷak kaṭṭi : iratta nāḷaṅkaḷil ēṟpaṭum irattak kaṭṭu.

angiooedema : kuruti nāḷaḻaṟci : itu oru kaṭumiyāṉa kāñcoṟi namiccal nōy, ovvāmiyāl mukam, kikaḷ piṟappuṟuppukaḷ ākiyavaṟṟiṉ tacikaḷ, vāy, toṇṭi ākiyavaṟṟiṉ caḷic cavvukaḷil uṇṭākiṟatu. kural vaḷiyil ēṟpaṭum aḻaṟciyiṉāl maraṇam nēriṭalām. kuralvaḷi aḻaṟciyiṉāl uṭaṉaṭiyāka nāḷaṅka ḷiliruntu ūṉīr aṇṭit ticukkaḷukkuḷ ūṭuruvic celkiṟatu. vīkkamum ēṟpaṭukiṟatu.

angioplasty : kurutināḷa oṭṭaṟuvi maruttuvam; kurutik kuḻāyc cīramippu; kuḻal amippu : iratta nāḷaṅkaḷil iḻima aṟuvi maruttuvam ceytal.

angiosarcoma : kurutināḷap puṟṟuk kaṭṭi; kurutik kuḻāyp puṟṟu; kuḻal catip puṟṟu : iratta nāḷaṅkaḷil uṇṭākum ukkirat taṉmivāynta kaṭṭi.

angiospasm : kurutināḷa icipput tacic curukkam; kuḻāy icivu : kuruti nāḷaṅkaḷil ēṟpaṭum kaṭumiyāṉa tacic curippu nōy.

anhidrosis : viyarvik kuṟi nōy; viyarviyiṉmi : viyarvi pōtiya aḷavil karakkātatāl uṇṭākum nōy.

anhydrous : nīriṉmi nōy; varaṇṭa nōy; nīraṟṟa nīrillā; nīril :uṭalil nīr aṭiyōṭu illātu pōtal.

anicteric : mañcaṭ kāmāliyiṉmi; mañcaḷ niṟamiṉmi : mañcaṭkāmālik kōḷāṟu illātiruttal.

anileridine : aṉilariṭiṉ : apiṉi pōṉṟa paṇpukaḷ koṇṭa oru ceyaṟki maruntu.

anilitin : mutumit taḷarcci; kiḻattaṉam.

aniridia : viḻittirik kōḷāṟu; viḻic curukkat taciyiṉmi; tiriyiṉmi : kaṇṇil viḻittiri illātiruttal allatu kuṟipāṭuṭiyatāka iruttal. itu perumpālum piṟavilēyē ēṟpaṭum kōḷāṟu.

anischuria : ciṟunīr oḻukku; ciṟunīr aṭakka iyalāmi; ciṟunīr kaṭṭaṟṟa oḻukku : ciṟunīri aṭakka iyalā vaṇṇam kaṭṭaṟṟa muṟiyil oḻukik koṇṭiruppatu.

anisocoria : camaṉilāk kaṇmaṇi; oḻuṅkaṟṟa kaṇ pārvi : iru kaṇmaṇikaḷiṉ viṭṭam ēṟṟat tāḻvuṭaṉ iruttal.

anisocytosis : camaṉilāc civappaṇukkaḷ; camaṉilā celliyam; aṇuc cīriṉmi : irattac civappaṇukkaḷ vaṭivaḷavil ēṟṟat tāḻvuṭaṉ iruttal.

anisocoria : cīrilāmaṉi.

anisomelia : camaṉilā uṟuppukaḷ : uṭal uṟuppukaḷ camaccīrāṉa nīḷattil illātiruttal.

anisometropia : kaṇṉoḷik kōṭṭa māṟupāṭu; camaṉilā pārvi vīkkam; otta pārviyiṉmi : iru kaṇkaḷiṉ oḷik kōṭṭamum māṟupaṭṭiruttal.

ankle : kaṇukkāl.

ankle clonus : kaṇukkāl tacit tuṭippu; kaṇukkāl utaṟal : uḷḷaṅkālil aḻuttam atikarippataṉ kāraṇam pātam piṉ puṟamāka vaḷikiṟapōtu piṉ kāl tacip pakuti virivāka māṟi māṟic curukkamum taḷarvumākat tuṭittal.

ankylurethria : ciṟunīr vaṭikuḻāy aṭippu; ciṟunīr vaṭikuḻāy kuṟukkam : ciṟunīr vaṭikuḻāy aṭippu allatu ciṟunīr vaṭikuḻāy kuṟuki yiruppatu.

ankyloblepharon : kaṇṇimi iṇivu oṭṭiya imi : kaṇ imikaḷiṉ viḷimpukaḷ iyaṟkikku māṟāka oṭṭik koṇṭiruttal.

ankylosis : mūṭṭu viṟippu : nōy kāraṇamāka oru mūṭṭu viṟittu viṭutal.

ankyloglossia : paṭinā.

anky lostomasis : kokkip puḻuppāṭu.

annular : mūṭṭu iṇipput taci nār; vaḷiya uru :mōtiram pōṉṟa vaḷiya vaṭivuṭiya taci nār. maṇik kaṭṭu, kaṇukkāl mūṭṭukaḷ uḷḷatu pōṉṟa nīṇṭa elumpukaḷi itu piṇikkiṟatu.

anodyne : nōyāṟṟum maruntu (aṉōṭiṉ) valiyakaṟṟi; vali nīkki : valimi nīkkum oruvaki maruntu.

anogenital : kutam-piṟappuṟuppu maṇṭalam : kutam, piṟappuṟuppu maṇṭalam toṭarpāṉa.

anomaly : muṟi tiṟampiya; māṟi ceṟi vilakal : iyalpu niliyiliruntu māṟupaṭṭa allatu vēṟupaṭṭa allatu iyalpu tiṟampiya.

anomia : peyar maṟati nōy : poruḷkaḷiṉ allatu āṭkaḷiṉ peyarkaḷik kūṟa muṭiyāta nili.

anomie : taṉimiyil vāḻpavar : maṟṟavarkaḷuṭaṉ toṭarpu koḷḷa muṭiyāta niliyil maṟṟavarkaḷuṭaṉ iṇintu vāḻa muṭiyāta kāraṇattāl taṉimiyil vāḻu oru napar.

anonychia : nakamiṉmi : nakaṅkaḷ illātiruttal.

anoperineal : kutam-eruvāy maṇṭalam : kutam, virip pikkum eruvāykkum iṭip pakuti ākiyavi toṭarpāṉa maṇṭalam.

anopheles : malēriyāk kocu; muṟik kāyccal kocu : muṟikkāyccali (malēriyā) uṇṭākkum oruvakik kocu iṉam. intak koka iṉattiṉ peṇkocukkaḷ kaṭippatāl maṉitarukku muṟikkāyccal uṇṭākiṟatu.

anoplasty : kuta aṟuvic maruttuvam : kutattil aṟuvi marut tuvam ceytu nōyik kuṇappaṭuttum muṟi.

anorchism : viriyiṉmi; kāyiṉmi : oruvarukku oṉṟu allatu iraṇṭu virikaḷum piṟaviyilēyē illātiruttal.

anorectal : kutavāy toṭarpāṉa nōy : kutam, kutavāy toṭar pāṉa veṭippu nōy.

anorectic : paciyiṉmi; paci taṇippi; paciyaṭakki; pacikuṟippi : (1) uṇavu uṇpatil viruppam illātiruttal nōy. (2) paci yiṉmi nōyāl avatiyuruvar.

anorexia (anorexia nervosa) : paciyiṉmi nōy; paciyāmi nōy : perumpālum kumarap paruvap peṇkaḷip pīṭikkum oru cikkalāṉa uḷaviyal nōy. uṭal paruttuviṭumō eṉṟa accattil iḷam peṇkaḷ mikak kuṟivāka uṇavu uṇpatip paḻakkamākkik koḷḷumpōtu intap paḻakkam or uḷaviyal nōyāka māṟi uṇavu uṇpatil veṟuppi uṇṭākkiviṭukiṟatu. itaṉi 'olliyāvataṟku aṭimiyātal” eṉṟum kūṟalām. innōy kaṇṭavarkaḷukku eṭi kuṟikiṟatu; uṭal eṭi kuṟintālum uṭal kuṇṭākiṟatu eṉṉum accavuṇarvu tīviramaṭikiṟatu. uṭal melital, iyalpukkumīṟi mātaviṭāy varātupōtal, malaccikkal, kāl vīkkam ākiyavi ēṟpaṭukiṉṟaṉa. attuṭaṉ mikak kuṟukiya kālattil peruntīṉi uṇṇum perum vēṭkiyum uṇṭākiṟatu. uṇavu uṭ koḷvatu kuṟintukoṇṭē varuvatāl iṟutiyil maraṇam viḷikiṟatu.

anosmia : mukarvuṇarviḻappu; mukarvuṇarviṉmi; mōppa uṇarviṉmi; mukariṉmi : mukarum uṇarvi iḻantu viṭutal.

anovular : karuvaḷarcciyiṉmi; muṭṭiyiṉmi; cūḻaṟṟa : karuttaṭi māttirikaḷi uṭkoḷvatāl peṇkaḷiṭam karuvuṟutaliṉṟi mātaviṭāy uṇṭākiṟatu. itaṉāl irattap pōkku atikamākum.

anoxaemia : kuruti ākcijaṉ kuṟipāṭu; uyirvaḷikkuṟi kuruti : irattattil ākcijaṉ illātiruttal.

ansiline : aṉciliṉ : nilakkariyiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum eṇṇeyp paciyuḷḷa oru kūṭṭup poruḷ. itu nōy nuṇmattaṭiccāyam tayārikkap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

antacid : puḷippu nīkka maruntu; amila etirppi; amila muṟi : vayiṟṟil puḷippi akaṟṟum maruntu, kāṭit taṉmikku etirīṭāṉa allatu māṟṟāṉa maruntu. kārattaṉmiyuṭiya vayiṟṟuvali nīkkat tūḷ kalavi maruntukaḷil payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṟatu.

antagonism : etirpput taṉmi; etirppiyal : cila maruntukaḷil uḷḷa tīviramāṉa etirpput taṉmi, (e-ṭu) "nākcōlōṉ" eṉṟa maruntu, mayakka maruntukaḷiṉ aṉittu viḷivukaḷiyum etirmāṟākkukiṟatu. cilavakit tacikaḷukkum, uṟuppukaḷukkuṅkūṭa inta etirpput taṉmi uṇṭu.

antaphrodisiac : ciṟṟiṉpam taṇikkum maruntu.

antecedent : muṉṉōṭi;muṉṉikaḻcci; muṉceyal; muṉviṉi : oru kuṟippiṭṭa ceyalukku muṉṉatākavē naṭakkiṉṟa.

anteflexion : uṟuppu muṉ vaḷittal; muṉmaṭakkam : karuppiyiṉ niliyiliruntu potuvāka muṉṉōkki vaḷintirukkum or uṟuppu.

antenna : uṇarkompu : pūcci vakiyil muṉ tariyiṉ iru pakkaṅkaḷil kāṇappṭum uṇarcci uṟuppu.

antepar : āṉṭippār : pipparacīṉ aṭaṅkiya nīrmam allatu māttiri.

anterior : muṉpuṟam, muṉpakkam, muntiya : (1) kālattāl muṟpaṭṭa (2) iṭattiṉ muṉṉatāka, (3) uṭaliṉ muṉ pakkam.

anterior chamber : viḻimuṉṉaṟi : paṉippaṭalattiṟkum (kaṇmaṇi allatu pāppā) viḻik karumpaṭalattiṟkum iṭippaṭṭa viḻiyaṟi.
