anthema : 'tōl peruṅ koppuḷam': toṭarpuṭiya or iṇippuccol. (e-ṭu) (enanthema) caḷippaṭalak koppuḷam.

anthelmintic : kuṭaṟpuḻu nīkka maruntu; puḻuppaki; pūccik kolli ; kuṭaṟpuḻu maruntu : kuṭaliluḷḷa puḻukkaḷi veḷiyēṟṟukiṟa allatu oḻikkiṟa oru maruntu.

antheroselerosis : taṉimattuṭippu.

anthiphen : āntiḵpṉ : meppirāmiṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

anthracene : āntaraciṉ : kari maṟṟum tār ivaṟṟiliruntu tayārikkappaṭum oru vaki hiṭrō-kārpaṉ. cāyam tayārippataṟkup payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṟatu.

anthracoid : tōṟṟattil irāja piḷavi pōlirukkiṉṟaṉa.

anthracosis : nuriyīral nōy; nuriyīral karippaṭivu; karimanōy : nilakkarit tūḷ kalanta kāṟṟi uṭkoḷvatāl uṇṭākum nuriyīralil kārpaṉ cērntu uṇṭākum nōy.

anthracycline : āntiracikḷiṉ : puṟṟunōykkut tarappaṭum oru vaki nuṇṇuyirk kolli. ṭāṉāmiciṉ maṟṟum ṭākcō rupiciṉ kalanta maruntu.

anthraquinone : āntirakuyiṉōṉ : āntiracīṉiliruntu tayārikkappaṭum kuyiṉōṉ vaki maruntu. cāyam tayārippataṟkup payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

anthrax : naccup paru : kālnaṭikaḷukku uṇṭākum āpattāṉa naccuc cīḻ kaṭṭu nōy. itu oru toṟṟu nōy. itu kālnaṭi kaḷiṭamiruntu maṉitarukkum toṟṟakkūṭum

naccup paru

anthropoid : curuṅkiya iṭuppelumpu : iṭuppu vaḷiyam pakkattukkup pakkam kuṟukic curuṅkiyuḷḷa iṭuppuk kūṭu.

anthropology : māṉuṭaviyal; māntaviyal : maṉitakulattip paṟṟi ārāyum tuṟi. itil pala pirivukaḷ uṇṭu.

anthropometry : maṉita uṭal aḷavi; uṭal aḷavi, māṉiṭa nili aḷavi : maṉitariṉ uṭal, ataṉ uṟuppukaḷ ākiyavaṟṟiṉ aḷavi. oppīṭu ceyvataṟ kākavum, pāliṉam, vayatu, eṭi, iṉam pōṉṟavaṟṟukkāṉa uru mātirikaḷi vakuppataṟkākavum inta aḷavi payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

antiadrenergic : naramputtūṇṭal camaṉamākkal : parivu narampu maṇṭalattiṉ narampu iḻikaḷiṉāl uṇṭākum tūṇṭu viḷivukaḷic camaṉappaṭuttutal allatu kuṟittal.

antiallergic : ovvāmittaṭuppu; māṟṟu viṉippaki : ovvā miyit taṭuttal; kuṟittal.

antiamoebic : amīpākkolli : amīpā kirumikaḷ vaḷarvatiyum, perukuvatiyum taṭukkiṉṟa allatu avaṟṟi aḻikkiṉṟa maruntu. -

antianabolic : purataccērmam taṭuppu : uṭal puratattiṉ kūṭ ṭiṇivit taṭuttal.

antianemic : kurutip pōkku taṭuppu maruntu; cōki etirppi : kurutikkuḻāykaḷiliruntu irattam veḷippaṭuvatit taṭukkap payaṉpaṭum maruntu. (e-ṭu) viṭṭamiṉ K.

antianginal : itayavali maruntu; neñcuvali maruntu : itayat tacikaḷukkuc celkiṉṟa iratta aḷavi atikarittum, itayappaṇi aḷavik kuṟittum itaya valiyip pōkkukiṉṟa maruntu.

antiarrhythmic : itaya cīr māṟiya tuṭippu maruttuvam : palvēṟu itayattuṭippuk kōḷāṟukaḷik kuṇappaṭuttuvataṟkup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum maruntukaḷum, maruttuva muṟikaḷum.

antibacterial : pākṭīriyā etirppu maruntu; nuṇṇuyiri muṟi; nōyaṇu muṟi : pākṭīriyākkaḷi aḻikkiṟa, avaṟṟiṉ vaḷarcciyit taṭukkiṟa oru maruntu.

anti beriberi : taviṭṭāṉ etirppu maruntu : ūṭṭaccattuk kuṟi viṉāl uṇṭākum taviṭṭāṉ eṉṟa nōykku etirāṉa maruntu. eṭuttukkāṭṭu : viṭṭamiṉ B kaliaivayiluḷḷa tiyāmiṉ.

antibiosis : uṭaṉvāḻ ovvāmi etir uyirikaḷ; uyirp pakimi: or uyiriṉ iyalpāṉa vāḻkki viḷivāṉa poruḷ, maṟṟōr iṉa uyiriṉ vaḷarccikkuk kēṭāka irukkum taṉmi.

antibiotic : nōymuṟiyam.

antibiotics : nōy nuṇma etirppup poruḷkaḷ; uyirk kolli; nuṇṇuyirkkolli; nōymuṟiyam : pūñcaṇam, pākṭīriyā pōṉṟavaṟṟiliruntu eṭukkappaṭum nōyk kirumi etirppup poruḷkaḷ. peṉciliṉ itaṟku or eṭuttukkāṭṭu. piṉṉar kaṇṭupiṭikkappaṭṭa ṭeṭrācikḷiṉ pōṉṟa tacinōy uṇṭākkum uyirikaḷukku etirākat tiṟampaṭa vēli ceykiṉṟaṉa; ivaṟṟi vāyvaḻiyākavum koṭukkalām. niyōmiciṉ, pāciṭrāciṉ pōṉṟavi atika naccut taṉmiyuṭiyaṉavāka iruppatāl, uḷḷē payaṉpaṭuttappaṭuvatilli, puṟakāyaṅkaḷukkup payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṉṟaṉa.

antibody : nōy etirpporuḷ; viḷi etirmam; taṟkāppu mūlam : tīṅkutarum ayaṟporuḷukku etirāka uyiriṉattiṉ uṭalil uṇṭākum poruḷ.

anticholinergic : pittanīr narampuk kōḷāṟu : pittanīr narampu, aciṭṭilkōliṉ eṉṟa oru vētiyiyal poruḷiṉ mūlamākat taṉatu tuṇṭalkaḷi narampu allatu itaya narampuc cantippukaḷukku aṉuppukiṟatu. inta naṭavaṭikkikkut taṭiyāka irukkum ceyal.

anticlockwise : etivalam.

anticoagulant : kurutikkaṭṭut taṭipporuḷ; uṟivu etirppi : uṭalil kāyampaṭṭu irattam aḷavukku atikamāka veḷiyēṟi vīṇāvatit taṭuppataṟkāka, irattatti iṟuki uṟiyac ceyyum poruḷ irattattil uḷḷatu. ivvāṟu irattam uṟiyac ceyvatit taṭukkum poruḷ kurutikkaṭṭut taṭipporuḷ ākum. nōyiyal paricōtaṉi kaḷukkāka irattam muḻuvatiyum eṭukka vēṇṭiyirukkumpōtu, ākcālik amilam (vellaka amilam) kurutikkaṭṭut taṭipporuḷākap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu. irattam celuttuvataṟkāka irattam eṭukkumpōtu, cōṭiyam ciṭrēṭ kurutik kaṭṭut taṭipporuḷākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

anticoagulation : irattam uṟitalit taṭuttal; irattam uṟiyāt taṉmi; kuruti uṟiyā nili.

anticonvulsant : valipput taṭip poruḷ; valippaṭakki; valippu muṟi : valippi aṟavē oḻikkiṟa allatu taṭukkiṟa poruḷ.

antidepressants : cōrvu nīkka maruntukaḷ; uḷaccōrvup pōkkikaḷ : cōrviṉi akaṟṟukiṟa maruntukaḷ ṭiricikḷik kuḻumattic cērnta maruntukaḷ itaṟkup perumaḷavil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. akaccōrvuk kōḷāṟukaḷukku ivi payaṉpaṭukiṉṟaṉa.

antidiarrhoeal : vayiṟṟuppōkkut taṭuppu maruntu : vayiṟṟuppōkkik kuṟikkiṉṟa maruntu vayiṟṟup pōkki kuṇappaṭuttukiṉṟa maruntu. vayiṟṟuppōkku aṟikuṟikaḷi aṟavē pōkkukiṉṟa maruntu.

antidiabetic : nīriḻivu maruttuvam; carkkari nōy etirppi; nīriḻi vaṭakki : nīriḻivu nōykku etirāṉa maruttuvac cikicci muṟikaḷi itu kuṟikkiṟatu. iyakkunīr kaṇiyaccurappu nīr (iṉculiṉ) vāyvaḻi maruntukaḷ ākiyavi itil aṭaṅkum.

antiemetic : vāntittaṭuppāṉ; vānti maruntu : vānti maṟṟum umaṭṭalit taṭukkum maruntu, vānti maṟṟum umaṭṭaliliruntu nivāraṇam tarum maruntu.

antidiphtheritic : toṇṭi aḻaṟcit taṭuppu maruttuvam : toṇṭi aḻaṟci nōyit (ṭiptīriyā) taṭuppataṟkāṉa maruttuvam muṟikaḷ toṟṟu nōyt taṭuppu naṭavaṭikkikaḷ itil aṭaṅkum.

antidiuretic : ciṟunīrk kaḻivut taṭuppu maruttuvam; ciṟunīrkkuṟippi; nīr perukkaṭakki : ciṟunīr aḷavukku mīṟik kaḻivatit taṭuppataṟkāṉa maruttuva muṟi.

antidote : māṟṟu maruntu; naccumuṟippi; naccu muṟi : naccup poruḷi muṟippataṟkuk koṭukkappaṭum māṟṟu maruntu. eṭuttuk kāṭṭāka amila nañciṉi muṟikka cōṭiyampikkārpaṉēṭ taṭuppu maruntu pōṉṟa kārap poruṭkaḷik koṭuttal.

anti-dysenteric : aḷiccal taṭuppu maruntu : vayiṟṟaḷiccalit taṭuppataṟkāṉa maruntu.

antiembolic : kurutik kuḻāyaṭipput taṭuppu maruntu : pakka vātattiṟkuriya niliyil kurutik kuḻāykaḷil kurutik kaṭṭi vaḻiyaṭippatit taṭukkum maruntu.

antiemetic : vāntit taṭuppu maruntu; vāntiyaṭakki : kumaṭṭa liyum, vāntiyiyum taṭukkum maruntu.

antienzyme : iyakkunīr taṭipporuḷ; iyakku nīr etirppi :or iyakkunīr (eṉcim) ceyaṟpaṭuvatit taṭukkum poruḷ. itu cīraṇamaṇṭalattil iruppatāl, nōyt taṭuppi etirkkiṟatu.

antiepileptic : valippu nōy taṭuppu maruntu; valippaṭakki maruntu : kākkāy valippu aṭikkaṭi varuvatik kuṟikkum maruntu.

antifebrite : kāyccal taṭuppu maruntu; kāycalaṭakki : kāyccalit taṭukkum allatu kuṟikkum maruntu.

antifebrin : kāyccal etirppu maruntu : kāyccalik kuṇappaṭuttak koṭukkappaṭum aciṭṭāṉiliṭu eṉṟa maruntu. itu aciṭṭik amilam, aṉiliṉ iraṇṭum kalantu peṟappaṭukiṟatu.

antifibrinolytic : ūnīrkōḷāṟu taṭuppu maruntu : kaṭṭiyāka uṟiyak kūṭiya ūṉīr kacivuk kōḷāṟukaḷit taṭukkakkūṭiya maruntu.

antitungi : kāḷāṉ oḻippu maruntu; kāḷāṉ nīkkikaḷ; pūcaṇap paki :nōyttaṉmiyuṭiya kāḷāṉ (nāykkuṭi) vakiyi oḻikkum maruntu.

antigen : kāppu mūlam; uṭaṟ kāppu ūkki; viḷiviyam : ayaṟ poruḷiliruntu uyiriṉam kākkum uyir taṟkāppup poruḷi uṇṭu paṇṇum poruḷ mūlam. itu irattattil uṟpattiyākum nōy etirp poruḷi uṇṭākkukiṟatu.

antihemophilic globulin (AHG) : kurutipperukkut taṭuppup puratap poruḷ : irattakkaṭṭiyil aṭaṅkiyuḷḷa VIII. itu niṇa nīril uḷḷatu; kuruti niṇanīril illi. kurutip perukkil kuṟivāka irukkiṟatu.

antihemorrahgic : kurutippōkkut taṭipporuḷ : kurutik kuḻāykaḷiliruntu irattam veḷippaṭuvatit taṭukkum poruḷ. itaṉi viṭṭamiṉ K eṉpar.

antihypertensive : uyar iratta aḻuttat taṭipporuḷ; miki aḻuttak kuṟippi; pēraḻuttat taṇippi : uyarnta iratta aḻut tattik kuṟikkum oru poruḷ.

antiinfective : toṟṟut taṭipporuḷ; toṟṟut taṭi : nōy toṟṟuvatit taṭukkum maruntu, itaṉi viṭṭamiṉ A eṉpar.

antiinflammatory : vīkkattaṭuppup poruḷ nīkki; aḻaṟcit taṭi : vīkkattik kuṟikkiṟa allatu vīkkam ēṟpaṭāmal taṭukkiṟa poruḷ.

antileprotic : toḻunōyt taṭuppu maruntu; toḻunōy etirppi; toḻunōyp paki : toḻunōy ēṟpaṭāmal taṭukkiṟa allatu toḻunōyik kuṇappaṭuttukiṟa oru maruntu.

antilymphocyte serum (ALS) : niṇanīr aṇu etirppu ūṉīr; paṭinīrccel etirc cīram : niṇa nīrkaḷiṉ ceyalkaḷit taṭuttu avaṟṟik kaṭṭiyākkukiṟa nōy etirppup poruḷkaḷiyuṭiya ūṉir.

antilysian: citivu tṭivi.

antilysis : citivut taṭi.

antimetabolite : vaḷarciti māṟṟat taṭuppup poruḷ; ūṉma ākkattaṭi : or uyiraṇuviṉ karumiyap purataṅkaḷil oruṅ kiṇittu ataṉ vaḷarcciyit taṭuppataṟkuk tēviyāṉa vētiyiyal poruḷkaḷi ottirukkum oru kūṭṭupporuḷ. itu puṟṟunōy maruttuvattil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

antimicrobial : nuṇṇuyir etirppup poruḷ; nuṇṇuyirp paki : uyir nuṇmaṅkaḷukku etirākac ceyaṟpaṭum poruḷ.

antimicrobic : nōy nuṇmat taṭi.

antimigrine : oṟṟit talivalit taṭuppu maruntu : kaṭumiyāṉa oṟṟit talivaliyit taṭukkum maruntu.

antimitotic : uyiraṇup piḷavu iyakkattaṭuppu maruntu; ticuppiḷapput taṭi : uyiraṇu nuṇṉiḻiyākap pirintu iṉapperukkam ceyvatit taṭukkum maruntu. puṟṟu nōyik kuṇappaṭuttuvataṟkāṉa pala maruntu kaḷi itu kuṟikkum.

antimony and potassium tartrate : karunimiḷi maṟṟum poṭṭāciyam ṭārṭrēṭ : añcaṉakkal eṉappaṭum karunimiḷi (āṉṭimaṇi) poṭṭāciyam puḷiyakakkāṭiyiṉ uppuccattu aṭaṅkiya oru vakip paḻiya maruntu. itu ippōtu, veppa maṇṭala nōykaḷik kuṇappaṭutta mukkiyamākap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

antimutagen : vaki māṟṟat taṭuppup poruḷ : uyiriṉavaki māṟṟa viṉiyip payaṉaṟṟatākkum oru poruḷ.

antimycotic : kāḷāṉ aḻippup poruḷ; kāḷāṉ nōy : nōy uṇṭākkum oṭṭuyirk kāḷāṉkaḷi aḻikkum oru maruntu.

antineoplastic : putu uyir ūṉma etirppup poruḷ : putiya uyir ūṉmaṅkaḷukku etirākac ceyaṟpaṭum oru poruḷ.

antinephritic : kuṇṭikkāy paṟṟiya; nōyk ketirākac ceyyappaṭukiṟa.

antineurtic : narampu nōyttaṭuppu maruntu; narampaḻaṟcit taṭi : narampu nōyit taṭukkum maruntu, itu kuṟippāka viṭṭamiṉ B kalaviyik kuṟikkum.

anti-oedema : vīkkat taṭi.

antiodontgic : palvali taṭukkum maruntu.

antioxidants : ākcikaraṇa etirppup poruḷ; ākciyēṟṟi etirppup poruḷ; uyir vaḷiyēṟṟa etirppikaḷ : ākcikaraṇa muṟiyit tāmatappaṭuttum oru poruḷ.

antiparkison (ISM) drugs : pārkkiṉcaṉ nōyttaṭi maruntu : 'ḵpiṉōttiyāciṉ' pōṉṟa mukkiya camaṉappaṭuttum maruntukaḷ. ivi narampu cārnta allatu uḷaviyal cārnta nōykaḷik kuṇappaṭuttum maruntukaḷiṉ pakka viḷivukaḷit taṭukkap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.

antiparasitic : oṭṭuyir oḻippup poruḷ; oṭṭuṇṇi etiri; oṭṭuṇṇittaṭi : oṭṭuṇṇikaḷi allatu oṭṭuyirkaḷit taṭukkiṟa allatu aḻikkiṟa poruḷ.

antipellagra : tōl veṭippi nōyt taṭi maruntu : ūṭṭak kuṟiviṉāl ēṟpaṭṭu, iṟutiyil mūḷikkōḷāṟil koṇṭu viṭum tōlveṭippu nōyik kuṇappaṭuttum maruntu. viṭṭamiṉ B kalaviyiluḷḷa nikkōṭṭiṉik amilam eṉṟa pakuti ippaṇiyic ceykiṟatu.

antiperiodic : kālāntara nōyt taṭuppu maruntu : kāyccal (malēriyā) pōṉṟa kālāntaraṅkaḷil tirumpat tirumpa varukiṟa nōykaḷit taṭuppataṟkāṉa maruntu.

antiperistalsis : tacic curukka etir māṟṟu ali; etirali viyakkam ; kuṭalali etirppikaḷ kuṭal acivu maṟinili : uṇavu cāram eḷitil celluvataṟkicivāṉa uṇarvaṟṟa vaṭṭākāramāṉa taṉṉiyakkat tacic curukka alikaḷiṉ iyalpāṉa iyakkatti etir māṟākkutal.

antiphlogistic : vīkkam taṇippi.

antiprothrombin : kurutikkaṭṭut taṭuppu : kuruti nāḷaṅkaḷil kuruti uṟivatit taṭuttal.

antiprotozoal : muntu nuṇmattaṭi.

antipruritic : aripput taṭuppu maruntu; namiccalaṭakki; arippuk kuṟippi; namiccuttaṭi : tōlil arippu ēṟpaṭuvatik kuṇap paṭuttum allatu taṭukkum maruntu.

antipurpura : cennīlap puḷḷit taṭuppu maruntu : tōliṉ mēl cennīla niṟappuḷḷikaḷ koṇṭa nōy ēṟpaṭuvatit taṭukkum maruntu. viṭṭamiṉ P intap paṇiyic ceykiṟatu.

antipyretic : kāyccal kuṟippāṉ maruntu; curamaṭakki; kāyccalaṭakki; curattaṭi : kuḻantik kaṇi (rikkaṭs) nōyit taṭukkum maruntu. viṭṭamiṉ D ippaṇiyic ceykiṟatu.

antirabic : nāykkaṭi nōyt taṭi.

antirachitic : elu citivuttaṭi.

antiRhesus : uṟi ūkka etirppuk kūṟu : kurutiyil uṟimam ūkkuṅkūṟu celuttappaṭum pōtu etircceyal kāṭṭukiṟa (Rh-positive) kuḻanti peṟukiṟa peṇkaḷukkup pintiya makappēṟṟiṉ pōtu karumūlattāḷ cavvil pātippu ēṟpaṭāmal taṭuppataṟkāka, kurutiyil uṟimam ūkkuṅkaṟu cettappaṭum pōtu etircceyalkāṭṭāka (Rh-negative) kūṟu aḷikkappaṭutal.

antirheumatic: kīlvātat taṭuppu maruntu; mūṭṭuvalit taṭi; vātamaṭakki; muṭakku nōy taṭuppi; muṭakku nōy nīkki : kīlvātattit taṭukkakkūṭiya allatu kuṟikkak kūṭiya maruntu.

antiscorbutic : coṟinōyt taṭuppu maruntu; mūkku vaṟaṭci nōy nīkki; kacinōyt taṭi : ūṭṭaccattuk kuṟiviṉāl ēṟpaṭum coṟi, karappāṉ, pal ekir vīkka nōyit (skarvi) taṭukkiṟa allatu kuṇap paṭuttukiṟa maruntu. viṭṭamiṉ C intap paṇiyic ceykiṟatu.

antisecretory : curapput taṭuppu maruntu; curapput taṭi; curappuk kuṟippi

ūṉirkarappatit taṭukkum maruntu.



antisepsis : nuṇmattaṭi; cīḻt taṭi; cīḻt taṭuppi : nōy nuṇ maṅkaḷ vaḷarcciyaṭintu ticukkaḷi aḻittuviṭāmal taṭuttal. lisṭar pirapu 1880 il aṟuvi maruttuvattil kārpālik amilatti mutaṉmutalāka itaṟkup payaṉpaṭuttiṉār.

antiseptic : nōy nuṇmat taṭi maruntukaḷ; cīḻ etirppi; naccu nīkki; naccu nīkkuvi : nōykaḷi uṇṭākkum nuṇṇuyirkaḷi aḻikkiṟa allatu avaṟṟiṉ vaḷarcciyit taṭukkiṟa vētiyiyal poruḷkaḷ. ivi uyiruḷḷa ticukkaḷil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

antiserum : nōy etirppu ūṉīr; etirccīram : oru vilaṅkiṉ irattattiliruntu tayārikkappaṭum poruḷ. itu tēviyāṉa kāppu mūlattiṉ mūlam nōyttaṭikāppu ceyyappaṭṭirukkum. itil peru maḷavil nōy etirppup poruḷkaḷ aṭaṅkiyirukkum.

antisialagogue : umiḻnīr taṭuppup poruḷ; eccil curappu oṭukki : vāyil aḷavukku miñci eccil ūṟuvatit taṭukkum poruḷ.

antisocial : maṉanalakkēṭu : camutāyatti veṟukkiṟa maṉanili, oru camutāyattiṉ ataṉ uṟuppiṉarkaḷ vitikkum kaṭamip poṟuppu kaḷiyum, kaṭṭuppāṭukaḷiyum ēṟṟukkoḷḷa maṟukkum maṉanili.

antispasmodic : tacic curipput taṭuppu muṟi; naṭukkamakaṟṟi; iṟuku taṭi; icivakaṟṟi : taciyil curippuk kōḷāṟukaḷiṉāl ēṟpaṭum valiyik kuṇappaṭuttap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum muṟi.

antisterility : malaṭu nīkka maruntu; malaṭu nīkki; malaṭu muṟi : iṉap perukkat takutiyiṉmiyi nīkkuvataṟkāṉa maruntu viṭṭamiṉ E ippaṇiyic ceykiṟatu.

antisyphilitic : mēkappuṇ taṭuppu muṟi; mēkap puṇ oḻippu; mēkap puṇ taṭi : mēkappuṇ (kiranti) eṉṟa mēka nōyit taṭuppataṟkāṉa maruttuvamuṟi.

antithrombin : tirāmpiṉ taṭi; kurutiyuṟivut taṭuppupporuḷ : irattattil iyaṟkiyāka irukkum kurutiyuṟivut taṭuppup poruḷ. (e-ṭu) heppāriṉ.

antithrombotic : kurutik kaṭṭut taṭuppu maruttuvamuṟi; paṭima uṟi vetirppu : kuruti nāḷaṅkaḷil kurutikkaṭṭu ēṟpaṭāmal taṭuppataṟkāṉa allatu ataṉik kuṇappaṭuttuvataṟkāṉa cikicci muṟi.

artificial pacemaker : itayat tuṭippic cīrākkum karuvi : uṭalil oṭum irattattic cuttappaṭutti, iratta ōṭṭattic cīrpaṭuttuvatu itayam, itayattil mēlaṟikaḷ iraṇṭum, kīḻaṟikaḷ iraṇṭum uḷḷaṉa. acutta irattam mutalil iṭatu mēlaṟikku vantu, aṅkiruntu iṭatu kīḻaṟikkuc ceṉṟu, aṅkiruntu aḻuttappaṭṭu nuriyīralukkuc ceṉṟu, aṅku ākcijaṉip peṟṟuc cuttamaṭikiṟatu. cuttamaṭinta irattam valatu mēlaṟikku vantu, aṅkiruntu valatu kīḻaṟikkuc ceṉṟu aṅkiruntu aḻuttappaṭṭu makātamaṉi vaḻiyāka uṭaliṉ maṟṟap pakutikaḷukkum celkiṟatu. mēlaṟikaḷum, kīḻaṟikaḷum cīrāṉa orē vēkattil iyaṅkumpōtu iratta oṭṭam cīrāka irukkum mēlaṟikaḷum kīḻ aṟikaḷum iyaṅkum vēkamē itayat tuṭippu. inta vēkattic cīr paṭutta nam itayattil iyaṟkiyākavē 'ciṉōṭriyal nōy' eṉṟa amippu uḷḷatu. narampu uyiraṇukkaḷālāṉa intac ciṟiya tarip pakuti, iṭatu mēlaṟic cuvaril uḷḷatu. itiliruntu eḻum tuṭippu, mēlaṟikaḷum kīḻaṟikaḷum orē cīrāka iyaṅka utavukiṟatu. itu cariyāka vēli ceyyāta pōtu, itayattiṉ iratta oṭṭam pātittu, inta kōḷāṟic cariceyya itayat tuṭippic cīrākkum intac ceyaṟkik karuvi poruttappaṭukiṟatu. itil, litiyam ayōṭiṉālāṉa miṉkalam uḷḷatu. itaṉ eṭi 40 kirām irukkum. mārpil itayam irukkum pakutiyiṉmītu ciṟiya aṟuviceytu ikkaruvi tacip pakutikkuḷ vikkap paṭukiṟatu. itiluḷḷa mika nuṇṇiya kampi (vayar) itayat tacip pakutiyuṭaṉ iṇikkappaṭukiṟatu. itiluḷḷa miṉkalam mūlam, kampi tuṇṭutal peṟṟu itayattuṭippic cīrākkukiṟatu. ikkaruvi poruttappaṭṭa cila nāṭkaḷil nōyāḷiyiṉ itayam mīṇṭum cīrāka iyaṅkat toṭaṅkum. avvāṟu cīrāka iyaṅkat toṭaṅkiyatum ikkaruvi taṉ paṇiyi niṟuttik koḷḷum. mīṇṭum kōḷāṟu ēṟpaṭṭāl, ikkaruvi mīṇṭum tāṉākavē paṇiyit toṭaṅki viṭum. ikkaruvi 10 āṇṭukaḷ vari ceyaṟpaṭum.

narampaṇu vāl

﻿muṭivaṭiyum iṭattiluḷḷa. allatu maṟṟoru narampuṭaṉ atu iṇiyum iṭattiluḷḷa narampu uyiraṇuvukkuc cellum narampu iḻi. axonopathy : narampu vēriḻi nōy : narampu vēriḻiyip pātikkiṉṟa oru vaki narampu nōy.

axonotmesis : narampaṇuvāl citivu : oru narampaṇuviṉ vālil ēṟpaṭṭa cētam kāraṇamākap puṟappakuti nalintu citivuṟutal. maruttuvac cikicciyiṉāl inta narampaṇu vālkaḷukkup puttuyiruṭṭalām. ivi puttuyir peṟuvataṟkup pala mātaṅkaḷ piṭikkalām. oru mātattil 25.4 mi.mī vaḷarntāl atu cātāraṇa vaḷarcci vēkam.

axotomy : narampu vēriḻi nīkkal; narampu vēriḻi veṭṭal; narampu vēriḻi akaṟṟal : aṟuvi maruttuvam mūlam narampu vēriḻiyi nīḷa āḻa veṭṭutal.

Ayerza's : ayercā nōy : arjeṉṭiṉā uṭaliyalāḷar apel ayercā eṉpavar kaṇṭupiṭitta nōy itu. inta nōyuḷḷa oruvarukku nuriyīral tamaṉi miku iratta aḻuttam, nuriyīral tamaṉittaṭippu, neṭuṅkālamākak kāṇappaṭum nīlam pāvittal, civappaṇu mikippu ākiya aṟikuṟikaḷ tōṉṟum.

blood : irattam; kuruti : itayattilum irattanāḷaṅkaḷilum niṟintirukkum cenniṟa neypput taṉmiyuṭiya tiravam. itil, kurutinīr (piḷāsmā) eṉappaṭum uyirmap poruḷ aṭaṅkiyuḷḷatu. itil irattac civappaṇukkaḷ, iratta veḷḷaṇukkaḷ, takaṭṭu aṇukkaḷ mitakkiṉṟaṉa. kuruti nīril, irattam kaṭṭikkoḷḷa utavum poruḷkaḷ uṭpaṭap palvēṟu poruḷkaḷ kari calāka aṭaṅkiyuḷḷaṉa.

bonding : piṇippu : oruvar maṟṟoruvaruṭaṉ koḷḷum uṇarvupūrvamāṉa piṇippu. itu nīṇṭakāla uṇarcci mayamāṉa uṟavunilikku iṉṟiyamiyātatu. piṟanta kuḻantikaḷ, tīvira maruttuvap pirivil kavaṉikkappaṭa vēṇṭiya pirivil kavaṉikkappaṭa vēṇṭiya cama yattil kuḻantikkum peṟṟōrkaḷukkum, mukkiyamākat tāykkumiṭiyē intappiṇippu uyiriyal muṟiyil iṉṟiyamiyātatu. piṟanta kuḻantikkum avaṟṟiṉ peṟṟōrukkum iṭiyē aṉpu iṇippi vaḷarppataṟkut taṉi muyaṟcikaḷ tēvi.

bone : elumpu : oruvaki iṇipput ticu kālciyam kārpōṉēṭ,kālciyampāsḵpēṭa pōṉṟa uppupporuḷkaḷ itil paṭintu itaṉik kaṭiṉamākki aṭarttiyākkukiṟatu. taṉittaṉi elumpukaḷ cērntu elumpukkūṭāka amikiṉṟaṉa.

bone graft : elumpu oṭṭu maruttuvam : uṭampiṉ oru pakuti yiliruntu or elumputtuṇṭi eṭuttu iṉṉoru pakutiyil poruttutal allatu oruvariṭamiruntu iṉṉoruvarukku māṟṟip poruttutal. elumpuk kōḷāṟukaḷic cīrpaṭuttuvataṟku allatu elumpu uruvākkat ticukkaḷi aḷippataṟku inta maruttuvam payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

bone marrow : elumpu macci; elumpuc cōṟu; elumpu nāḷak kūḻ : elumpu uṭpuḻiyiluḷḷa cōṟu pōṉṟa poruḷ. piṟakkumpōtu inta uṭpuḻiyiṉuḷ, civappuc cōṟu pōl aminta, irattam niṟinti rukkum. piṉṉar, nīṇṭa elumpukaḷiṉuḷ koḻuppup poruḷ paṭintu civappuccōṟu, mañcaḷ elumpuccōṟāka māṟukiṟatu.

bone-marrous cancer (multiple myeloma) : elumpu maccippuṟṟu : elumpuc cōṟu eṉappaṭum elumpu macciyil uḷḷa oru vaki iratta veḷḷi aṇukkaḷil paṭippaṭiyāka ēṟpaṭum puṟṟunōy. itil toṭakka niliyil, kāraṇamiṉṟi elumpu vali, aṭikkaṭit toṟṟu nōykaḷ, ciṟu nīrakam ceyaliḻattal pōṉṟa nōykkuṟikaḷ tōṉṟum. inta nōy potuvāka 40 vayatukku mēṟpaṭṭavarkaḷukku uṇṭākiṟatu. inta nōyik kuṇappaṭuttuvataṟkāṉa orē vaḻi elumpu macci māṟṟu aṟuvic cikicciyēyākum. inta aṟuvic cikicciyil, nōyuṟṟa macci nīkkappaṭṭu, māṟṟāka ārōkkiyamāṉa elumpu macci vikkappaṭu kiṟatu.

bone-marrow transplant : elumpu macci māṟṟu aṟuvi maruttuvam perumpālāṉa elumpukaḷiṉ miyappakutiyil elumpuc cōṟu allatu elumpu macci eṉṉum meṉmiyāṉa ticu uḷḷaṉa. itutāṉ, uṭampi luḷḷa nōyit tīrppataṟkāṉa iratta veḷḷaṇukkaḷi uṟpatti ceytu, mutircciyaṭiyac ceykiṟatu. elumpu macciyiṉ intac ceyalmuṟi cēta maṭiyumpōtu nōyāḷi iṟantuviṭukiṟār. itit taṭuppataṟku māṟṟu aṟuvic cikicci mūlam nōyuṟṟa elumpu macci uyiraṇukkaḷi akaṟṟiviṭṭu ataṟkup patilāka ārōkkiyamāṉa uyiraṇukkaḷi macciyil vikkiṟārkaḷ. inta ārōkkiyamāṉa uyiraṇukkaḷi nōyāḷiyiṭamirunta eṭukkalām; illiyeṉil inta uyiraṇukkaḷip perumpālum mārpelumpiliruntu allatu iṭuppelumpu vari, mukaṭṭiliruntu eṭukkiṟārkaḷ. elumpil pala tuḷikaḷiṭṭu ūcikaḷ mūlam macci eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. itu nōyāḷikku narampu vaḻiyākac celuttappaṭukiṟatu. nōyi etirkkum uyiraṇuk kaṟṟikaḷiṉ muṉṉōṭikaḷāṉa naṭuttaṇṭu uyiraṇukkaḷiyum nōyuṟṟa uyiraṇukkaḷukkup patilāka vikkalām. naṭuttaṇṭu uyir aṇukkaḷi, elumpu macci irattam, toppuḷkoṭi irattam allatu karuppic cicuviṉ nuriyīraliliruntu eṭukkalām.

Boop : pūp : pirāṅkiyōliṭṭis āpliṭoraṉs ārkaṉiciṅ nimōṉiyā eṉṉum nōyiṉ āṅkilac coṟṟoṭariṉ mutal eḻuttuc cērkki. mūccunuṇ kuḻāy ﻿kaḷ aḻaṟciyuṟṟu muṟṟilumāka aḻintu pōvatāl ēṟpaṭukiṉṟa nuriyīral aḻaṟci nōyik kuṟippatu.

booster : ceyalūkki; ūkkuvippu ūci : oruvarukku ēṟkaṉavē tarappaṭṭa taṭuppu ūciyiṉ ceyali ūkkuvippataṟkākap pōṭappaṭum maṟṟoru taṭuppūci. (e-ṭu) kuḻantikaḷukku 1 1/2, 2 1/2, 3 1/2 mātaṅkaḷil muttaṭuppūci pōṭappaṭum. itaṉ ūkkuvippu ūcikaḷ muṟiyē oṉṟari, nāṉkari vayatukaḷil pōṭappaṭum.

borax : veṇkāram : pōrik amilam pōṉṟatoru meṉmiyāṉa nōykkirumit taṭip poruḷ. pōraks kiḷicariṉum elumpu nirampiya pōrak kam toṇṭip pūccu maruntākap payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṟatu. eṉiṉum itaṉi aritākavē payaṉpaṭuttutal vēṇṭum.

borborygmi : vayiṟṟup porumal : kuṭalil vāyukkaḷ acivatāl uṇṭākum kumuṟal cattam.

borderline : ellikkōṭu; iṭippaṭṭa viḷimpu; elli; niliyaṟṟa : enta niliyilum uṟutiyillāta iraṇṭu nilikaḷukku iṭippaṭṭa. miku iratta aḻutta elli : iyalpāṉa iratta aḻuttattiṟkum miku iratta aḻuttattiṟkum iṭippaṭṭa niliyil oruvariṉ iratta aḻutta aḷavu iruppatu.

niliyaṟṟat toḻunōy : ivvakit toḻunōyiṉ tōl paṭikaḷ pārppataṟku ṭiyūpar kulāyṭu vakiyip pōlavē irukkum. nāḷkaḷ āka āka ippaṭikaḷ leprōmēṭṭas vakikku māṟiviṭum.

iṭippaṭṭa kaṭṭi : puṟṟunōyk kaṭṭiyāka māṟum taṉmiyuḷḷa kaṭṭi.

bordeteila : kakkuvāṉ kirumi : kakkuvāṉ irumal nōy uṇ ṭākkum 'purucellāṉciyē’ eṉṟa nōykkirumi (pākṭīriyā).

bonedom : aluppu.

boric acid : pōrik amilam : meṉmiyāṉa nōyk kirumit taṭipporuḷ. kaṇ coṭṭu maruntākavum, kātuccoṭṭu maruntākavum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. itaṉ tuḷiyum karicaliyum uṭaliṉ veṟṟup pakuti yil taṭavutalākātu. ataṉāl, pōrik naccu uṇṭākalām.

Bornholm disease : pārṉhālm nōy : ṭeṉmārkkic cērnta pārṉhālm eṉṟa tīvil atikam paraviyirunta inta nōyi cilvesṭariṉ 1934 il kaṇṭaṟintu viḷakkiṉār. oruvaki nōyk ﻿kirumiyiṉāl innōy uṇṭākiṟatu. innōykkirumi pīṭitta 14 nāṭkaḷil nōykkuṟikaḷ tōṉṟukiṉṟaṉa. neñciṉ aṭippakuti allatu aṭivayiṟu allatu mutukelumput tacikaḷil tiṭīreṉak kaṭum vali tōṉṟi, mūccuviṭuvatu kaṭiṉamākiṟatu. vali kāraṇamāka, kāyccalum tōṉṟukiṟatu. innōy oru vāram nīṭikkum. itaṟkuc cikicci etuvumilli.

Borrelia : poriliyā : itu oru curuḷuyirik kirumi.mīḷ kāyccali uṇṭākkum. ḵpirāṉs nāṭṭiṉ nuṇṇuyiriyal vallunar ameṭīporel ikkirumiyik kaṇṭupiṭittār.

poriliyā parjiṭōrperi : lim nōyi uruvākkum kirumi.

bossing : vaṭṭamēṭu; uruṇṭi mēṭu : piṟanta kuḻantiyiṉ maṇṭiyōṭṭil kāṇappaṭum mēṭu muṉ maṇṭiyōṭṭilum pakkavāṭṭu maṇṭiyōṭṭilum vaṭṭavaṭivil uruṇṭiyākat tiraṇṭu kāṇappaṭum mēṭu itu.

Botallo's duct : poṭṭallō nāḷam; oruvakit tamaṉi nāḷam : ittāli nāṭṭiṉ aṟuvic cikicci vallunar liyōnārṭō poṭṭallō iṉam kaṇṭa iratta nāḷam.

botulism : takara naccu : takara kalaṅkaḷil aṭittu vikkappaṭum uṇavukaḷil kirumikaḷāl viḷiyum naccuppāṭu. itaṉāl, vānti, malaccikkal, vāy maṟṟum toṇṭi vātam ēṟpaṭum. cila camayam inta nañcuṇavu uṇṭa 24-72 maṇi nērattiṟkuḷ kuraliḻappum ēṟpaṭakkūṭum. eṉavē, takarak kalaṅkaḷil iṭappaṭṭa kāykaṟikaḷ, uṇavup poruḷkaḷit tavirttal vēṇṭum. ﻿bougie : vaḷivuk katti; pukutti : vaḷiyum iyalpuṭiya meṉ miyāṉa aṟuvik katti. itu nīḷ uruḷi vaṭivuṭiyatu. itu piciṉ nekiḻvu ulōkat tiṉālāṉatu. iṟukkaṅkaḷi virivaṭiyac ceyvataṟku itu payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

Bourneville's disease : pārṉ villi nōy : naramput tōl taṭippu nōy. itu oru parampari nōy. inta nōyuḷḷōrukku valippu nōy, maṉanōy, mūḷiyil kaṭṭi, tōlil taṭippukaḷ maṟṟum kaṭṭikaḷ kāṇappaṭum. in nōykku muṟiyāka cikicci ituvarik kaṭipiṭikkappaṭa villi. ḵpirāṉs nāṭṭiṉ narmpiyal vallunar ṭeycari mēklōyar pārṉvilli eṉpavar inta nōyik kaṇṭupiṭittār.

Bowman's capsule : pumaṇ kiṇṇam : ciṟunīraka vaṭippiyil kāṇappaṭum kiṇṇam pōṉṟa amippu. ciṟunīraka vaṭi muṭiccukaḷi uḷḷaṭakki uḷḷatu. āṅkila uṭaliyaṅku iyalāḷar car villiyam peḷamaṇ itik kaṇṭaṟintār.

Bowman's membrane : peḷamaṇ āyvu : karu viḻippaṭalattiyum karuviḻip poruḷiyum pirikkiṉṟa melliya cavvu allatu iḻi.

Boyle's aneasthetic machine : pāyil mayakkamaruntu entiram : kuḷōrōḵpārm, ītar, niṭras ākciṭu vāyu, ākcijaṉ pōṉṟa mayakka maruntukaḷ koṭuppataṟkāṉa entiram.

Boyle's apparatus : pāyiliṉ karuvi; pāyiliṉ uṇarvakaṟṟik karuvi : iṅkilāntu nāṭṭil mayakkaviyal vallunar 'pāyil' eṉpavar vaṭivamitta karuvi. aṟuvic cikicciyiṉpōtu nōyāḷikku uṇarvu illā niliyi uṇṭākkuvataṟkum, avarukkut tēviyāṉa pirāṇa vāyuvit taruvataṟkum payaṉpaṭum karuvi.

Boyle's law : pāyiliṉ viti : “oru vāyuviṉ kaṉa aḷavu atikarittāl ataṉ aḻuttam kuṟiyum. vāyuviṉ aḻuttam atikarittāl ataṉ kaṉaaḷavu kuṟiyum" eṉpatu pāyiliṉ viti. iṅkilāntu iyaṟpiyalāḷar rāparṭ pāyil eṉpavar inta vitiyik kaṇṭupiṭittār.

brachial : mēṟki cārnta : mēṟki maṇṭalattiluḷḷa nāḷaṅkaḷ kaḻuttiṉ aṭiyiluḷḷa narampup piṉṉal ākiyavaṟṟi itu kuṟikkiṟatu.

brille : pireyli muṟi; pārvi aṟṟōr paṭippu : ḵpirāṉs nāṭṭiṉ pārviyiḻanta kalviyāḷar lūyis pireyli eṉpavar, pārviyaṟṟavarkaḷ vācippataṟkum, eḻutuvataṟkum kaṇṭupiṭitta oru paṭippu muṟi.

bronchoscope : mūccukkuḻāy nōkki; cuvācak kuḻal nōkki : turiyīraliṉ uḷpakutikaḷik kāṇpataṟkup payaṉpaṭum karuvi. itaṉ utaviyāl nuriyīralilum mūccukkuḻāykaḷilum uḷḷa curappu nīrkaḷiyum anniyap poruḷkaḷiyum veḷiyēṟṟa iyalum, nuriyīralilum mūccuk kuḻāykaḷilum uḷḷa nōykaḷi uṟuti ceyvataṟku aṅkuḷḷa ticukkaḷi ciṟitaḷavu veṭṭi eṭuttup paricōtaṉikku aṉuppavum ikkaruvi payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

eosiophil : civappūtāc cāya uyiraṇu : civappūtāc cāyam ēṟkum uyiraṇukkaḷ.

epicanthus : kaṭikkaṇ maṟippu; kaṇmūli maṭippu : kaṭik kaṇṇiṉ uṭpuṟatti maṟikkum tōl vaḷarcci. itu piṟaviyilēyē uṇṭākiṟatu.

epilepsy : kākkāy valippu; valippu nōy; icivu nōy : mūḷi oru kaṇippoṟi pōṉṟatu. kaṇippoṟi pōlavē, mūḷi aṇukkaḷ oṉṟōṭoṉṟu iṇikkappaṭṭaḷḷaṉa. miṉṉaṇu vēkattil uṭaliṉ ellāp pakutikaḷukkum toṭarpu koḷkiṉṟaṉa. cila vēḷikaḷil mūḷiyil vaḻakkattiṟku māṟāka atircci ēṟpaṭukiṉṟaṉa. itaṉi 'valippu' eṉkiṟōm, mūḷiyiliruntu kaṭṭukkaṭaṅkāmal miṉkānta āṟṟal veḷippaṭum pōtu inta valippu uṇṭākiṟatu. mūḷi virivilēyē iyalpunilikku vantuviṭuvatāl valippu nōyāḷikaḷ iyalpāka enta nōyk kuṟikaḷum teṉpaṭuvatilli. valippu nōyil palavakikaḷ uṇṭu cāppiṭumpōtu valippu vantāl atu 'cāppāṭṭu valippu (Eating epilepsy) eṉappaṭum; cirikkumpōtu ēṟpaṭum valippu (Laughing epilepsy) ākum; cilar vennīrit toṭṭāl valippu varum atu "vennīr valippu".

innōyāḷikaḷ ūrtikaḷ oṭṭuvatiyum, āṟu, kuḷaṅkaḷil kuḷippatiyum, vaṉmuṟik kāṭcikaḷ niṟinta tirippaṭaṅkaḷiyum, tolik kāṭci nikaḻccikaḷiyum pārppatiyum, kūriyamuṉikaḷi uṭiya poruḷkaḷik kiyāḷvatit tavirppatu nallatu. naṉku uṟaṅkutal, camaccīruṇavu uṇṇutal, kuṟippiṭṭa maruttuvak kavaṉippu, ciṟanta poḻutu pōkku ākiyavi mikunta nalaṉ payakkum.

epileptic : kākkāy valippu nōyāḷi; valippu nōyāḷi : kākkāy valippu nōyuṭiyavar. epileptiform : pōli kākkāy valippu : kākkāy valippu allatu ataṉ aṟikuṟikaḷi ottirukkiṟatu.

episclera : kaṇ iṇipput ticu; viḻiveḷippaṭala mēluṟi : kaṇveḷik kōḷattiṉ puṟattōlukkum, imi iṇip paṭalattiṟkumiṭiyilāṉa taḷarvāṉa iṇipput ticu.

Erb's area : erp maṇṭalam : mārpelumpup pakkak kiḷiyākavuḷḷa mūṉṟāvatu iṭatu iṭiveḷi potuvāka iraṇṭāvatu peruntamaṉi maṇṭalam eṉa aḻikkappaṭukiṟatu. jermaṉ maruttuva aṟiñar vilhelm erp peyarāl aḻikkappaṭukiṟatu. inta iṭattil peruntamaṉiyiṉ virikuruti aḻutta muṇu muṇuppu naṉku kēṭkiṟatu. Erb's palsy : erp muṭakkuvātam : tōḷ, puyam ākiyavaṟṟiṉ tacikaḷil ēṟpaṭum pakka vātam. aintāvatu āṟāvatu kaḻuttu narampu vērkaḷil uṇṭākum puṇ kāraṇamāka itu ēṟpaṭukiṟatu. itaṉāl puyam ceyaliḻantu toṅkum. perumpālum piṟaviyilēyē ēṟpaṭum kāyattiṉāl itu uṇṭākiṟatu.

Erb's paralysis : erp muṭakku vātam : tōḷ, kittacik kuḻumattil ēṟpaṭum muṭakku vātam. aintāvatu, āṟāvatu mutukuttaṇṭu narampukaḷiṉ kaḻuttu vērppakutikaḷil itu uṇṭākiṟatu. jermaṉ narampi yalaṟiñar vilhelm erp peyarāl aḻikkappaṭukiṟatu.

erectile : nimirttakkūṭiya; virikkakkūṭiya; virikkum : viṟip pākki eḻuppak kūṭiya tika.

eruption : pokkuḷam; tōl koppuḷam : tiṭīr veṭippu, paru. pal vakiyil īṟṟiṉi ūṭuruvi ēṟpaṭum veṭippu.

Erysichthon syndrome : ericiktōṉ nōy; kuṇṭōtarap paci : aḷavukkumīṟiya itayattuṭippu, aṭaṅkāta paci, kaṇṭa uṇavukaḷi uṇṇum vēṭki ākiyavi uṇṭākum oru nilimi. kirēkkap purāṇattil varum kuṇṭōtaraṉ tīrāp paciyuṭiya oru katāppāttirat tiṉ peyarāl inta nōy aḻikkappaṭukiṟatu.

Erythrocin : eritrōciṉ : eritrōmiciṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

erythroblast: mutirācivappaṇu : mutirāniliyiluḷḷa irattac civappaṇu. karumiyamuṭiya civappaṇu.

erythroblastemic : mutirācivappaṇu mikuti : karumiyamuṭiya mutirāc civappu aṇukkaḷ aḷavukku atikamāka iruttal.

insulin-dependent diabetes mellitus (IDDM) : iṉculiṉ cārpu nīriḻivu nōy : kuḻanti paruvattil ūci mūlam iṉculiṉ maruntu vaḻakkamākac celuttappaṭa vēṇṭiya nīriḻivu nōy.

insulin preparations : iṉculiṉ tayārippukaḷ : virivākac ceyaṟ paṭum naṭuttaramākac ceyaṟpaṭum eṉpiec aicōḵpēṉ, nīṇṭa kālam ceyaṟpaṭak kūṭiya (purōṭṭō miṉ tuttanāka iṉculiṉ-PZI) pōṉṟa iṉculiṉ tayārippukaḷ. tūymiyākkiya pōrciṉ, ākṭirāppiṭ, iṉcalāṭṭārṭ, miksṭārṭ ākiyavi maṉita iṉculiṉ.

insulin pump : iṉculiṉ iṟippāṉ : tāḻnta nilikaḷiṉ oḻuṅkāṉa vītattil iṉculiṉ vaḻaṅkum, uḷḷē poruttak kūṭiya cātaṉam.

insulin-regulatable glucose transporter (GRT) : iṉculiṉ cārnta kuḷukkōs aṉuppīṭṭuc cātaṉam : iṉculiṉ tūṇṭutal kāraṇamāka ticuppāymac cavviliruntu kurutinīrc cavvukku iṭam peyakkiṟa taciyiluḷḷa oru puratam maṟṟum koḻuppu, itaṉāl uyiraṇukkuḷ kuḷukkōs pāyvatu atikarikkiṟatu.

insulin resistance : iṉculiṉ etirppu : iṉculiṉ uṭaliyal aḷavukkāṉa ukanta aḷavut tulaṅkali veḷippaṭuttum nili. itu cuṟṟōṭṭamākac cellum kuḷukkōkāṉ allatu iṉculiṉ ēṟpip paṟṟākkuṟi kāraṇamāka ēṟpaṭalām.

insulin shock : iṉculiṉ atircci : iṉculiṉi aḷavukku mikutiyākac celuttuvatāl iyalpāṉa mūḷic ceyaṟpāṭṭukkut tēviyāṉati viṭa mikutiyākak kurutik kuḷukkōs kuṟipāṭu ēṟpaṭutal.

insulin tolerance test : iṉculiṉ tāṅkutiṟaṉ cōtaṉi : iṉcu liṉip payaṉpaṭuttik koḷvataṟkāṉa uṭaliṉ tiṟaṉi aṟivataṟkāṉa cōtaṉi, kurutiyiluḷḷa kuḷukkōs aḷavu iṉculiṉ celutti avvappōtu aḷaviṭappaṭukiṟatu. kuruti kuḷukkōs aḷavu 30 nimiṭattil kuṟintu, 90 nimiṭattukkup piṟaku mīṇṭum iyalpu nilikkut tirumpu kiṟatu. kālciyam kuṟipāṭuḷḷa nōyāḷikaḷiṭam kaḷukkōs kuṟiyum aḷavu kuṟivākavum iyalpu nilikkut tirumpum nēram kuṟivākavum irukkum.

insulinoma : miki iṉculiṉ curappu : iṉculiṉi aḷavukku atikamākac curakkum lāṅkar hāṉs tīvukaḷiṉ pīṭṭā uyiraṇukkaḷil ēṟpaṭum kaṭṭi itaṉāl, kurutiyil kuḷukkōs aḷavu kaṇicamākak kuṟintu mayakkanili ēṟpaṭum.

jēkcaṉ peyarāl aḻikkappaṭukiṟatu. iru tarappāṉatacit tuṭippu acivukaḷ ēṟpaṭum. inta acivukaḷ oru tacik kuḻumattil toṭaṅki paṭippaṭiyāka aṭuttuḷḷa kuḻumattukkup paravukiṟatu. itu kākkāy valippu naṭavaṭikki, kaṭṭaḷi mūḷi mēluṟi mūlamāka vāy, kaṭṭi viral, pātam ākiyavaṟṟukku nakarvatik kuṟikkiṟatu. intap pātippu, cila viṉāṭikaḷ mutal pala maṇinēram vari māṟupaṭṭa kālattukku nīṭikkalām.

lymphangiolemyomatosis (LAM) : niṇanīrt tamaṉi nōy : mika aritākap pīṭikkum tamaṉi nōy. itaṉāl, mirutuvāṉa taci pōṉṟa uyiraṇukkaḷ aḷavukkumīṟi paravum. itaṉāl, kāṟṟuppuḻikaḷ, niṇanīr nāḷaṅkaḷ iratta nāḷaṅkaḷ ākiyavaṟṟil taṭi ēṟpaṭum. itu, kuḻantipeṟum vayatu uṭiya iḷam peṇkaḷip pātikkum.

lymphanigoplasty : niṇanīr nāḷa māṟṟu maruttuvam; vaṭinīrk kuḻal amippu : niṇanīr nāḷaṅkaḷukkup patilāka ceyaṟki nāḷaṅkaḷip poruttutal.

lymphagnitis : niṇanīr nāḷa aḻaṟci; niṇak kuḻalaḻaṟci : niṇanīr nāḷaṅkaḷ allatu nāḷaṅkaḷ vīkkamaṭital

lymphagitis : niṇanīr nāḷa vīkkam; vaṭinīrk kuḻal aḻaṟci.

lymphatic : niṇanīr cārnta.

lymphatic gland : niṇanīr curappi.

lymphatic : niṇa.

lymphatic vessel : niṇanīr nāḷam. lymph node : niṇanīr tīcut tiraṭci; niṇakkaṇu : niṇanīr nāḷaṅkaḷiṉ vaḻiyiluḷḷa niṇanīrt ticukkaḷi tiraṭci aṭital.

lymphoblast : niṇanīr ticu muṉṉōṭip poruḷ; niṇa muṉṉaṇu : mutircciyaṭinta niṇa nīrt ticukkaḷiluḷḷa pala ciṟiya veḷḷik kurutiyaṇukkaḷil oṉṟil irukkum mutircciyaṭiyāta muṉṉōṭip poruḷ.

lymphocyte : veḷḷik kuruti aṇu; niṉavaṇu : oru karumiyam uḷ veḷḷiyaṇu, itu aṭarnta vaṇṇaccāyaluṭaṉ irukkum. itil aṭarttiyāṉa kurōmāṭṭiṉ, veḷiṟiya niṟamuṭiya ticuppasmam aṭaṅki irukkum. itu, "B", "T" veḷḷik kurutiyaṇukkaḷ eṉap pakukkappaṭṭuḷḷaṉa. ivi muṟiyē uṭal nīriyal, uyiraṇu ēmakkāppukkuk kāraṇamāṉaviyākum.

lymphoedema : niṇanīr iḻima aḻaṟci : niṇanīrt tēkkattiṉāl piḷavukaḷiluḷḷa tiravam tiraḷvataṉ kāraṇamāka kikāl pakutikaḷil kaṭumiyāṉa iḻima aḻaṟci uṇṭātal.

lymphocytosis : veḷḷik kurutiyaṇup perukkam : irattattil iyalpāṉa veḷḷik kurutiyaṇukkaḷiṉ eṇṇikki atikarittal.

Iymphography : niṇanīrnāḷa ūṭukatirppaṭam : niṇanīr nāḷattil oppīṭṭu ūṭakattic celuttuvatit toṭarntu niṇanīrnāḷaṅkaḷiyum, niṇa nīrttiraḷkaḷiyum ūṭukatirp paṭam eṭuttal.

lymphoma : niṇanīrt ticukkaṭṭi; vaṭinīrp puttu : niṇanīrt ticukkaḷil uṇṭākum kaṭumi illāta kaṭṭi itu, niṇanīrk karaṇikaḷiliruntu uṇṭākiṟatu.

lymphorrhoea : niṇanīr miki veḷiyēṟṟam : palvēṟu niṇa nīrnāḷaṅkaḷiliruntu niṇanīr mikutiyāka veḷiyēṟutal.

lymphomatoid granulomatosis : niṇanīrt ticukkaṭṭi : nuriyīral, kiṟunīrakam, tōl, miya narampu maṇṭalam ākiyavaṟṟip pātikkum oru cuṟṟōṭṭak kōḷāṟu. itu ēmakkāppu aṭakkac cikicci mūlam kuṇappaṭuttap paṭukiṟatu.

lymphomatosis : paṉmuka nīrt ticukkaṭṭi : uṭaliṉ palvēṟu pakutikaḷil paṉmuka niṇanīr ticukkaṭṭikaḷ uṇṭātal.

lymphopenia : veḷḷik kurutiyaṇuk kuṟipāṭu : irat tattil veḷḷiyaṇukkaḷ kuṟinta eṇṇikkiyil iruttal.

lymphorrhagin : mikiniṇanīrk kacivu : niṇanīr aṇṭakōcattil uruvākiyuḷḷa kumiḻkaḷiliruntu niṇanīr perumaḷavil veḷiyēṟutal.

lymphosarcoma : niṇanīrtticuk kaḻali; niṇanīr ticupputtu : niṇa nīrtticukkaḷil uṇṭākum ukkiramāṉa kaṭṭi.

lymph scrotum : niṇanīr aṇṭa kōcam : aṇṭakōcattiṉ tōl cārnta niṇanīriṉ virivākkam neḷitiṟaṉ eṉṟa vakiyil kāṇappaṭum iḻi oṭṭuṇṇi nili. itu aṇṭakōcat tōliṉ oṭṭu mottac curuḷ maṭippuṭaṉ toṭarpuṭiyatu.

lyophile : ūṭukavappu.

lyophilization : uṟiporuḷ; ūṭukavappu : mika atikamāṉa veṟṟiṭattil uṟintirukkum poruḷ virivāka uṟital, nīrvaṭital kāraṇamāka or uṟutiyāṉa uyiriyal poruḷ uṟpattiyātal.

lysine : liciṉ : vaḷarccikkut tēviyāṉa iṉṟiyamiyāta amiṉō amilaṅkaḷil oṉṟu.

lysis : aḻivu; mīṉ nili.

Lysol : nōyt toṟṟal taṭuppu ney : naccuttaṭi maruntākap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum nīril kariyattakka cavarkkāra neyk kalavi vaki. itu cavarkkārak karicalil aṭaṅkiyuḷḷa 50% kiricōl.

lysosome : licōcim : nuṇṇiya cavvu iḻi cūḻntuḷḷa ticuppāyma uyiraṇu uṟuppu. itil palvēṟu cīraṇac cerimāṉap poruḷkaḷ aṭaṅki uḷḷa uyiraṇukkaḷil irukkum.

lysozyme : licōcim : nōyk kirumikaḷi etirkkakkūṭiya aṭip paṭic cerimāṉap poruḷ (eṉcim). itu kaṇṇīr, eccil pōṉṟa uṭal tiravaṅkaḷil aṭaṅkiyuḷḷatu.





mūḷik kirumiyiliruntu uruvākum oru periya, aciyāta, iṉapperukka uyiraṇu.

macroglobulin : atīta kuruti vaṭinīrp puratam : oru periya kuruti vaṭi nīrppuratam. paṉmuka elumpu maccip puṟṟu, elumpuppuratak kōḷāṟukaḷ, īral taṭippu, amilāyṭ tiraṭci nōy ākiya nōykaḷiṉ pōtu itaṉ aḷavu atikamāka irukkum.

macroglobulinemia : atīta kurutit tacip puratam : kurutiyil pēraḷavut tacippuratam iruttal itu kurutiyiṉ kuḻimattiṟaṉi atikarikkiṟatu.

macroglossia : perunākku; perunā; peru nāviyam : aḷavukku mīṟip peritākavuḷḷa nākku.

macromania : uṟuppup perukkam : mikapperiya uṭaluṟuppukaḷik koṇṭirukkum tiripu nili.

macromastia : peru mārpakam; peru muli : mārpakam aḷavukku mīṟi peritāka iruttal.

macromolecule : mūlakkūṟu perukkam : puratam, carkkaric cērmam, mīccērmam pōṉṟa periya mūlakkūṟu.

macronucleoli : miyakkaru virivaṭital : ciṟunīrakappuṟṟu, mār pakappuṟṟu, kēṭayaccurappup puṟṟu, ukkiramāṉa karum puṟṟu, hāṭkiṉ nōy pōṉṟa cila ukkiramāṉa nōykaḷiṉ pōtu miyakkarukkaḷ virivaṭintiruttal, ticuk kōḷāṟiṉ pōtu itu kāṇappaṭukiṟatu.

macronucleus : karumiya ākkiramippu : uyiraṇuviṉ perum pakutiyi karumiyam ākkiramit tiruttal.

macrophages : oṟṟikkaru uyiraṇukkaḷ; peruviḻuṅkaṇu : ayalporuḷkaḷiyum, uyiraṇuc citivukaḷiyum akaṟṟit tupparavu ceyyum uyiraṇukkaḷ.

macrophthalmia : kaṇviḻip perukkam : kaṇviḻi iyalpu mīṟip peritāka iruttal.

macroscopic : kaṇṇukkup pulaṉākiṟa : veṟṟuk kaṇkaḷukkap pulaṉākiṟa.

macrotome : uṟuppu veṭṭuk karuvi : periya uṭal uṭ kūṟuppakutikaḷi veṭṭuvataṟkup payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum oru karuvi.

macula : puḷḷi; poṭṭu; maṟu; viḻittirippuḷḷi; karuviḻit taḻumpu :tōlil niliyāka uḷḷa maṟu. kaṇ viḻippiṉ puṟattiriyil uḷḷa mañcaḷ puḷḷi.

macule : tiṭṭu. maculopathy : karuviḻippuḷḷi māṟṟam : kaṇṇiṉ viḻittirip puḷḷiyip pātikkum nōykkuṟi māṟutalkaḷ.

mad cow disease : pacu veṟi nōy : pacukkaḷukku ēṟpaṭum mūḷiyip pātikkum mūḷi vīkka nōy.

madarosis : puruvamayir iḻappu : puruvaṅkaḷ allatu kaṇṇimi mayirkaḷi iḻattal.

madecassol : mēṭikkācōl : elumpup purata uṟpattiyit tūṇṭi nōyik kuṇappaṭutta utavum kaḷimpu maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

Madelung's disease : mēṭilaṅk nōy : neñcukkūṭṭiṉ piṉ pakutiyiṉ mēṟpuṟam, tōḷkaḷ, kaḻuttukaḷ ākiyavaṟṟiṉ mītu potu iyalpāṉa oru cīrāṉa perutta ticukkaḷ paṭintiruttal. jermaṉ aṟuvi maruttuva vallunar āṭṭō mēṭilaṅk peyarāl aḻikkap paṭukiṟatu.

madribon : mēṭripōṉ : cal ḵpāṭi mettōkciṉ maruntu.

madura foot : maturip pātam; maturit tāḷ : intiyāvilum veppa maṇṭala nāṭukaḷilum pātattil ēṟpaṭum pūñcaṇa nōy. itaṉāl vīkkam uṇṭāki karaṇikaḷum, uṭpurip puṇkaḷum ēṟpaṭum. iṟutiyil kuruti naccuppāṭu uṇṭāki maraṇam viḷiyum. kuṇappaṭutta antap pātatti veṭṭa vēṇṭum.

magenta tongue : oṇ civappu nākku : nākku aṭar civappiliruntu karuñcivappu niṟattil iruttal. ripōḵpiḷēviṉ paṟṟākkuṟi kāraṇamāka meṉmiyāṉa nākku ivvitam tōṉṟum.

maggot : īḻum puḻu.

magnesium carbonate : makṉīciyam kārpoṉēṭ : irippip puṇṇiṉ pōtu, vayiṟṟup puḷippakaṟṟum pēti maruntākap payaṉpaṭum oru tūḷ maruntu.

magnesium hydroxide : makṉīciyam hiṭrākciṭu : mikavum payaṉuḷḷa vayiṟṟup puḷippakaṟṟum maruntu malamiḷakku maruntu. itu veṟum vayiṟṟil nīrtta karicalākak koṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. tōl vīkkattiṟku itaṉ 25% karicalik koṇṭu oṟṟaṭam koṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. koppuḷaṅkaḷ, aracapiḷavikaḷ ākiyavaṟṟukku kiḷicariṉuṭaṉ kalanta kuḻampu maruntākap pūcappaṭukiṟatu. uṭalil makṉīciyam kuṟipāṭu iruntāl, ūci mūlam uṭalil celuttappaṭukiṟatu.

magnesium trisilicate : makṉīciyam ṭiricilikkēṭ : meṉmi yāṉa, vayiṟṟup puḷippakaṟṟum taṉmiyuṭiya tūḷ maruntu; cuviyaṟṟatu; veṇṇiṟamāṉatu. irippip puṇṇukkup perumaḷavu payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

magnetic resonance imaging : kānta nāṭi atirvu urukkāṭci : uṭaliṉ vaḻiyē melliya kaṇṭaṅkaḷip paricōtippataṟkāka urukkāṭcip pulattiyum katiriya aliveṇ cikikaḷiyum uṇṭākkum aṇu kānta nāṭi utti. itil ūṭu katir (eks-rē) payaṉpaṭuttap paṭuvatilli. ataṉāl uṭalil pakka viḷivukaḷ ēṟpaṭuvatilli.

magnetic resonance MR : kānta nāṭi atirvu em.ār : oru niliyāṉa kāntap pulam, poruttamāṉa nāṭi atirvu veṇ kāntapulattiṉ mūlam tūṇṭappaṭṭapiṉpu antak kāntap pulattiluḷḷa miyak karuviṉāl veḷiyiṭappaṭum miṉkānta viciyi īrttuk koḷḷutal allatu veḷippaṭuttutal.

magnetotherapy : kānta maruttuvam : nōykaḷik kuṇappaṭut tuvataṟkuk kāntaṅkaḷip payaṉ paṭuttutal.

magnum : perumpuḻi; periya : taliyōṭṭiṉ piṉ elumpiluḷḷa perumpuḻi pōṉṟa periya puḻi.

magor : periya; vayatiṉa.

major affective disorder : kaṭum uḷaviyal nōy : uḷaviyal kōḷāṟukaḷiṉ oru kuḻumattic cērnta oru nōy. itaṉāl kaṭumiyāṉa maṟṟum poruttamaṟṟa uṇarvut tulaṅkalkaḷ, maṉappōkkil nīṇṭa kāla maṟṟum iṭiviṭāta kuḻappaṅkaḷ, maṉaccōrvu allatu pittanili pōṉṟa piṟa nōykkuṟikaḷ tōṉṟukiṉṟaṉa.

major basic protein : uyiraṇu mikip puratam : civappu ūtāc cāya uyiraṇu mikik kuruṇikaḷil kāṇappaṭum puratam itu mūccuk kuḻāy tōliḻimac cētam uṇṭākkukiṟatu. itu īḷi nōyuṭaṉ (āstumā) toṭarpuṭiyatu.

major surgery : periya aṟuvi maruttuvam : potu uṇarcci nīkkam allatu ceyaṟkic cuvāca utavi pōṉṟavi tēvippaṭum oru aṟuvi maruttuva ceymuṟi.

mal : nōy; kēṭu.

malabsorption : vayiṟṟup pōkku akattuṟiñcāmi; uḷḷuṟiñcu tiṟaṉaṟṟa; uḷḷīrppuk kēṭu; kuṟi uṟiñcuki : kuḻantikaḷukkāṉa uṇavu ceritta piṉ kuṭal uṟiñcikaḷāl uṟiñcappaṭāta niliyil appaṭiyē tirava malamāka veḷiyēṟutalāl ēṟpaṭum vayiṟṟup pōkku purataccattu. māp poruḷkaḷ, koḻuppuc cattu ivaṟṟiṉ vikitam atikarittālum itu uṇṭākalām.

maladjustment : uṟuppamitik kēṭu : uṭal uṟuppukaḷ poruttamiṉṟi amintiruttal.

malise : uṭalnalak kuṟipāṭu; uṭaliyakkac cōrvu; cukakkēṭu; vāṭṭam : evvita nōyum illāmalēyē uṭal nalam kuṉṟiya nili.

małalignment : teṟṟuppal : paṟkkaḷ oru cīrāka irāmal oḻuṅ kiṉṟi amintiruttal.

malar : kaṉṉa elumpu : kaṉṉattukkuriya elumpu.

malaricidal : malēriyā oṭṭuṇṇik kolli : malēriyā oṭ ṭuṇṇiyik kollum kuṇa muṭiya.

malaria : muṟikkāyccal (malēriyā) : veppa maṇṭalap pakutikaḷil uṇṭākum uṭal nalattiṟkak kēṭu viḷivikkum. malik kuḷir kāyccal. itu 'aṉōḵpilis' eṉṉum kocuviṉāl uṇṭākiṟatu.

malariologist : muṟikkāyccal vallunar; malēriyā nōy val lunar; malēriyaviyalār : muṟik kāyccal maruttuvattil vallunar.

malassimilation : cemittal kōḷāṟu; cerimāṉak kēṭu : uṇavu cemippatil ēṟpaṭum kōḷāṟu.

Malatex : mālāṭṭeks : ḵpurōppilīṉ kiḷikkōl eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

maldevelopment : kuṟi vaḷarcci.

malformation : kuṟi amivu; uṭal tiripu; iyalpilā vaḷarcci; vaṭivak kēṭu; ukkira vēkam : uṭal kaṭṭamippu iyalpu mīṟit tiripaṭintiruttal; poruttamillā uruva amippu: uṭal ceppak kēṭu.

malignancy : ukkira vēkam : nōy vakiyil tuṉpam viḷi vikkum tīvirat taṉmi.

malignant : ukkiramāṉa; koṭiya; vīriya : nōy vakiyil ukkira māṉa, vēkamākat toṟṟip paravukiṟa kēṭu viḷivikkiṟa.

malingeres : nōyppacappu.

malingering : nōyp pācāṅku : nōy nili nīṭippatāka naṭittuk kaṭamiyit taṭṭik kaḻikka muyaltal.

malleable : vaḷintu koṭuttal; vaḷiyak kūṭiya : aḻuttat tiṉāl vaṭivatti uruvākkum iyalpuṭiya. malleolus : kaṇu elumpu

malleus : kātiṉ cutti elumpu : kātuc cavviṉ atircciyi uṭ kātukkuḷ ūṭuparava viṭum elumpup pakuti.

Mallory bodies : māllōri uḷtukaḷkaḷ : īral uyiraṇuk kaḷiluḷḷa kurutic cevvaṇut ticuppāyma uḷ tukaḷkaḷ. ivi kaṭumiyāṉa ālkakālil īral kāyattil kāṇappaṭukiṉṟaṉa. amerikka nōyiyalaṟiñar ḵpirāṅk mallōri peyarāl aḻik kappaṭukiṟatu.

Mallory-Weiss syndrome : māllōri-veyis nōy : uṇavuk kuḻāyiṉ kīḻ nuṉiyil allatu irippi-uṇavuk kuḻāy cantippil ēṟpaṭum caḷiccavvuk kiḻical, itu kuṟippākak kuṭikārarkaḷiṭam kaṭum vānti uṇṭākum pōtu ēṟpaṭum. itaṉāl kurutip pōkku uṇṭākum. itu amerikka nōyiyal aṟiñar keṉt māllōri, amerikka maruttuva aṟiñar cōmā veyis ākiyōr peyarāl aḻikkappaṭukiṟatu.

malnutrition : ūṭṭaccattuk kuṟipāṭu; ūṭṭak kuṟi; kuṟi yūṭṭam; ūṭṭakkēṭu : cattuk kuṟivāṉa uṇavu uṭṭac cattup paṟṟākkuṟi.

malocclusion : muraṇtāṭi : tāṭikaḷi mūṭum pōtu mel tāṭip paṟkaḷum kīḻt tāṭip paṟkaḷum muṟiyāka oṉṟiṇiyāmal iruttal.

Malpighian body : mālpikiyaṉ uḷtukaḷ : 1. pōmaṉ poti yuṟiyil aṭikkappaṭṭuḷḷa oru naramputtiraḷi uḷḷaṭakkiya ciṟunīrakak kurutiyaṇu, 2. maṇṇiraliluḷḷa niṇanīrk karaṉi.

Malpighian layer : mālpikiyaṉ aṭukku : mēltōl uḷaṭukku atāvatu, perumūḷi uyir ﻿aṇukkaḷ, muṉ uyiraṇukkaḷ ākiyavaṟṟik koṇṭuḷḷa or uyiriluḷḷa uyiraṇukkūṟu.

malposition : nili māṟupāṭu; uṟuppu nili māṟṟam : or uṟuppu iyalpukku mīṟi nili piṟaḻntiruttal.

malpractice : oḻuṅkaṟṟa maruttuvam; tavaṟāṉa maruttuvam; muṟi yilā maruttuvam : oḻukkakkēṭāṉa allatu tīṅku ceyyak kūṭiya muṟiyil maruttuvat toḻil naṭattutal.

malpresentation : mutirkaru muṉippu; kuli piṟappu : iṭuppuk kūṭṭiṉuḷ mutirkaru vaḻakkattiṟku māṟāka muṉintiruttal.

malrotation : kuli cuḻaṟci.

maltose : māvellam : māvūṟaliliruntu eṭukkappaṭum carkkari.

malt worker's lung : māvūṟal toḻilāḷar nuriyīral : pūñci piṭippuḷḷa ularpul, parli ākiyavaṟṟiluḷ āsperkillas kiḷāvaṭṭas, ē. ḵpiyūmikēṭṭas ākiyavaṟṟiṉ nuṇtukaḷkaḷukku mikiyuṇarvu kāraṇamāka ēṟpaṭum puṟa iyakka ovvāmi nuriyīral kaṇṇaṟi vīkkam.

myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) : veṇpuṟṟu nōy : elumpumacciyil ēṟpaṭum patippuvākkapparaval kōḷāṟukaḷiṉ oru kuḻumam. itil veḷippuṟak kurutiyil oṉṟu ataṟku mēṟpaṭṭa uyiraṇu varicikaḷiṉ kurutiyaṇup paṟṟākkuṟiyum, elumpumacciyil māṟutalkaḷum uṇṭākum. ivi kaṭumiyāṉa niṇanīr cārāta veṇpuṟṟāka māṟum.

Nightingale Ward : niṭṭiṅkēl kūṭam : maruttuvamaṉiyiluḷḷa oru cevvakamāṉa nōyāḷar paṭukkik kūṭam. itil 30-36 nōyāḷikaḷukkāṉa paṭukkikaḷ, caṉṉalkaḷukkiṭiyilāṉa cuvarkaḷiṉ neṭukil amikkappaṭṭirukkum.

nightmare : iravu araṭṭu.

nigral : narampuuyiraṇu : "caps ṭāṉṣiyānikrā" eṉpataṉ narampu uyiraṇu,

nigilism : cūṉiyavātam/etir maṟuppu vātam : camaya oḻukkat tuṟikaḷil naṭimuṟi nampikkik kōṭpāṭukaḷ aṉittiyum maṟukkum koḷki. aḻivuc ceyalkaḷil īṭupaṭutal.

nigilistic delusion : cūṉiyavāta maruṭci : tāṉ, maṟṟavarkaḷ ulakil illāmalirukkiṟatu allatu muṭiyappōkiṟatu eṉṟa poyyāṉa uṇarvu.

nikethamide : nikkettamiṭu : mūccaṭippu mayakkattiṉ pōtu payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum miya narampu maṇṭalattit tūṇṭum maruntu. itaṉi narampu ūci allatu taci mūlam koṭukkalām.

Nikolsky's sign : nikkōlski nōy : tōli ilēcāka aḻuttiṉālum, iyalpāṉa mēl tōl, īramāṉa kiyil rappar kiyuṟi nakarvatupōl nakartal. itu nīrkkoppuḷat tōl nōyiṉ aṟikuṟiyākum.

Nilodin : nilōṭiṉ : lukkāntōṉ eṉṉum maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

nipple : mulikkāmpu; kāmpu : mārpakattiṉ miyattiluḷḷa kūmpu vaṭivak kumiḻ. itaṟkaṭiyil pāl curakkum nāḷaṅkaḷ amintirukkum.

niridazole : nitiṭācōl : kaṭumiyāṉa kuruti uṟikaṭṭi ﻿nōykkuk koṭukkappaṭum oru maruntu. itu vēḷi maruntākap pakukkappaṭṭu 12 maṇi nēra iṭiveḷikaḷil koṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. puṟa nōyāḷikaḷukkum itik koṭukkalām. iti uṭ koḷvatāl, ciṟunīr aṭar paḻuppu niṟattilirukkum eṉṟu nōyāḷikaḷi eccarippatu nallatu.

nit : pēṉ muṭṭi; īṟu : īr oṭṭuṇṇi iṉavakikaḷiṉ muṭṭi.

nitinal : niṭṭiṉāl : niṉivu ulōkam. nikkalum ṭiṭṭē ṉiyamum iṇinta ulōkak kalavi. itu taṉatu paṇpiyalpukaḷi niṉivil vittuk koḷkiṟatu. eṭuttukkāṭṭāka, oru kuṟippiṭṭa veppa niliyil oru niṭṭiṉāl curuḷ tayārikkappaṭṭa piṉṉar atu muṟukkappaṭukiṟatu allatu ataṉ vaṭivu nīṅkum aḷavukku nīṭṭappaṭukiṟatu eṉṟāl, atē veppa nilikku mīṇṭum cūṭākkumpōtu atu taṉatu paḻiya curuḷ vaṭivukku mīṇṭum tirumpiviṭum. itaṉip palvēṟu vakiyil payaṉpaṭuttalām. itaṉik koṇṭu paṟkuḻikaḷi nirappalām. vātanōyik kuṇappaṭutta ūṉṟu poruḷākap payaṉpaṭuttalām. iṉṟiyamiyāt tamaṉikaḷil valic caṭṭaṅkaḷākap porutti kurutik kaṭṭukaḷit taṭukkalām. viṇveḷi maṟṟum irāṇuvap payaṉpāṭukaḷukkum itu ēṟṟatu.

nitrazepam : niṭrāspām : peṉcōṭiyāspiṉ vakiyic cērnta tuyiluraṭṭum maruntu. inta marunti uṭ koḷḷum cilarukku virivāṉa kaṉavukaḷ tōṉṟak kūṭum.

nitro furantoin : niṭrō ḵpūrāṇṭāyṉ : kirām cāyam eṭukkāta kirumikaḷāl viḷiyum nōykaḷiṉ nuṇmattaṭi maruntu. ciṟunīrppi aḻaṟciyil payaṉpaṭum.

nitrofurazone : niṭrōḵpūrācōṉ : pākṭīriyā etirppu maruntu. itu veppa maṇṭalap payaṉpāṭṭukkākak kaḷimpākavum karicalākavum kiṭikkiṟatu.

nitrogen : niṭrajaṉ (veṭiyam) : vāyu maṇṭalattiluḷḷa vāyu kaḷil aintil nāṉku pakutiyākavuḷḷa vāyut taṉimam. itaṉi maṉitar nēraṭiyākap payaṉpaṭutta muṭiyātu. eṉiṉum maṇṇilum payaṟu iṉacceṭi kaḷiṉ vērkaḷilum uḷḷa cila uyirikaḷ, niṭjaṉi nilip paṭuttum tiṟaṉuṭiyavi. itu puratam pōṉṟa palvēṟu uyiraṇut tuṇipporuḷ kaḷukkum, purata uṇavukaḷukkum iṉṟiyamiyātatākum. nitrogen balance : niṭrajaṉ camanili : oruvar aṉṟāṭam uṭkoḷḷum puratattiliruntu kiṭikkum niṭrajaṉ aḷavu, avar veḷiyiṭum niṭrajaṉukkuc cama aḷavil irukkumāṉāl atu niṭrajaṉ cama nili eṉappaṭum. uṭkoḷḷum niṭrajaṉ veḷiyēṟum niṭrajaṉiviṭak kuṟivāka iruppiṉ atu etirmaṟi niṭrajaṉ camaniliyākum. ciṟunīriluḷḷa yūriyā, ammōṉiyā, kiriyēṭṭiṉiṉ ākiyavi mūlamāka niṭrajaṉ mukkiyamāka veḷiyēṟukiṟatu. motta niṭrajaṉil 10% malattiṉ vāyilāka veḷiyēṟukiṟatu.

nitrogen dilution method : niṭrajaṉ nīrttal muṟi : niliyāṉa nuriyīraliṉ kaṉa aḷavukaḷi aḷaviṭum oru muṟi.

nitroglycerin : niṭrō kiḷicariṉ : kiḷicarāl ṭiriṉiṭrēṭ toṇṭi valiyik kuṇappaṭuttuvataṟkup payaṉpaṭuttakkūṭiya kuṟukiya kālam viṉi puriyakkūṭiya kuruti nāḷa virivakaṟci maruntu.

nitrosamine : niṭrōcāmiṉ : pukiyiliyil kāṇappaṭum orupuṟṟut tūṇṭuporuḷ.

nitrosurea : niṭrōcūriya : puṟṟu etirppu maruntākap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum oru kāra muṭṭum poruḷ.

nitrous oxide : niṭras ākciṭu : itaṉic cirippu vāyu eṉṟum kūṟuvar. vāyu vaṭiva mayakka maruntākap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. itu nīlaniṟa nīḷuruḷikaḷil kiṭikkiṟatu.

nivaquine : nivākkuviṉ : kuḷōrōkkuviṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

Nobecutane : nōpikkuṭṭēṉ : kariyakkūṭiya oru ceyaṟkip piciṉiṉ vaṇikap peyar. intak karicalik kāyattil teḷittāl, atu oḷi ūruvak kūṭiya tīppaṟṟāta nekiḻvup paṭalamāka māṟukiṟatu. itu kāṟṟum nīrāviyum uṭpuka aṉumatikkiṟatu. āṉāl, pākṭīriyā uṭpuka vaḻiviṭātu.

Noble's plication : nōpiṉ tōl maṭippu : utaruṟi iṇippu kaḷi viṭuvikkavum, mīṇṭum iṇippukaḷ ēṟpaṭumpōtu taṭi etuvum ēṟpaṭāmal irukkum vakiyil neḷavariyākat tiyaliṭuvataṟkumāṉa ceyaṟpāṭṭu naṭimuṟi.

Nocardia : nōkkārṭiyā : ākcijaṉ uḷḷa iyaṅkum taṉmi illāta katirvīccup pākṭīriyākkaḷil oruvaki. ivaṟṟil viṇmīṉ vaṭiva nōkkārṭiyā, pittaḷi niṟamuṭiya nōkkārṭiyā eṉpavi nōy uṇṭākkak kūṭiyavi. ḵpireñcu kālnaṭi nōyiyalaṟiñar eṭmaṇṭ-nōkkārṭ peyarāl aḻikkappaṭukiṟatu.

nocardiosis : nōkkārṭiyā nōy : nuriyīralkaḷ, narampu maṇṭalam toṭarpuṭiya nōkkārṭiyā pākṭīriyāviṉāl uṇṭākum oru nōy.

Noludar : nāluṭar : mettip pirilōṉ eṉṟa maruntiṉ vaṇikap peyar.

noma : ticu arippu nōy : taciyaḻukal aḻaṟci vāyaḻukal nōy. vāy-mukatticukkaḷil ēṟpaṭum kaṭumiyāṉa taciyaḻukal pala nuṇṇuyiriyal maṟṟum aḻaṟcip puṇṇuṭiya nōy. itu ūṭṭaccattuk kuṟipāṭuḷḷa kuḻantikaḷiṭam kāṇappaṭukiṟatu. innōy āḻamāṉa ticukkaḷi mikavēkakamāka arittu, elumpuḷum paṟkaḷum veḷiyē teriyumpaṭi ceykiṟatu.

nomenclature : peyarttokuti : aṟiviyal etilum payaṉpaṭut tappaṭum peyarkaḷiṉ oru tokuti muṟi.

Nomina Anatomia : maruttuvap peyark kaḷañciyam : uṭkūṟiyal paṟṟiya maruttuvap peyarkaḷiṉ coṟkaḷañciya ēṭu. itaṉi paṉṉāṭṭu uṭal uṭkūṟiyal pēravi tayārittu uḷḷatu.

non-cirrhotic portal fibrosis : iṟukkamaṟṟa kallīral nārtticu aḻaṟci : iṟukkamaṟṟa uḷīral ciri mikiyaḻuttam ēṟpaṭa oru mukkiyamāṉa kāraṇam. itu irippi-kuṭal kurutip pōkku, maṇṇiral virivu ākiyavaṟṟuṭaṉ cērntu kāṇap paṭum. itil ēṟpaṭum irattap pōkkiṉik kaṭṭuppaṭutta vēṇṭum.

non-compliance : nōyāḷi tuḻiyāmi : cikicci naṭimuṟikku allatu cīruṇavu ālōcaṉikku nōyāḷi ottuḻikkat tavaṟutal.

non-Hodgkin's lymphoma : aṇutticu nōy : niṉa aṇutticukkaḷil ēṟpaṭum nōy aṇuviyal naccu etirppu maruntukaḷ itaṟkup payaṉuṭi yavi āṉāl nōykku muṉ uṭkoḷḷutal nallataṉṟu.

non-vigravida : oṉpatām karppam : oṉpatāvatu muṟiyākak karuttarittirukkum oru peṇ.

non-insulin dependent diabetes mellitus (NIDDM) : iṉculiṉ cārā nīriḻivu nōy iṉculiṉ tēvippaṭāta iraṇṭām vaki (type-II nīriḻivu nōy). non-intoxicating : pōtiyilā.

non-ionising radiation : ayaṉiyilāk katirvīccu : miṉkāntak katirvīccu. itil aṇukkaḷi ayaṉiyākkuvataṟkup pōtumāṉa āṟṟal illāta ḵpōṭṭāṉkaḷ irukkum.

non-invasive : nōyparavā maruttuvac ceyalmuṟi : tōlil ūṭuruvāta allatu uṭalukkuḷ pukāta oru maruttuvac ceyalmuṟi. nōyparavāta naṭimuṟi.

nonipara : oṉpatu kuḻanti peṟṟa tāy : oṉpatu taṭavikaḷ peṟṟa oru peṇ.

non-myelinated : macciyillā narampu iḻimam : 'miyaliṉ' eṉṟa veṇṇiṟak koḻuppup poruḷ aṭaṅkiyirāta (macciyillāta) narampu iḻimaṅkaḷ.

non-parametric : puḷḷiyiyal muṟicārnta : makkaḷ tokip pakirmāṉam kuṟittuk kaṭṭuppaṭuttiya aṉumāṉaṅkaḷ tēvippaṭāta puḷḷiyiyal muṟikaḷ.

non-photochromogen : nīḷuruḷip pākṭīriyā : veḷiṟiya mañcaḷ niṟamiyi uṟpatti ceyyat tiṟaṉillāta, potu mātiriyillāta nīḷuruḷip pākṭīriyākkaḷiṉ oru kuḻumam. itil oḷipaṭṭāl, vaṇṇam aṭarttiyāvatilli.

non-proprietary name : uṭimiyurimiyilāp peyar : oru maruntiṉ allatu cātaṉattiṉ vētiyiyal allatu potu viyalpāṉa peyar. itu uṭimiyuḷḷa aṭiyāḷap peyar allatu vaṇikak kuṟiyīṭṭiliruntu vēṟupaṭṭatu.

non-Q-wave infarction : kiyū-ali cārā ticumāḷvu : nāḷamil tuṇic curappu neñcut taciyaḻivu. itil ṭi-ali māṟṟaṅkaḷuṭaṉ cērntu iyalpu mīṟiya esṭi pakuta kuḻivu.

non-self : aṉṉiyak kāppu mūlam : uyirikku aṉṉiyāṉa kāppu mūla amippāṉkaḷ. inta amippāṉkaḷ tātunīr allatu uyiraṇu ūṭaka ēmak kāppu mūlam oḻikkappaṭukiṉṟaṉa.

non-sense mutation : ṭ.eṉ.ē mūla māṟṟam : mutircciyaṭi yāta muṉṉōṭi ār.eṉ.ē mūlakkūṟil ēṟpaṭum oṟṟi ṭi.eṉ.ē mūla māṟṟam.

non-striated muscle : aṉiccit taci : uḷḷuṟuppukaḷiṉ ceyalkiḷak kaṭṭuppaṭuttukiṟa meṉmiyāṉa (aṉicci) tacikaḷ.

non-tuberculous mycobacterial disease : kācanōy cārāta nīḷu ruḷip pākṭīriyā nōy : kāca nōy cārāta nīḷuruḷip pākṭīriyāviṉāl uṇṭākum maruttuva nōy. itu kaṭumiyāṉa nuriyīral nōykaḷ, kaḻuttu niṇanīrkkaraṇi vīkkam, tōl maṟṟum meṉ tika nōykaḷ, naṭu narampu nōykaḷ vaṭivil irukkalām.

non-ulcer dyspepsia : aḻaṟcippuṇ allāta acīraṇam : kaṭum aḻaṟcippuṇṇātal illātirukkiyil cīraṇappātip puṇ uṇṭākum nili. itaṉi, akanōkkuk karuviyil iḻima aḻaṟci, muṉ ciṟukuṭal cītac cavvu arimāṉaṅkaḷ eṉṟa nōykaḷākak kāṇalām.

non-union : iṇiyā elumpu muṟivu : oṉpatu mātaṅkaḷukku mēlāka iṇiyāmalirukkum elumpu muṟivu.

Noone's syndrome : nūṉ nōy : pōli mūḷikkōḷakkaṭṭi itil uḷmaṇṭiyōṭṭu vīkkamum, kaṇkumiḻ aḻaṟciyum kāṇappaṭum.

Nonne-Milroy's disease : nōṉ-milrāy nōy : niṇanīr nāḷam virivaṭivataṉ kāraṇa māka kālil vīkkam ēṟpaṭum kuṭumpa nōy. amerikka maruttuva aṟiñarkaḷ māks nōṉ, villiyam milrāy ākiyōr peyarāl aḻikkap paṭukiṟatu.

Noonan's syndrome : nūṉāṉ nōy : iṉakkīṟṟu cārāta ṭarṉar nōy. amerikka kuḻanti maruttuva aṟiñar jākkuliṉ nūṉāṉ itaṉi viḷakkiyurittār. itu ṭarṉar nōykku iṇiyāka āṇkaḷukku ēṟpaṭum nōy. itil kātukaḷ tāḻntirukkum; kaḻuttil tōl iḻimam potintirukkum, piṟaviyilēyē itaya nōy uṇṭākum; cila camayam kaṭumiyāṉa maṉavaḷarccik kuṟipāṭu ēṟpaṭum.

moradrenaline : nōrāṭriṉaliṉ : nōreppiṉeḵpṉaraṉ; āṭri ṉaliṉ illāta eṉ-metil kuḻumam. itu.oru parivu narampuk kaṭatti.

outbreak : nōy tiṭīr paraval : oru kuṟippiṭṭa pakutiyil oru nōyiṉ allatu nōy niliyiṉ nikaḻvukaḷ tiṭīreṉa atikarittal.

overshoot alkalosis : mikikkāra nōy : pikārpaṉēṭṭi kuḷikiyāka virivāka uṭceluttutal kāraṇamāka, lākṭik amilamum, keṭṭō amilamum pikkārpaṉēṭṭā ākcikaramākum pōtu lākṭik aciṭōcicilum, keṭṭōciṭōcicilum itu kāṇappaṭum.

overweight : miki eṭi : vayatu, uyaram, uṭalvāku ākiyavaṟ ṟukkup pōtiya kaḻivu ceyyappaṭṭapiṉpu, uṭal eṭi iyalpukku atikamāṉa aḷavil iruttal. ukanta eṭikku 20% atikamāka iruntāl atu miki eṭiyākum.

owl eye appearance : āntik kaṇ tōṟṟam : curappik kāyccal pōṉṟa nōyi uṇṭākkukiṟa tēmal kirumik kuṭumpattic cērnta ṭi.eṉ.ē uṭiya nōykkirumikaḷiṉāl uṇṭākum nōyil kāṇappaṭum uḷtukaḷ. intak kirumikaḷāl pātikkappaṭṭa tōliḻima uyiraṇukkaḷ eṭuppāka virivaṭintum, kurutic cevvaṇukkaḷil aḷavukku mīṟi uḷ tukaḷkaḷ maruntum, oru eṭuppāṉa muḻuttāḻelumpiṉāl cūḻappaṭṭum kāṇappaṭum.

oxacillin : ākcāciliṉ : peṉciliṉēs etirppuc caktiyuṭiya oru peṉciliṉ nōy nuṇma etirppup poruḷ. itu vaṭṭa pākṭīriyākkaḷi uṇṭākkum peṉciliṉēs mūlam ēṟpaṭum kaṭumiyāṉa toṟṟu nōykaḷik kuṇappaṭuttap payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

oxalate : ākcālēṭ : ākcālik amilattiṉ or uppu. pacaḷikkīri, 'rupārp' eṉṟa ceṭi, tēyili pōṉṟa uṇavāka uṭkoḷḷattakka uṇavup poruḷkaḷil ākcālēṭ uppu mikutiyāka uḷḷatu.

oxidant : ākcikaraṇap poruḷ : or ākcikaraṇip poruḷ. itu ākcijaṉik koṇṭirukkum. anta ākcijaṉi mika eḷitāka vaḻaṅkum.

oxidase : ākciṭēs : ākcijaṉ (uyirvāyu) uṟpattiyi atikamākkum oru cerimāṉap poruḷ (eṉcim) ākcijaṉ ēṟṟum noti.

oxprenoloi hydrochloride : ākspiraṉōlāl hiṭirō kuḷōriṭu : maṭṭumīṟiya irattak kotippiṉpōtu (miki iratta aḻuttam) payaṉpaṭut tappaṭum maruntu.

oxycephaly : kūmpu maṇṭi : tiripāṉa vaṭivattil uḷḷa maṇṭiyōṭu. itu ucci maṟṟum vakiṭṭu iṇivukaḷ uriya kālattukku muṉṉatākavē mūṭik koḷvatāl uṇṭākiṟatu. itaṉāl, tali virivāka mēlnōkki vaḷarntu, ataṟku nīṇṭa, kuṟukiya, kūmpu vaṭivattik koṭukkiṟatu.

oxymetazoline : ākcimeṭṭācōliṉ : mūkkuk kuruti nāḷa cuṟukka maruntu. mukkaṭippiṉ pōtu itaṉāl uṭaṉaṭiyākak kuṇam teriyum āṉāl, intak kuṇam kuṟukiyakālamē nīṭikkum. itaṉi aṭikkaṭip payaṉpaṭuttiṉāl etirk kurutit tiraṭci ēṟpaṭum apāyam uṇṭu.

oxymetholone : uyirp poruḷ ūkki : uyirp poruḷākku taṟkuriya oru kūṭṭupporuḷ.

oxymetry : ākcijaṉ aḷavīṭu : kurutiyiluḷḷa ākcijaṉ aḷavi, kurutiyiṉ mātiriyi eṭuttu, kātuk kuḻāyuṭaṉ allatu viral nuṉiyuṭaṉ iṇintuḷḷa oru cātaṉattip payaṉpaṭutti aḷaviṭutal.

oxymon-2000 : nāṭi aḷavu karuvi : uṭaliṉ nāṭit tuṭippiyum ākcijaṉ paṟṟiyum aṟiya utavum karuvi. aṟuvi maruttuvam mūlam, avacara maruttuvap pirivilum itu payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. miṉ taṭi ēṟpaṭṭālum 2 maṇi nēram vari itiluḷḷa miṉkalam iyaṅkum nēram, nāṭittuṭippu vikitam ākiyavi accāki veḷivarum. itil āṭkāṭṭi virali nuḻittatumē avaratu nāṭittuṭippu aḷavu paṭattil terintuviṭum.

oxypertine : ākciperṭṭiṉ : narampukkōḷāṟu, muraṇ mūḷi nōy ākiyavaṟṟil payaṉpaṭum uṟakka maruntu.

oxyphenbutazone : ākciḵpeṉpuṭṭācōṉ : vīkkattit taṇittu nōvakaṟṟakkūṭiya allatu mūṭṭu vīkkattip pōkkak kūṭiya oru maruntu. itu naccat taṉmi yuṭiyatākiyāl, oru kaḷimpākap payaṉpaṭuttappaṭuvatu nīṅkalāka vēṟetaṟkum ippōtu payaṉpaṭuttappaṭuvatilli.

ozone : ōcōṉ; kamaḻi; ceṟi uyiraka oti '(o3)' : ākcijaṉiṉ (pirāṇavāyu) aṇuttiripu vaṭivaṅkaḷil oṉṟu. āṟṟal vāynta ākcikaraṇap paṇpukaḷik koṇṭatu. itaṉāl, nōyk kirumi taṭi marun tākavum, toṟṟuttaṭi maruntākavum, payaṉpaṭukiṟatu. itu nuriyīral maṇṭalattil ericcaliyum, naccuttaṉmiyiyum uṇṭākkakkūṭiyatu.





itil uḷḷa miṉkalam mūlam kampi tūṇṭutal peṟṟu itayat tuṭippic cīrākkukiṟatu. ikkaruvi poruttappaṭṭa cila nāṭkaḷil nōyāḷikaḷiṉ itayam mīṇṭum tāṉākavē taṉ paṇiyit toṭaṅkiviṭum. ikkaruvi 10 āṇṭukaḷ vari vēli ceyyum.

pachyblepharon : tiṇ kaṇṇimi; taṭi imi : kaṇṇimikaḷ tiṇmiyāka iruttal.

pachycephalia : tiṇ maṇṭi; taṭi maṇṭi : tiṇmiyāṉa maṇṭiyōṭu.

pachyehilia : tiṇ utaṭu; taṭi utaṭu : utaṭukaḷ tiṇmiyāka iruttal.

pachydermato coele : taṭit tōlpi : 1. mikuntu toṅkum tōl maṭippukaḷ, 2. perum narampunārk kaṭṭi.

pachydermia : tiṇ tōl; taṭittōl; coraṇiyiṉmi; ūṟuṇarcciyiṉmi : tōl tiṇmi peṟṟiruttal ūṟu uṇarcci illātiruttal.

pachydermoperiostosis : taṭittōl eṉpu cuṟṟu : iyalpukku mīṟit taṭitta tōliṉ iyalpāṉa maṭippukaḷ, talit tōl, mukattōliṉ mikunta curukkaṅkaḷ, ki, kāl uṟuppukaḷiṉ cēyma elumpukaḷ taṭittal maṟṟum taṭitta viralkaḷ.

pachydermy : taṭittōl : tirāyṭu kuṟivīkkattil uḷḷa puratam mikunta miyūciṉ allatu piṭyūṭṭari miki nōyiluḷḷa nekiḻā iṇit tiṉkuvippāl vilaṅkuttōl pōṉṟa tōlaṭit taṭippu.

problem-based learning (PBL) : cikkal aṭippaṭiyāṉa paṭippu : oru cikkalukku tīrvu kāṇpataṉ mūlam allatu purintu koḷḷa mēṟkoḷḷum muṟikaḷiṉ viḷivāka kaṟṟaṟital.

problem-based medical curriculum : nōy nili aṭippaṭiyāṉa maruttuvak kalvi : aṭippaṭi maruttuva aṟiviyaliyum nōyāḷiyip paricōtippatiyum oruṅkiṇitta kalvimuṟi.

pyelonepthritis : ciṟunīraka cīḻ aḻaṟci; ciṟunīrakam-kuḻi aḻaṟci : ciṟunīrakak kuḻiyiliruntu ciṟunīrakattiṉ mēluṟivarip paravum oruvakic ciṟunīraka nōy.

Pygnalionism : pikmēliyāṉiyam : kirēkkac ciṟpi pikmēliyāṉ, tāṉ vaṭitta cili uruviyē kātalittatu pōṉṟu, tāṉ uruvākkiya oṉṟiṉ mēlēyē kātal koḷḷum kōḷāṟu nili.

pyloroduodenol : irippic ciṟukuṭal cārnta : irippik kāppu vāyil curuṅku taci maṟṟum muṉ ciṟukuṭal toṭarpāṉa.

pylorospasm : irippik kāppu vāyil icivu : irippik kāppu vāyilil ēṟpaṭum icippu. itu perumpālum muṉ ciṟukuṭal cīḻppuṇ kāraṇamāka uṇṭākiṟatu.

﻿Q



Q band : kyūpaṭṭi : oḷirum niṟapporuḷāṉa kviṉākriṉ koṇṭu iṉakkīṟṟukaḷ niṟa mēṟṟappaṭumpōtu kuṟip piṭṭa iṭaṅkaḷil tōṉṟum oḷirum paṭṭikaḷ, ṭi.eṉ.ē, curuḷukkuḷ cerukukiṉṟaṉa.

Q fever : kiyū-kāyccal : āṭu māṭukaḷiṭamiruntu maṉitarukkut toṟṟum oruvakik kāyccal nōy.

QRS complex : kyūāres tokuti : itaya miṉ vari paṭattil oru pakuti. itayak kīḻaṟikaḷāṉa veṉṭrikkiḷ kaḷ curuṅkumpōtu tōṉṟum pakuti mutalil tōṉṟum etirmiṉ tiruppam kyū, aṭuttu nērmiṉ tiruppattāl mēl nōkkiya ali ār, toṭarntu varum etirmiṉ tiruppam es ākum.

QRS interval : kyūāres iṭi nēram : itayakkīḻaṟiyāṉa veṉṭrikkiḷkaḷiṉ miṉ muṉippiyakkam māṟum nēram. itu itaya miṉ vari paṭattil kyū allatu vaṅkuvatiliruntu es ali muṭiyum variyuḷḷa nēram. itaṉ carācari aḷavu 0.04 vināṭi mutal 0.1 vināṭi vari

QS wave : kyūes ali : itayamiṉ varipaṭattil nērami ār illāta muḻuvatum etir (miṉ tiruppa) ali maṭṭum koṇṭa kyūāres tokuti.

QT interval : kyūṭī iṭinēram : itayamiṉ varipaṭattil itayakkīḻaṟi curuṅkum nēram, kyū allatu vaṅkuvatu mutal ṭī ali muṭivu vari kaṇakkiṭappaṭukiṟatu. itu itayamiṉ oṭṭa mukappu mīḷ tiruppattik kuṟikkiṟatu.

quack : pōli maruttuvaṉ; pōli aṟuviyāḷar; ari kuṟi maruttuvam : maruttuva aṟivō, paṭṭaṟivō illāmal, iruppatupōl naṭikkum oruttaṉ.

quackery : pōli maruttuvam : oru nōy nilikku kuṇam tarum poruḷ, karuvi, allatu maruttuva muṟi eṉa poyyākak kūṟutal.

quadrigeminal; quarigeminal : nāḷ mukikaḷ : narampaṇukkaḷ kuviyap peṟṟa naṭu mūḷiyiṉ nāṉku mēṭukaḷ.

quadrigeminal pulse : nāṟṟuṭi nāṭi : nāṉku tuṭippum oru iṭi veḷiyum uḷḷa nāṭi vaki.

quadripara (quartipara) : nāṉkām karuttarippu : nālupeṟṟa peṇ nāṉkumuṟi karuttarittu nālu uyiruḷḷa kuḻantikaḷip peṟṟeṭutta peṇ.

quadruped : nāṟkāl vilaṅku : nāṉku kālkaḷiyuṭiya vilaṅku kikaḷiyum kālkaḷiyum tariyil ūṉṟiya nili.

quadruple vaccine : nāṟkūṭṭu; maṭaṅku ammippāl : toṇṭi aṭippāṉ, kakkuvāṉ, iḷampiḷḷi vātam, vilvāta caṉṉi ākiya nōykaḷukku etirāka nōyt taṭuppu ceyvataṟkāṉa ammip pāl maruntu.

qualitative : paṇpu cārnta; paṇputtiṟaṉ : paṇpu aṭippaṭi yilāṉa paṇpu toṭarpāṉa.

Quenu-Mayo operation : kuveṇu-mēyō aṟuvi : ḵpireñcu aṟuvi maruttuvar kkuveṇuvum amerikka aṟuvi maruttuvar mēyōvum cērntu kaṇṭupiṭitta aṟuvi maruttuva puṟṟu nōyi kuṇappaṭutta nērkkuṭaliyum cuṟṟiyuḷḷa niṇakkaṇukkaḷiyum veṭṭi yeṭuttal.

Quick tourniquet test : kuvikṭurṉikkēṭ cōtaṉi : mēṟkiyil iratta aḻuttakkaṭṭup paṭṭiyi kaṭṭuvataṉ mūlam tōṉṟum karuñciṟuppu tōṟ puḷḷikaḷik kaṇakkiṭum cōtaṉi mēṟkiyil iratta oṭṭam taṭipaṭumpōtu tantukikaḷiṉ valuviṉmiyik kaṇṭupiṭikkum cōtaṉi.

Quiescent : amitiyāṉa aciviṉmi : oru nōy aṭaṅkik kiṭakkum nili; kuṟippāka oru tōlnōy ivvāṟu irukkum amitik kālam.

quinacrine : kuviṉēkriṉ : nāṭāppuḻunōy, nūlpuḻu nōy maruttuvam maṟṟum malēriyāvi kaṭṭuppaṭuttum maruttuvattukkum payaṉpaṭuttap paṭum kārvaki maruntup poruḷ.

quinalbarbitone : koyṉal pārpiṭṭōṉ : kuṟukiya kālam ceyaṟpaṭum oruvakip pārpiṭṭurēṭ ilēcāṉa uṟakkamiṉmi, maṉakkavali nilikaḷil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭukiṟatu.

quinapril : kuviṉāpril : āñciyōṭeṉciṉ maṟṟum noti taṭuppu (ēciī iṉhipiṭṭar) eṉṉum vaki cārnta kuruti aḻuttattukkāṉa maruttuvattil payaṉpaṭuttappaṭum maruntu.

Quincke's puise : kuviṉk(kē) nāṭi; tantuki nāṭi : itaya ayōḷarṭṭik vālv ceyal paṭā niliyil, nakappaṭukiyil tantukip parappukaḷ veḷiṟiyum civantum māṟimāṟit tōṉṟum nili.

quinestrol : ceyaṟki peṇpāl iyakkunīr : ceyaṟkiyāṉa peṇpāliṉa iyakkunīr (hārmōṉ). itu pāl curappati maṭṭuppaṭuttukiṟatu.

quinoline : kuviṉōliṉ : kāyccal etirppu maṟṟum kirumi nīkka kuṇaṅkaḷik koṇṭa kviṉiṉ allatu kari eṇṇiyiliruntu peṟappaṭṭa kāra vakip poruḷ.

quirk : kuyirk : vintiyāṉa ceyal, naṭatti, āḷumi, ēyppuc ceyal, coṟpuraṭṭu.

qunidine : koyiṉiṭiṉ : koyiṉā pōṉṟa veṭiyak kalappuṭiya oru vētiyiyal mūlapporuḷ (kārakam). itu itayat tamaṉit taciyil taṉi viḷiviṉi uṇṭupaṇṇukiṟatu. cila camayam tamaṉi nāriḻi yākkattilum payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

quinine : koyiṉā : ciṉkōṉāp paṭṭiyiluḷḷa kārakap poruḷ ciṅkōṉāppaṭṭik kārakamaṭaṅkiya maruntu. oru camayam, muṟik kāyccalukkup (malēriyā) payaṉpaṭuttap paṭṭatu. piṉṉar itaṟkup patilāka vēṟu maruntukaḷ payaṉpaṭuttappaṭalāyiṉa. inta maruntukaḷukku etirāka muṟik kāyccal etirppu āṟṟal peṟṟuviṭṭatāl, ippōtu itu mīṇṭum payaṉpaṭuttap paṭṭu varukiṟatu.

quininism : koyiṉā nōy : talivali, kātukaḷil ocikaḷ eḻutal, oraḷavu ceviṭṭut taṉmi kaṇpārvikkōḷāṟu: kumaṭṭal pōṉṟa nōyk kuṟikaḷ tōṉṟutal koyiṉāvi toṭarntu payaṉpaṭuttuvatāl ivi ēṟpaṭukiṉṟaṉa.

quinsy : toṇṭi vīkkam; toṇṭi cīḻkkaṭṭi : uḷ nākkup paḻuppu uḷ nākku aḻaṟci.

quotidian : nāḷ muṟic caṉṉi : nāḷtōṟum viṭāmal varum kāyccal.

quotient : īvu : vakuttu vanta eṇ. aṟivukkuṟi eṇ eṉpatu aṟivuttiṟaṉ aḷaveṇ. cuvāca īvu eṉpatu, oru kuṟippiṭṭa kāla aḷaviṉ pōtu uḷḷiḻukkum ākcijaṉ aḷavukkum, veḷiviṭum kārpaṉṭi-yākciṭiṉ aḷavukkum iṭiyilāṉa vikitam.

Q wave : kuyū ali : itayamiṉ vari paṭattil ār alikku muṉ tōṉṟum oru ciṟiya etir miṉ tiruppam iṭatu kīḻaṟiyiliruntu valatu kīḻaṟikkum kīḻaṟiyiṭit taṭuppuc cuvar vaḻi ēṟpaṭum iyakkam.





﻿radiculography : vēr ūṭu katirppaṭam : mutukantaṇṭu narampu vērkaḷ ūṭukatir (eksrē) paṭam. inta vērkaḷik katir ūṭuruvātavāṟu ceytu, anta vērkaḷiṉ ūṭu katirppaṭam eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu. nekiḻcciyaṭinta iṭi mutukelumpu vaṭṭac cilliṉ iṭattiyum, aḷaviyum kaṇṭaṟiya ippaṭam eṭukkappaṭukiṟatu.

radioactive : katiriyakkapporuḷ; katiriyakka : aṇukkaru miyam uṟutiyaṟṟiruppatāl veppak katirkaḷivīcakkūṭiya poruḷ. nuriyīral nōykaḷi ārāya katiriyakkat taṅkam payaṉpaṭuttap paṭukiṟatu. kēṭayac curappiyil (tirāyṭu) katiriyakka ayōṭiṉ irukkiṟatu. itaṉi aḷaviṭṭu aṟiyalām.

radiobiology : katiriyakka uyiriyal : uyiruḷḷa ticukkaḷiṉmītu katiriyakkattiṉ viḷivukaḷi ārāyum aṟiviyal.

radiocesium : katiriyakka cīciyam : cīciyam eṉṟa taṉimattiṉ katiriyakkat taṉmi koṇṭa oru vaṭivam; itu, nōykaḷukkāṉa katiriyakka maruttuvattil payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

radiocarbon : katiriyakka kārpaṉ : kārpaṉ (kariyam) eṉṟa taṉimattiṉ katiriyakka vaṭivam. itu, vaḷarciti māṟṟam paṟṟiya ārāycciyil payaṉpaṭukiṟatu.

zonoskeleton : pakuti elumpuk kūṭu : iṭuppelumpu, mutukuppaṭṭiyelumpu, kāriyelampu pōṉṟa uṟuppukaḷ oṭṭum pakka elumpukaḷ.

zonula ciliaris : kaṇṇimi iḻippiḻi : kaṇviḻiyāṭiyiṉ puṟappakutiyik kaṇṇimi mayiruṭaṉ iṇikkum toṅku iṇippiḻi.

zonule : paṭṭi vaḷiyam; ciṟu pakuti : ciṟupaṭṭi vaḷiyam.

zonulolysis : kaṇṇimi iṇippiḻi aḻaṟci; nuṇ pulamuṟivu : kaṇṇimi iḻip piḻiyil ēṟpaṭum vīkkam.

zoodermic : pirāṇittōl cārnta : tōl oṭṭaṟuviyil pōl pirāṇittōl koṇṭu ceyyappaṭṭa.

zooglea : oṭṭiya nuṇṇuyirkaḷ : ūṉpacipporuḷāl patiyappaṭṭuḷḷa, nuṇṇuyirkaḷiṉ tokuti.

zoogony : uyirākkam : uṭalukkuḷḷiruntu, uyiruḷḷa iḷam uyir oṉṟi uruvākkutal.

zoograft : vilaṅkutticu oṭṭaṟuvi : oru kīḻnili (pirāṇi) vilaṅkiliruntu ticuvi eṭuttu oṭṭaṟuvi.

zooid : vilaṅku pōṉṟa : oru vilaṅkuk kūṭṭattil oru uyir.

zoolagnia : vilaṅkuppāliṉa kavarcci : vilaṅkukaḷiṉ mēl pāliṉak kavarcci.

zoology : vilaṅkiyal : vilaṅkukaḷip paṟṟik kūṟum uyiriyal viññāṉap pirivu.

zoomania : vilaṅku vēṭki : vilaṅkukaḷiṉ mēl aḷavu mīṟiya viruppam.

zoonosis : tāvu nōy; vilaṅku vaḻi toṟṟu nōy; vilaṅkiya nōy : vilaṅkiṭamiruntu maṉitarukkut tāvakkūṭiya nōy, iṟiccik koṭṭilkaḷ, paṇṇit toḻilāḷarkaḷ ākiyōrukku innōy uṇṭākum.

zoonotic helminths : vilaṅku ēntukuṭaṟpuḻukkaḷ : ṭirik kiḷullāspirālis, ṭāksōkērā kēṉis, āṉkaki lōsṭōmāpirēsiliyeṉ cis, kṉētō sṭōmā vilaṅkukaḷāl maṉitarkaḷukkup paravum kuṭaṟ puḻukkaḷ. zoophilia : vilaṅku aṉpu : 1. vilaṅkukaḷiṉ mēl iyalpallā aṉpu, 2. pāliṉak kiḷarcciyi aṭivataṟkāka, pāluṟavu allatu uṭaluṟavi virumputal.

zoospore : vilaṅkuk karumūlam : cila ōraṇuvuyirkaḷ, pūñcikaḷ, pācikaḷ uruvākkum nakarum karuvaṇu.

zootoxin : vilaṅkunaccu :tēḷkaḷ, cilantikaḷ, pāmpukaḷiṉ viṣam pōṉṟa vilaṅkukaḷi liruntu uruvākum naccup poruḷ allatu atu mātiri nacciliruntu tayārikkappaṭum ūnīr.

z-plasty : isṭ oṭṭaṟuvi : taḻumpuc curukkaṅkaḷi iḷak kuvataṟku ceyyappaṭum vaṭiva mippu (cīr) aṟuvi isaṭ vaṭivil kīṟi, iru mukkōṇa maṭippukaḷi avaṟṟiṉ muṉikaḷ curukkakkōṭṭi tāṇṭuvatu pōl iṭam peyartal.

zoster : tēmal : paṭar tāmari, akki.

z protein : isṭ puratam : varit taciyiṉ isṭpaṭṭiyil iyalpāka uḷḷa oru puratam.

z score : isṭkaṇippeṇ : kaṇippeṇṇukkum carācarikkum uḷḷa vēṟupāṭṭi oru niliyāṉa vilakalāl vakuppatik kuṟikkum matippeṇ vilakal.

z-track : isṭ taṭam : uḷ celuttappaṭṭa karical piṉ varāmal taṭukkiṉṟa muṟiyil uṭceluttum muṟi.

Zuckerkandl's bodies : sīkker kēṉṭil meymaṅkaḷ : jermaṉ uṭaṟkūṟiyalāḷar emilkkar kēṉṭil vivaritta, makātamaṉi iraṇṭākap piriyumiṭattiṟku arukiluḷḷa pakka narampu muṭiccu narampaṇut tiraḷkaḷ.

Zulu dancer's hip : sūlu naṭaṉamāṭuvōr iṭi : sūlu makkaḷil uṇṭākum toḻil maya mūṭṭaḻaṟci.

zvalue : isaṭ-matippu : oru makkaṭ kuḻuviṉ carācari kuṟippiṭṭa peṇṇiṭamiruntu māṟutal illi eṉṉum puṉivu kōḷukkāṉa puḷḷi vivarac cōtaṉi.

z wave : isaṭ-ali : itaya mēlaṟi maṟṟum kīḻaṟic curukkaṅkaḷukkiṭi nērattil mēlaṟi aḻuttam kuṟital.

zwitterion : īrayaṉi : nērmiṉṉēṟṟamum etirmiṉṉēṟṟamum koṇṭa ayaṉi.

zygodactyly : viraluḷḷa : oṭṭi iṇinta viralkaḷip pōli allāmal viralelumpukaḷiṉ elumpiṉip piṇippiṉṟi, tōl maṟṟum meṉticukkaḷāl oṭṭiyuḷḷa viralkaḷ.

zygogene cells : jikōjīṉ aṇukkaḷ : pepsiṉ curakkum irippi uyiraṇukkaḷ.

zygoma : kaṉṉa elumpu : kaṉṉattiṉ vaḷivelumpu.

zygomaticus : kaṉṉakkatupput taci : mēlutaṭṭi mēlākavum veḷippakkamum iḻukkum mukattaci. mukattiṉ iru pakkamum oru periyatum oru ciṟiyatumeṉa kaṉṉak katupput tacikaḷ uḷḷaṉa.

zygomycetes : oṭṭiṇip pūñci : etirppu caktiyiḻantavarkaḷil vaḷarum apciṭiṉ, miyūkār, rijōpas pōṉṟa pūñcikkāḷāṉ) tokuti.

zygomycosis : oṭṭiṉi pūñcit toṟṟu : nōyāḷikaḷil tōṉṟum miyūkōrāciyē kuṭumpatti cērnta pūñcit toṟṟu. otutōlaṭit ticukkaḷ maṭṭumirukkakkūṭum allatu iratta nāḷaṅkaḷukkup paravakkūṭum.

zygosis : oṭṭukkaru : āṇ peṇpālaṇukkaḷiṉ (muṭṭiyum vintaṇuvum) iṇivatāl uṇṭākum karuvuṟṟa muṭṭi.

zygote : irupālaṇu iṇivup poruḷ.

zygotene : sikōṭṭēṉ : uyiraṇuppiḷaviṉ mutal niliyil orupaṭi.

zyme : puḷimā nōykkirumi.

zymogen : simōjaṉ : oru ceyal tiṟamikka cerimāṉap poruḷiṉ (eṉsim) muṉṉōṭipporuḷ. itu amilapporuḷāl ceyalūkkam peṟukiṟatu.

zymogenesis : samōjeṉ notiyātal : simōjeṉ oru ceyalpaṭum notiyāka urumāṟutal.

zymolysis : notiyaḻivu : notikaḷiṉ cīraṇa maṟṟum puḷikkum ceyalkaḷ.

zymose : simōs : iṉver ṭiṉ oru māṉōcākkariṭi ṭicēkkariṭuāka māṟṟum noti.

zymosis : puḷippūṭṭam : naṇma nuḻivup perukkak kōḷāṟu.

zymotic disease : puḷippūṭṭa nōy : uṭampukku veḷiyē iruntu uṭalukkuḷ celuttappaṭum kirumikaḷāl uṇṭākum toṟṟunōy puḷittup pōkac ceyvatu pōṉṟatu.

zz : isṭ isṭ : ālḵpā, ṭiripsiṉ etirppik kuṟivil pōṉṟa ottapālaṇu vaki.





inta miṉṉūlip paṟṟi


uṅkaḷukku immiṉṉūl, iṇiya nūlakamāṉa, vikkimūlattil iruntu kiṭittuḷḷatu[1].

inta iṇiya nūlakam taṉṉārvalarkaḷāl vaḷarukiṟatu. vikkimūlam patiya taṉṉārvalarkaḷi varavēṟkiṟatu. tāṅkaḷum vikkimūlattil iṇintu mēlum pala miṉṉūlkaḷi aṉivarum paṭikkumāṟu ceyyalām.

mikunta akkaṟiyuṭaṉ meyppu ceytālum, miṉṉūlil piḻi ētēṉum iruntāl tayakkam illāmal, vikkimūlattil immiṉṉūliṉ pēccu pakkattil terivikkalām allatu piḻikaḷi nīṅkaḷē kūṭa cari ceyyalām.

ippaṭippākkam, kaṭṭaṟṟa urimaṅkaḷōṭu (potukaḷa /kuṉu -Commons /GNU FDL )[2][3] ilavacamāka aḷikkappaṭukiṟatu. eṉavē, inta uriyi nīṅkaḷ maṟṟavarōṭu pakiralām; māṟṟi mēmpaṭuttalām; vaṇika nōkkattōṭum, vaṇika nōkkamiṉṟiyum payaṉpaṭuttalām
